Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Agentic AI and large language models are shaping how enterprise software gets built, deployed, and operated at scale. We're hiring a Senior Software Development Engineer to lead that charge, architecting AI-driven solutions that reshape how partners like SAP run mission-critical workloads on AWS. This role demands a self-starter mindset, rapid experimentation, and expertise in partner ecosystems, ideal for engineers who love learning, challenging norms, and building prototypes that ship.

The AI & Strategic Partner Engineering team builds deep integrations between AWS and strategic partners, creating seamless interoperability that accelerates time-to-market for joint customers. We're expanding across Agentic AI, LLM-powered workflows, distributed systems, security, and emerging AWS services, pioneering collaborative AI agent patterns that turn weeks of integration work into days. A wave of innovation is revolutionizing partner ecosystems through AI-driven automation, secure architectures, and elastic scalability, reshaping how global enterprises deploy and operate cloud solutions.

Candidate should be willing to travel to work with partner to do co-development engineering,
travel may be 50%


Key job responsibilities
You'll define the technical direction for your team, own architectural decisions, and drive cross-team alignment in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment, building partner-driven solutions alongside skillful builders, senior engineers, and architects. You'll design and deliver mission-critical integrations between partners (like SAP) and AWS-native services spanning Agentic AI, LLM workflows, distributed systems, security, databases, and emerging AWS services, enabling seamless data flow, identity management, and compliance for global enterprises.

You'll architect AI-augmented SDLC patterns, collaborate with AI agents to rapidly prototype and validate solutions, and own full-stack delivery from design through production, emphasizing high availability, performance, and customer delight. You'll build detailed technical specifications, master diverse domains, and turn ambiguity into shipped products. You'll mentor junior engineers, partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Security, AI Research), influence roadmaps through data and credibility, and represent your team externally to partner service teams and leadership. All team members actively participate in product definition, architecture reviews, iterative development, code review, and operations. Clear, professional communication with teammates, customers, and partners is essential.


A day in the life
You'll identify partner pain points and make architectural decisions that blend scalability, security, and AI innovation. You'll rapidly prototype solutions using AI agents, validate them through load testing, and drive cross-team alignment with partner service teams. You'll mentor engineers through design reviews, troubleshoot complex distributed failures, and document decisions to empower future teams. Occasional travel may be required based on engineering work requirements with partners.

About the team
The AI & Strategic Partner Engineering team empowers AWS partners to innovate at cloud scale. We're pioneers in integrating AI-driven capabilities into partner offerings, building secure, scalable foundations for tomorrow's enterprise workloads.
Join us to redefine what's possible for partners on AWS. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members thrive on one-on-one collaboration, thorough but kind code reviews, and the autonomy to drive high-impact technical decisions. We invest in your growth through challenging projects that expand your architectural breadth and leadership influence.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques

Preferred qualifications

- 7+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
- Autonomous Agent & Generative AI Engineering: Experienced in creating, maintaining, and successfully deploying multiple autonomous AI agents into production systems for enterprise customers and external partners. Possesses a deep understanding of different AI-native technologies, with demonstrated success implementing robust guardrails

title: Finance Manager, Ads Agencies
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, and entrepreneurs across our international markets. We offer customers a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying. These solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more.

Amazon Ads seeks a Finance Manager to lead Agency Finance and Strategy across the global expansion portfolio. This role is the primary Finance partner to agency leadership teams supporting a broad portfolio of international locales including Japan, Canada, Brazil, Australia, Mexico, UAE, TR, the Nordics, and others. This locales and reports directly to the Finance Director supporting global expansion for Ads Sales.

A successful candidate will operate independently in a rapidly growing and evolving business. The ideal candidate will be as comfortable building and refining financial models as they are with challenging and refining business strategies.

Key job responsibilities
Financial Planning & Modeling

Own the agency revenue plan across the IX+CA+JP portfolio, supporting rapid multi-year growth targets

Build and maintain financial models supporting long-range scenarios, stepping stones, and sensitivity analyses

Lead quarterly guidance, annual planning cycles, and variance analysis across dozens of deals and locales

Model the economics of incentive structures (rebates, price terms, hybrid) that vary by market

Strategy Development

Partner with agency sales leadership to drive three simultaneous transformation workstreams: coverage expansion, incentive optimization, and partner segmentation

Develop the strategy to significantly expand agency coverage and deepen engagement with agency partners

Build the business case and roadmap for scaling the Independent agency segment

Identify and close advertiser concentration and supply source gaps

Business Partnership

Serve as a trusted advisor across agency leadership teams spanning multiple locales and holdco structures

Translate complex, multi-market financial data into actionable narratives for senior leadership

Challenge assumptions, pressure-test targets, and bring analytical rigor to investment decisions

A day in the life
The Agency landscape is a large, high-growth portfolio with an ambitious multi-year trajectory. It spans Big6 holdcos and Indies across diverse markets, with incentive structures that vary significantly by locale and coverage that must expand substantially over the planning horizon. This role will be at the center of that transformation.

About the team
This role is part of an international and decentralized team supporting over 30 recently launched Ads business across Asia, Europe, North and South America, and Australia.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 5+ years of Microsoft Excel experience
- Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
- Experience defining, refining and implementing sales processes, procedures and policies or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Salesforce (or other CRM tool) or BI tools
- Experience presenting to senior leadership

title: Senior PMT-ES, AWS FinOps Agent, AWS Insights and Optimizations
descriptionHtml:
We're building the future of cloud financial management by making FinOps autonomous, intelligent, and agent-native. The AWS Billing organization processes millions of events per second to deliver cost, usage, and optimization insights that power the financial decisions of the world's largest enterprises. We're now transforming how customers interact with this data, moving from dashboards and reports to agentic experiences that continuously understand, control, and optimize AWS spend on their behalf.

As Senior Product Manager - Technical, you'll own the product strategy and execution for AWS FinOps Agent, building agentic workflows and expanding its cloud financial management capabilities, with responsibility for defining and driving their evolution as the technology landscape advances. You'll determine how millions of customers and AI agents discover, analyze, and act on AWS cost and usage data through AWS FinOps Agent.

In this role, you'll drive the vision for making AWS the most agent-friendly cloud for financial management, define the product strategy that governs how generative AI transforms cost management workflows, and own the measurement and continuous improvement of the AI-powered FinOps experience across AWS. You'll evaluate emerging agent frameworks, reasoning models, and interface patterns, determining when to adopt, extend, or build new approaches to maintain AWS's leadership in autonomous cloud economics. You'll work at the intersection of generative AI, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise finance to pioneer the next generation of FinOps.

You'll collaborate with engineering teams, applied scientists, and product teams across AWS to ensure AWS FinOps Agent delivers measurable value to customers, from individual developers optimizing a single account to enterprise CFOs managing billions in cloud spend. This role requires deep technical understanding of generative AI, agent architectures, and AWS cloud financial management, combined with the ability to influence without authority across a large, distributed organization.

If you're passionate about making cloud financial management autonomous and excited about defining how generative AI transforms enterprise FinOps, this role offers the opportunity to shape AWS's agent-first cost intelligence strategy.


Key job responsibilities
* Create the product vision, and strategy for internal and external customers.
* Engage with customers through a variety of channels and serve as the voice of the customer internally.
* Gain feedback from customers to ensure right focus in building our products
* Manage the entire product life cycle from strategic planning to tactical execution.
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver on the product roadmap.

* Define and maintain a product roadmap with inputs from all stakeholders.
* Provide effective written and verbal updates on the products and key projects to senior leadership and stakeholders.

- 5+ years of product management in the cloud computing technology space experience

- Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

title: Duales Studium - BWL
descriptionHtml:
Ein Job im Operations-Bereich bei Amazon versetzt dich ins Zentrum dessen, wie Dinge vom Klick bis zur Haustür gelangen. Du hilfst dabei, Systeme zu entwerfen, zu verbessern und zu betreiben, die Menschen, Produkte und Orte miteinander verbinden – und das in großem Maßstab. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Teams zusammen, um reale Herausforderungen zu lösen, und siehst die direkten Ergebnisse deiner Entscheidungen, wenn sie täglich bei den Kunden ankommen. Hier ist die Wirkung dessen, was du aufbaust, nicht abstrakt – sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam – und hält eine der komplexesten Betriebsorganisationen der Welt am Laufen. Hier nimmt deine Reise Gestalt an – durch Handeln, Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, in viele Richtungen zu wachsen Dein Einstieg in die Führung - Das Duale Studium bei Amazon
- Studiengang: BWL / Logistikmanagement (B.A.)
- Studienpartner: IU Internationale Hochschule (30+ Standorte deutschlandweit)
- Programmbeginn: 1. August 2027
- Dauer: 3,5 Jahre
- Einsatzorte: mehr als 20 Amazon-Standorte in Deutschland (Fulfillment Center und Sort Center)
Das duale Studium bei Amazon ist ein strukturiertes Führungsentwicklungsprogramm, das dich Schritt für Schritt auf eine operative Führungsrolle vorbereitet. Wer das Programm erfolgreich abschließt, hat die Chance direkt eine Position als Area Manager:in in unserem Netzwerk zu bekommen - ohne weiteres Bewerbungsverfahren.
________________________________________
Drei Phasen auf dem Weg zur Führungskraft
Das Programm ist in drei aufeinander aufbauende Phasen gegliedert, die deinen Verantwortungsbereich kontinuierlich erweitern.
Phase 1 - Operative Grundlagen: Zunächst lernst du die operativen Abläufe im Fulfillment Center von Grund auf kennen, analysierst Kennzahlen und setzt eigenständig Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung um.
Phase 2 - Rotation & Führungsentwicklung: Anschließend rotierst du durch verschiedene operative Bereiche, übernimmst schrittweise Führungsaufgaben - von der Begleitung der Team Leads über Schichtplanung bis hin zur Personalsteuerung - und entwickelst ein Verständnis für bereichsübergreifende Zusammenhänge.
Phase 3 - Area-Manager-Niveau: In der Abschlussphase arbeitest du auf Area-Manager-Niveau: Du steuerst operative Kennzahlen, führst Teams eigenständig und trägst echte Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

Das bieten wir dir
• Karriereperspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Programms wechselst du direkt in eine Area Manager Position im Amazon-Netzwerk - ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren
• Studienfinanzierung: Amazon übernimmt die Studiengebühren an der IU
• Mentoring: Strukturierte Begleitung durch Learning Manager:in und operative Führungskräfte
• Netzwerk: Zugang zu einem europaweiten Operations-Netzwerk
• Mobilität: Kostenloses Deutschlandticket
• Verpflegung: Bezuschusste Mahlzeiten am Standort
• Mitarbeitervorteile: Vielfältige Vorteile, wie ein Amazon Mitarbeiterrabatt
• Technologie: Arbeite täglich mit modernster Automatisierungs- und Robotiktechnologie

Key job responsibilities
• Analyse und Optimierung operativer Prozesse in Fulfillment- und Sortierbereichen
• Eigenständige Durchführung von Continuous Improvement Projekten mit messbaren Ergebnissen
• Übernahme von Führungsaufgaben im Rahmen von Lead-Rotationen (Schichtverantwortung, Teamsteuerung, KPI-Management)
• Mitarbeit an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten in den Bereichen Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Personalwesen und Technik
• Vorbereitung auf die eigenständige Steuerung eines operativen Bereichs als Area Manager:in
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem internationalen Team innerhalb des europäischen Amazon-Netzwerks

A day in the life
Deine Betreuung im Programm
Du bist nicht allein. Während des gesamten Programms wirst du von zwei Seiten unterstützt:
• Dein:e Learning Manager:in am Standort begleitet dich durch alle drei Phasen, ist deine zentrale Ansprechperson und koordiniert deine Entwicklung
• Operative Führungskräfte mentoren dich während deiner Rotationen und geben dir direktes Feedback aus der Praxis
Zusätzlich bist du Teil einer deutschlandweiten Community dualer Student:innen - ein Netzwerk, das mit dir wächst.

________________________________________
Dein Alltag: Theorie und Praxis im Wochentakt
Das Studium läuft parallel zur Praxis - keine langen Blockphasen, sondern ein wöchentlicher Rhythmus:
• 2 Tage Studium an deinem IU-Standort (Logistik, Supply Chain, BWL, Personalführung)
• 2-3 Tage / 20 Stunden im Amazon Fulfillment Center oder Sort Center

Du bist kein Besucher im Betrieb. Du bist Teil des Teams - von Tag eins an.

Basic qualifications

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Affinität für das Fach Mathematik
- Umgang mit MS-Office (insbesondere Kenntnisse in Excel, Word und PowerPoint)

Preferred qualifications

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität"
- Interesse, Führungsverantwortung zu tragen

title: Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
External job description
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.
Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.


Key job responsibilities
Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:


- Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce

- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises

- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives

- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical enabler of the world's most advanced cloud computing infrastructure. In this role, you'll play a pivotal part in maintaining the heartbeat of our data center operations by ensuring seamless logistics and inventory management that directly support our technology deployment and maintenance efforts.

The Logistics Specialist plays a critical role in inventory management, ensuring optimal stock levels are maintained to support data center build and repair operations. This position serves as the primary point of contact for parts management, including receiving, inventory control, and distribution to Data Center Technicians and Engineers.

This position involves frequent lifting of materials and products. Logistics Specialists will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of the company. They must also maintain the cleanliness, organization, and safety of all workspaces. They must be available to work on weekend shifts.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Ensure that all billing associated with the Inventory supply chain is accurate, validated and ready for processing
• Assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials
• Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations
• Keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company
• Understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e. forklift or cherry picker).

Physical Requirements:
• Requires standing, sitting, and walking for prolonged periods of time.
• Typically, work is in a warehouse or data center environment where the noise level is moderate to loud.
• Occasionally assist in loading and unloading shipments.
• Occasionally exposed to supreme cold or hot weather

Work Environment:
• Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts
• Noise level varies and can be loud
• Temperatures are between 60 and 90 degrees, and will occasionally exceed 90 degrees

Basic qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent
- 1+ years of logistics or other relevant experience
- 1+ years of experience in shipping & receiving inventory and warehousing practices

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of computer hardware components and operating systems
- Experience in Warehouse Management Software / Inventory Management Software proficiency
- Familiar with waybills and shipping procedures with transport companies
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager
- Proficient with computers and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)

title: Operations Manager, Operations Manager, XRI3
descriptionHtml:
Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager.

In this role, you will play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location. You will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
- Support, mentor, and motivate your team
- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
- Create and implement productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Ops Integration, Loss Prevention and Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, as well as continuously climb and descend stairs
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments, and grocery locations include refrigerated environments)
- Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: Partner Development Manager, EMEA Central APO
descriptionHtml:
This is the next-generation PDM role where AI fluency isn't a nice-to-have — it's core to the job. We're looking for someone who can harness AI tools and insights to drive smarter, faster, and more impactful partnerships across CH and CEE.

The role sits within the AWS Partner Organization (APO), focused on building and scaling strategic relationships with Partner ecosystem to realize the vision of making Partners default choice for customers across CH and CEE: orchestrating partner-led cloud transformation at scale.

What makes this "of the future":

AI-native approach to partner management — using AI to identify market opportunities, optimize joint GTM strategies, and accelerate pipeline generation
Driving partners beyond traditional migration and modernization into GenAI-led customer engagements
Leveraging data and AI tooling to build smarter Partner Business Plans that dynamically align partner capabilities with evolving market demand
Enabling partners to have AI-informed C-suite conversations on cloud transformation
The fundamentals remain: own end-to-end partner relationships, hit revenue and pipeline targets, build C-level trust, and influence without authority across a complex ecosystem of AWS sales, SA, marketing, and ProServe teams. But the expectation is that the right candidate amplifies all of this through AI fluency — working faster, seeing patterns others miss, and helping partners do the same.

This is a role for someone who thinks strategically about indirect sales models, executes with precision, and sees AI as the multiplier that transforms how partnerships drive customer outcomes in CH and CEE.



Key job responsibilities
Strategic Partner Management

Own and manage strategic relationships with Tier 1 partners in CH and CEE, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor
Develop and execute comprehensive Partner Business Plans (PBPs) that align partner capabilities with market opportunities and drive measurable business outcomes — leveraging AI-driven insights to identify whitespace, prioritize accounts, and optimize partner engagement strategies
Build and maintain C-level and VP-level relationships with partner organizations, orchestrating executive engagement and strategic business reviews
Develop partnerships to expand market, segment, and verticals capability depth across CH and CEE, with a focus on AI/GenAI-led transformation opportunities
Identify and cultivate intersection points between partners, ISVs, and Distribution channels — creating multi-partner motions that combine delivery capability with ISV solutions and distributor reach to unlock new customer segments
Go-To-Market Development

Design and execute Joint Go-To-Market (JGTM) strategies with partners, including AI-powered solution development, market positioning, and data-driven demand generation campaigns
Enable partners to develop industry-specific and workload-specific solutions — with emphasis on GenAI use cases — that address customer needs in key verticals and segments across CH and CEE
Orchestrate tri-party GTM plays that bring together partners, ISVs, and Distributors — packaging ISV solutions with partner implementation services and leveraging distribution networks to scale across CH and CEE markets
Coordinate with internal field sales teams to ensure seamless partner collaboration on customer opportunities, using AI tooling to surface joint pipeline insights and drive outcomes faster
Partner Capability Development

Assess partner technical capabilities and create development roadmaps to build competencies in priority areas: Migration, Modernization, GenAI, AI/ML, and industry solutions
Support partners in building repeatable AI-infused practices, accelerators, and IP that differentiate their offerings and unlock new customer value
Champion AI fluency within the partner ecosystem — helping partners upskill their teams to lead AI-first customer conversations and solution design
Enable partners to build delivery practices around key ISV platforms on AWS, creating scalable solution bundles that distributors can take to market across CH and CEE's diverse sub-regions
Business Planning & Execution

Develop annual and quarterly business plans and reviews with quantifiable goals for revenue, pipeline, certifications, and customer outcomes — using AI analytics to track performance and dynamically adjust strategy
Manage partner funding requests and investments, ensuring ROI and alignment with business objectives — including joint investments that span partner, ISV, and Distribution ecosystems
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, solutions architecture, professional services) and adjacent partner teams (ISV PDMs, Distribution PDMs) to deliver integrated partner success across CH and CEE
Ecosystem & Program Leadership

Contribute to the development of regional partner programs, playbooks, and best practices for the EMEA Central region, embedding AI-first methodologies into partner engagement frameworks
Drive the convergence of partner, ISV, and Distribution ecosystems in CH and CEE — building repeatable models where distribution amplifies partner+ISV solutions to reach mid-market and SMB customers at scale
Share insights and learnings across the broader PDM community to drive continuous improvement, including how AI tools and multi-partner ecosystem plays can scale partner management effectiveness

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic relationship building, collaborative planning, and technology innovation. You'll engage with system integrator partners, design breakthrough partnership strategies, and translate complex technological visions into actionable business plans. You'll leverage data and analytics to track performance across multiple dimensions: segments, verticals, horizontals and collaborate with various teams. Working backwards from partner business models, you'll help them understand how to maximize their AWS revenue streams and open new ones.

About the team
You will join the EMEA Central Partner Organization, a high-performing team responsible for driving partner success across Germany, ALPS (Austria, Switzerland), and CEE markets. Our team is focused on scaling partner-led growth, developing innovative go-to-market strategies, and building the capabilities that enable partners to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You will work closely with field sales, solutions architects, marketing, and partner sales teams to drive results.

Reporting Structure: This role reports to the Partner Development Manager Lead for EMEA Central.

- Sales/

Preferred qualifications

- German Language
- AI Fluency

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. - Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Risk Manager, People Protection, SOG ; People Protection
descriptionHtml:
You will oversee the deployment and validation of protective controls for Amazon personnel across Worldwide Operations Security. Global Risk & Resilience (R&R) determines which controls are needed; you ensure those controls get deployed and function as intended. You build the operational scaffolding that empowers Field Security & Loss Prevention (SLP) teams and partner SOG teams to execute controls independently, without friction.
You will author playbooks, validate control performance through testing and after-action review, and operate feedback loops that drive continuous improvement. When possible, you enable field teams to execute; when necessary, you execute directly. You are building something new from the ground up.


Key job responsibilities
- Deploy protective controls directly when required, both onsite and offsite, across Under the Roof (UTR) and Over the Road (OTR) environments
- Receive control requirements from Global Risk & Resilience (R&R) and translate them into rapid deployment plans across threat types, geographies, and operational contexts
- Validate that deployed controls function as intended through regular testing, real-world observation, and after-action review
- Identify gaps between intended and actual control performance; drive corrective actions with field teams
- Enable field-facing teams to deploy controls independently when possible, providing the tools and guidance to do so effectively
- Author user guides, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for field-facing teams to execute protective measures independently
- Build deployment playbooks that help field SLP and partner teams execute controls rapidly when directed — minimizing time from notification to protection in place
- Establish clear escalation criteria — defining when field teams execute independently vs. when People Protection provides direct support
- Operate feedback mechanisms to capture real-world control performance data from field execution
- Translate field insights into framework updates, guide revisions, and control enhancements
- Provide structured reporting on control efficacy to People Protection leadership and stakeholders
- Work closely with Global Risk & Resilience (R&R) to enable partner SOG teams worldwide
- Partner with Field SLP leadership to ensure frameworks align with operational realities and resource constraints
- Support training and readiness initiatives to build field team confidence in executing protective controls


A day in the life

Your morning starts with a strategic question: how do we take a protective capability that works for ten sites and make it work for a thousand? After lunch, you design the enablement model that will let Field SLP teams globally execute controls without needing your team in the loop for every case. You are building the playbooks, escalation logic, and feedback mechanisms that make People Protection a platform — not a bottleneck. When you step into an active case, it is to validate that the system you are building actually works under pressure, and to capture the lessons that improve the next iteration. You balance long-term architecture with near-term execution, always asking: will this still work at 10x the volume?

Want to build the memory layer that gives AI agents the ability to learn, remember, and get smarter over time? Come lead engineers on the team building AgentCore Memory, the managed service that lets developers give their AI agents persistent, secure, and intelligent long-term and short-term memory at scale.

AgentCore Memory is at the heart of the agentic AI revolution. Every meaningful agent experience that remembers customer preferences, recalls past conversations, and improves with every interaction, depends on a memory system that is fast, durable, and secure. As a Software Development Manager for the team, you will own a mission-critical service that thousands of builders rely on to bring stateful, context-aware AI agents to life.

help drive the technical direction and roadmap for a system that blends large-scale distributed systems with cutting-edge generative AI, using Amazon Bedrock to power memory extraction and consolidation. You will be accountable for operational excellence across multiple AWS regions, meeting demanding availability, latency, and security bars for a service customers depend on every day. Along the way, you will partner closely with product, science, and cross-functional engineering teams to define what agent memory should be, while coaching and developing engineers, hiring top talent, and cultivating an inclusive, high-performing team culture.

title: Sr. Business Development Manager, Storage (Data Foundations), WWSO Data APJC
descriptionHtml:
Are you a storage expert who can build and scale the go-to-market for one of AWS's highest-growth portfolios across Australia and New Zealand? Do you have the technical depth in cloud storage, data transfer, and migration, combined with business development instincts to drive our largest, most complex migration deals and build the motions that scale wins across the region? Do you love building strategic, data-driven businesses and helping customers get their data foundations ready for the AI era? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Data & AI team as a Sr. Business Development Manager for Storage, based in Sydney and focused on data foundations across ANZ.

This role builds and scales the AWS storage go-to-market across ANZ, owning the strategy and execution that helps customers modernise their data foundations to be ready for AI and agentic workloads. Storage is the foundation of every large migration and every AI workload from training data, model artifacts, inference pipelines, and the data lakes that power analytics. Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences; every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it. You will be across all the top migration deals in ANZ ensuring storage is scoped, sized, and funded from day one, spanning S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, Backup, DataSync, Transfer Family, Snow Family, and Storage Gateway, and the networking and data transfer (DTO) that makes large migrations possible. You are accountable for the growth of the ANZ storage business. You will also be the voice of ANZ back to the service team, carrying customer needs to our storage service teams to help reshape service and roadmap strategy.

Key job responsibilities
- GTM for storage and data foundations across ANZ — strategy, messaging, positioning, and campaigns across all segments
- Be across all the top deals — ensure storage is scoped, sized, and funded from day one; own storage sizing, data transfer planning (DTO), and migration sequencing on the largest, most complex opportunities
- Drive storage pipeline and revenue — activate growth levers including workload placement, data migration, tiering optimisation, and AI-driven consumption
- Build scalable GTM motions — playbooks, ROI models, and partner enablement that multiply impact beyond one-to-one deals
- Drive the "storage as the foundation for AI" narrative
- Be the voice of ANZ to the storage service teams, feeding customer needs and competitive gaps back to product leadership

A day in the life
One morning you're modelling the data transfer economics for a large enterprise migration across Direct Connect and DataSync; midday you're in a CxO briefing positioning S3 as the data lake foundation for an AI initiative and making sure storage is funded in the deal. The afternoon you're building a partner-led storage assessment motion with an SI, reviewing migration pipeline with the ANZ area team, and feeding a feature gap back to the WW Storage service team. You operate across ANZ and every segment, building the strategy and executing it.

About the team
The WWSO Data & AI team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. We are technology specialists. This role sits on the APJ Data GTM team as the ANZ storage and data-foundations lead, working as an integrated unit with the Database and Analytics teams, account teams, Specialist SAs, and partner teams. Storage is one of the fastest-growing domains in our data portfolio driven by AI consumption, data lake expansion, and large migrations and it can never be an afterthought in a data or AI deal. We value individuals who combine deep technical knowledge with GTM business acumen: people who can size a multi-petabyte migration AND build the business case that funds it. title: Software Development Engineer, AWS - Amazon EKS
descriptionHtml:
Join the Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) Control Plane team that manage the entire EKS fleet globally. We own the path from a customer's intent to a running cluster: the EKS API that accepts the request, the regional services that hold every cluster's desired state and orchestrate its lifecycle, the services that provision and repair the infrastructure that state describes, and the Kubernetes control plane that runs on it. We also own the availability commitment customers hold us to. And we own knowing what state every cluster is in: the health detection that catches a cluster broken by a change to the resources it depends on, the insights that tell a customer what will break before they upgrade, and the operational signals we stream back to them.

Amazon EKS now supports Kubernetes version rollback, which we built to enable customers mitigate operational risk with in place updates; customers can update normally and watch the new version carry production traffic, and rollback within 7 days if it does not hold, with their cluster state, workloads, and volumes untouched. We also made the control plane resilient to Availability Zone issues with no customer action, which turned a single zonal impairment into a non-event. We run all of this for every EKS cluster across all commercial AWS Regions and AWS GovCloud, and on customer premises through AWS Outposts.

Innovation takes a village, and this team is the catalyst for it. Other EKS teams launch on our API and lifecycle services. AWS partner services like Amazon GuardDuty build customer-facing security features integrating with services we own. We also own the EKS Model Context Protocol server and the AI capabilities that enable how agents work with EKS.

This is an opportunity to operate and engineer distributed systems at scale, and to own the availability and resiliency of a service customers run their production workloads on. You will provide technical leadership and influence strategies to delight our customers. You will be solving challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, alongside peers with remarkable technical expertise. The solutions you build will be high impact and rolled out to our large customer base across the world. If you are excited to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment to deliver results, we would love to hear from you!

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don't get paged for the same issue again.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

The Business Manager will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Quality, Operations, and CM stakeholders to ensure manufacturing plans are executed with the right cost structure, business terms, capacity readiness, and delivery discipline.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in consumer electronics, supplier management, contract manufacturing, cost analysis, and cross-functional program execution. This person should be comfortable working through ambiguity, managing detailed business operations, and escalating risks with clear recommendations. They should bring strong ownership, structured thinking, analytical capability, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders through data, business judgment, and clear communication.

Key job responsibilities
Contract Manufacturer Business Ownership
- Own day-to-day business management execution for a dedicated Contract Manufacturer, serving as the primary business interface between Ring and the CM.
- Manage CM business operations across NPI, launch, and sustaining programs, ensuring alignment on cost, schedule, capacity, commercial terms, and execution readiness.
- Build strong working relationships with CM counterparts to drive accountability, transparency, and timely issue resolution.
- Support the CM Business Team Manager in executing broader CM strategy, supplier governance, and portfolio-level business priorities.

NPI and Sustaining Program Execution
- Partner with Product, Engineering, TPM, Supply Chain, Finance, Quality, and Operations teams to support program execution from concept through launch and sustaining production.
- Drive CM readiness tracking, business milestone alignment, RFQ execution, cost reviews, capacity planning, and launch support.
- Identify execution gaps, business risks, and decision blockers early, and provide clear escalation paths with recommended actions.
- Ensure CM commitments are clearly documented, tracked, and delivered against agreed timelines.

Cost, Commercial, and Contract Management
- Support commercial negotiations with the CM, including cost, payment terms, business terms, tooling, NRE, capacity, and other manufacturing-related agreements.
- Analyze CM quotations, cost breakdowns, MVA, tooling, E&F, and other commercial inputs to identify gaps, opportunities, and negotiation levers.
- Drive cost reduction initiatives, cost benchmarking, and supplier accountability to support Ring’s cost competitiveness.
- Partner with Finance and cross-functional teams to validate business cases, cost assumptions, and financial impact.

Supplier Performance and Risk Management
- Monitor CM performance across cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, execution discipline, and overall business partnership.
- Track risks related to manufacturing readiness, capacity, material availability, business terms, regional footprint, and launch execution.
- Work with internal teams and CM partners to define mitigation plans and drive follow-through.
- Support regular supplier performance reviews, business reviews, and operating mechanisms.

Cross-Functional Communication and Influence
- Prepare clear business updates, decision summaries, RFQ analysis, cost review materials, and escalation documents for leadership review.
- Translate complex program, cost, and supplier issues into structured recommendations and actionable next steps.
- Influence internal stakeholders and CM partners through data-driven insights, strong business logic, and practical execution plans.
- Maintain strong communication rhythm across global teams to ensure alignment and timely decision-making.

Process Improvement and Operational Discipline
- Identify opportunities to improve CM management mechanisms, reporting, cost tracking, risk visibility, and decision-making processes.
- Maintain accurate documentation of CM agreements/SoW, business decisions, cost assumptions, and action items.
- Adopt scalable tools, dashboards, and working mechanisms to improve operational efficiency and transparency.
- Contribute to continuous improvement across the broader Business Management function.

About the team
Ring and Blink are committed to making neighborhoods safer by delivering accessible, reliable, and innovative home security products to customers around the world. The Supply Chain and Operations team plays a critical role in bringing this mission to life by supporting the business from product concept and development through NPI, launch, and sustaining operations.

Within this organization, the Business Management team serves as the key business interface between Ring/Blink and our global manufacturing partners. The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Quality, Operations, and Contract Manufacturers to ensure the right manufacturing strategy, cost structure, supplier partnerships, and execution plans are in place to support Ring’s product roadmap.

In this role, you will own the business execution for a dedicated CM and help solve practical, complex supply chain and manufacturing business challenges. You will work closely with teammates and cross-functional partners across regions to ensure Ring and Blink products can be launched and scaled with speed, quality, cost competitiveness, and operational discipline.

This is a fast-moving and highly cross-functional team where ownership, structured thinking, attention to detail, and strong stakeholder management are essential. The work directly impacts our ability to deliver trusted products to customers and advance Ring and Blink’s mission of making neighborhoods safer.

- Experience in business development, direct technology services sales, partnership management, or sourcing new business

title: Data Center Technician , DCC Communities
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members

Physical Requirements:
- Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in an industrial environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
- This role supports data centers in various o perational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:

- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
- Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
- Improve effectiveness through process innovation
You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting experience, or experience related IT
- 2+ years of computer layer 1/2 networking (including troubleshooting and repair) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of network design, protocols and troubleshooting
- Knowledge of Linux/Unix Administration
- Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
- Experience training and onboarding of new team members

title: Principal Solutions Architect, Bedrock Customer Success - AWS Mantle
descriptionHtml:
Are you a strategic technical leader who measures success by the measurable business outcomes your customers achieve? We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect within our Customer Success organization to serve as the trusted technical advisor to our most strategic enterprise customers adopting generative AI inference at scale through AWS Mantle and Amazon Bedrock. In this role, you will own the post-sales customer journey end-to-end—from initial adoption through production optimization and value realization—driving clarity in high-ambiguity environments where customers' AI strategies, operating models, and success criteria may not yet be defined. You will work backwards from customer outcomes to architect solutions, remove adoption barriers, and ensure customers achieve transformational business results.

Serve as the primary strategic technical advisor to customers' senior and executive stakeholders, shaping their long-term AI inference strategies and guiding them from proof-of-concept through production at scale on AWS Mantle
Own customer transformation health end-to-end—proactively identifying adoption barriers, architecting solutions to overcome them, and driving measurable value realization (latency improvements, cost optimization, time-to-production)
Operate with complete independence in deeply ambiguous engagements where the customer's business objectives, technology strategy, and success criteria are not yet defined—driving clarity and creating the path forward
Influence AWS product and engineering roadmaps by synthesizing customer feedback patterns, articulating unmet needs, and championing the customer perspective with internal leadership
Establish scalable customer success methodologies, frameworks, and playbooks that accelerate adoption of Mantle's inference capabilities across the broader customer base

Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Solutions Architect on the Customer Success side of Mantle, you will be the connective tissue between our customers' most ambitious generative AI goals and the production-ready reality of operating AI inference at enterprise scale. Your success is measured not by designs delivered, but by customer outcomes achieved—production workloads launched, performance targets met, and business value realized.
Own structured success planning for strategic customer accounts, including executive business reviews, adoption milestones, and proactive health monitoring to ensure customers achieve their AI inference goals on Mantle and Amazon Bedrock
Architect production-ready inference solutions leveraging Mantle's distributed engine, Zero Operator Access security model, and OpenAI-compatible APIs—optimizing for customer-specific requirements around latency, throughput, cost, and compliance
Lead deep-dive technical engagements to resolve complex production challenges, including model performance tuning, capacity planning, multi-region deployment strategies, and integration patterns with customers' existing ML pipelines
Gather, decompose, and prioritize customer feedback across many accounts and use cases—translating pain points into actionable product roadmap inputs for Mantle engineering teams, including PR/FAQ creation and feature prioritization influence
Create and evangelize reference architectures, best practices, and reusable patterns for AI inference at scale; lead workshops, publish technical content, and mentor other Solutions Architects to raise the bar across the Customer Success organization


About the team
The AWS Mantle Customer Success team ensures that enterprise customers successfully adopt, scale, and realize measurable business value from generative AI inference on Amazon Bedrock. We sit at the intersection of our customers' ambitions and Mantle's technical capabilities—working backwards from business outcomes to deliver production-ready AI solutions. Our Zero Operator Access architecture means customers can trust that no person—whether from AWS, a customer, or a model provider—can ever access their inference data, and we help them understand and operationalize that trust in their environments.
We are customer-obsessed, measuring our success by production workloads launched, adoption velocity, and quantifiable business impact our customers achieve
We partner deeply with Mantle engineering, product, and go-to-market teams—serving as the voice of the customer and driving feedback loops that shape the platform's evolution
We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where diverse perspectives drive better customer outcomes—and where creative problem-solving is valued over rigid process
We support customers across industries adopting models from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Google, Mistral, NVIDIA, and more—each with unique scale, compliance, and performance requirements
We believe the best customer experiences come from teams that are curious, empathetic, and relentless about removing friction from the path between ambition and production

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

The ideal candidate is an owner with strong business judgment, exceptional written communication, a bias for building mechanisms that scale, and the ability to align cross-functional teams and drive work to closure.

Key job responsibilities
Owning and running the monthly goal review mechanisms for the organization. This includes preparing and coordinating goal status inputs, driving the standard reporting format, managing the review calendar, and ensuring leaders have a clear, accurate view of progress ahead of each review.

Leading the operating cadence of business reviews across the team and organization, including the Weekly Business Review (WBR) and other cross-business reviews. This involves coordinating content owners, managing deck preparation, and setting and enforcing corrections and submission deadlines so content is decision-ready.

Managing the headcount planning process end to end. This includes operating plan cycles, top-down and bottom-up alignment, and partnering with finance and headcount POCs on artifacts, and timelines.

Serving as the connective tissue between leadership, business operations, finance, and functional teams, translating leadership priorities into clear operating mechanisms and following up to closure on action items and decisions.

Identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate recurring reporting, reducing manual effort and cycle times while improving quality and consistency.

Communicating clearly to a range of stakeholders and executives through high-quality narratives, executive summaries, and review documents that make the story clear for a senior audience.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with the teams and leaders responsible for planning and delivering data center capacity. You will prioritize the activities that are most impactful to the operating rhythm and to leadership visibility.

Start your morning finalizing the inputs for an upcoming monthly goal review.
Reconcile a set of WBR corrections against a deadline.
Partner with finance on a headcount comparison for the next planning cycle.
Edit a leadership narrative before it goes out.
Move between the details of a spreadsheet and a room with senior leaders, trusted to run the mechanism so leaders can focus on the decisions.

About the team
Join the AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery team, where we are not just building data centers, we are architecting the future of cloud computing. You will join a tight-knit business operations function supporting AMER Capacity Delivery. We value ownership, clear writing, and mechanisms that scale. This role works across the organization and with partner teams, giving you broad visibility into how AWS plans and delivers data center capacity.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Preferred qualifications

title: Injury Prevention Specialist
descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

title: Creative Strategist, PV Brand Partnership Studio
descriptionHtml:
The PV Brand Partnerships Studio creates the deepest brand-content integrations in streaming — custom programs that connect advertisers to Prime Video's premium IP at the highest investment tier. The Creative Strategist is the qualification and creative gateway for all custom brand partnerships entering the Studio pipeline.

You will guide brands on how to leverage Prime Video's content slate, talent, and streaming technology to reach audiences in a meaningful way. You'll respond to client briefs with compelling proposals that serve the brand's needs while leveraging the best of Prime Video's IP, products, and premiere calendar. You'll also develop proactive packages against upcoming titles — identifying which brands belong against which content before the brief arrives.

This role sits at the intersection of pre-sales and creative. You are not producing campaigns — you are deciding which campaigns get produced, and shaping the creative strategy that wins them.

Key job responsibilities
You will qualify inbound briefs against defined criteria (win probability, budget confirmation, title-brand alignment, timeline feasibility) and route demand to the correct tier.

You will respond to qualified client RFPs with compelling proposals that connect brand objectives to Prime Video IP, talent, and audience.

You will attend client meetings, pitches, and collaborative work sessions to translate, and educate, PV Brand Partnerships to customers and media agencies.

You will develop proactive title packages, identifying advertiser vertical needs and content opportunities before demand arrives.

You will conceptualize campaigns in a fast-paced, collaborative environment while managing multiple projects with multiple stakeholders across Sales, GTM, Studios, and Production.

You will articulate high-concept ideas and proposals to sellers, media agencies, and clients to ensure they're effectively communicated and creatively differentiated.

You will serve as the strategic bridge between the sales organization and the creative team — protecting Studio capacity while maximizing pipeline quality and win rates. You will ensure that all concepts delivered meet Amazon's bar-raising standard. You will work hard, have fun, and make history.


A day in the life
Creative: You lead strategic creative development sessions for qualified briefs, guide cross-functional teams through innovative program design, and champion breakthrough ideas from concept through pitch.

Qualification & Routing: You assess incoming demand against the qualification gate, make binding go/no-go decisions on which briefs enter the custom pipeline, and redirect non-qualifying demand to appropriate tiers with clear rationale.

Data-Driven Approach: You analyze title performance data, audience signals, and campaign history to inform creative recommendations and brand-title matching decisions.

Proactive Development: You build title packages against the upcoming slate before briefs arrive — connecting IP, audience data, and brand category fit into pitchable creative platforms.

Stakeholder Management: You navigate conversations with internal teams (Sales, GTM, Studios, Production) and external clients, build consensus across diverse groups, and maintain strong relationships with key partners.

AI Fluency: You integrate AI tools into your creative workflow, explore emerging capabilities to enhance campaign development, and advocate for AI-driven innovation in the pre-sales process.

Strategic Influence: You pitch creative concepts to senior leaders and clients, refine ideas based on feedback, and drive teams to execute against your strategic vision.

About the team
The BIL PV BPS team focuses on Prime Video IP and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience with end-to-end project management
- Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
- 5+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
- Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
- Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
- Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
