descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about building autonomous AI systems that operate in high-stakes financial domains? Do you want to design multi-agent solutions where precision and trust are non-negotiable? If so, we'd love to talk with you.
Amazon processes massive volumes of financial agreements with partners worldwide. Our team owns critical systems in this financial lifecycle, ensuring accuracy at scale. We've built an autonomous multi-agent AI system that's transforming how we manage financial operations — and we're just getting started.
We're now pushing the boundaries of what agentic AI can do in production: building systems that go beyond predefined workflows to intelligently adapt and improve over time. Our AI agents run complex financial workflows, producing structured outputs with evidence that human reviewers validate. If you're passionate about building autonomous AI where accuracy is a business requirement — not just a metric — this is the role for you.

What You'll Build
You'll design and deliver systems at the intersection of AI/ML and FinTech, working on problems that directly impact profitability at Amazon scale. You'll leverage Amazon's advanced agentic AI infrastructure to build autonomous systems that process real financial data in production.
You'll contribute to products that span:
- Multi-agent AI architectures with orchestrators, specialized agents, and shared knowledge bases
- Distributed systems processing millions of financial transactions and communications annually
- Financial products where accuracy, auditability, and compliance are non-negotiable
- Full-stack solutions from data pipelines to user interfaces
- Evaluation and testing frameworks for AI agents at production scale
The ideal candidate will have strong software development experience, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and a passion for building reliable, scalable AI systems. We look for engineers who are great communicators, self-motivated, and excited about pushing the boundaries of what autonomous AI can do in production.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build complex systems that solve ambiguous business problems, decomposing them into components that teams can build in parallel
- Contribute to technical decision-making for your team, taking ownership of system architecture and providing system-wide design guidance
- Build AI systems with precision constraints, designing workflows, thresholds, and success metrics optimized for domains where errors are expensive
- Mentor and influence engineers across your team and organization, raising the bar for engineering excellence
- Drive innovation in autonomous AI systems and evaluation frameworks
- Own operational excellence for production systems, proactively identifying and fixing risks
- Partner cross-functionally with finance, product, and engineering teams to deliver customer-obsessed solutions

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior IT Auditor, AWS Internal Audit
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth, and that includes protecting our customers and their data. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Do you have a passion for architecture, security, software design and innovative technologies? Do you see security, compliance and risk management as business enablers?

Amazon’s Internal Audit team is seeking a technology auditor to perform assessments of Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will have the rare opportunity to dive deep into the internal architecture of AWS infrastructure and services to assess operational risks and security posture.

This position will challenge your current understanding of AWS services. You will have a broad technical background and the ability to learn new technology concepts quickly. You are someone who is curious and known for diving deep into subject matter, taking ownership, and encouraging innovative and pragmatic solutions to complex problems. In addition, you will have solid business judgment, enthusiasm for risk management, the ability to gain trust and respect of business leaders, and the capability to guide a fast-paced organization to the right results.

Up to 10% travel may be required, including international travel.

Key job responsibilities
- The ideal candidate is an experienced technology or security professional who can dive deep into a variety of complex architectures, identify risks and ensure AWS services are designed and operating securely.
- You will support the planning, scoping, execution, and reporting based on identified risks. Assessment scope may include identity and access management, key management, data security/privacy, service monitoring, release management, and service availability.
- You will bring independent and objective points of view to provide support to service teams and their partners to identify opportunities for control improvements to mitigate risks, ensure compliance and improve operational performance. In this capacity, you will gain valuable exposure to many areas of our global business.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 5+ years of experience in roles involving technology and commercial acumen, finance/tech business partnering, IT audit, risk management, information security, or related fields.
- Experience assessing technology risks in business-critical systems or processes.

Preferred qualifications

- Understanding of control frameworks (e.g., COSO, COBIT, ISO, NIST), with a pragmatic approach to applying them.
- 7+ years of experience in IT audit, risk management, information security, technology consulting, or related fields.
- Experience working in or auditing technology-driven businesses (e.g., platforms, data systems, consumer products).
- Familiarity with modern technology environments (cloud, distributed systems, data platforms) sufficient to assess risk and challenge stakeholders.
- Experience with or exposure to AI/ML systems, including generative AI tools and platforms.
- Experience using data and analytics to support risk assessments or audits.
- Background in consulting, Big 4, or large technology companies.
- Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CIA, CPA, CISSP).

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

NOTE: This position requires the successful candidate report to a site location. This position is in-person and on-site. The candidate will work in an environment that operates 24/7.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data center
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- An Associate’s degree, technical certification, or equivalent professional or military experience in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, networking engineering, etc.)
- Understanding of network design, protocols and layer 1/2 troubleshooting

- Experience with the project management of technical projects

title: Public Policy Manager, EU, Amazon Brussels Public Policy Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's EU Public Policy team is looking for a Public Policy Manager to join its Brussels-based team. This role will drive Amazon's engagement with EU and national policymakers and stakeholders on a wide range of economic policy issues. The successful candidate brings established relationships with decision-makers in Brussels and EU member state capitals, and a proven track record as an effective advocate.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead Amazon's external engagement on EU policy files affecting Amazon's businesses, working independently with limited guidance.
- Build and maintain relationships with senior officials in EU institutions (European Commission, European Parliament, Council of the EU), national governments, and relevant trade and industry associations across a range of policy areas.
- Develop and execute advocacy strategies on legislative and non-legislative initiatives affecting Amazon's businesses, such as fiscal and customs frameworks, while also engaging on broader regulatory and economic policy developments relevant to our operations in Europe.
- Represent Amazon before external stakeholders and coalitions, serving as a credible and trusted advocate for Amazon's policy positions.
- Monitor, analyze, and translate complex policy developments into clear, actionable analysis and recommendations for senior Amazon leaders, ensuring visibility across the full spectrum of issues that impact our operations in Europe.
- Partner with legal, communications, compliance, and business teams to drive successful policy campaigns and ensure alignment on cross-business priorities.
- Contribute to team-wide mechanisms and best practices that improve the EU Public Policy team's effectiveness, scalability, and coordination across policy portfolios and the region.
- Play an active role in hiring and developing Public Policy talent within the overall public policy team in the region.

Basic qualifications

- Substantial experience in public affairs, lobbying, or government relations, including direct engagement with EU and national policymakers.
- Demonstrated track record of campaign development and execution influencing policy outcomes.
- Established network of senior-level contacts within EU institutions or member state governments, particularly across finance ministries, the EU Commission Directorate- General for Taxation and Customs Union (DG TAXUD), or trade bodies.
- Ability to operate independently on complex, ambiguous policy files where the problem, plan, or strategy is not predefined.
- Fluency in English (written and verbal); additional EU language an asset.
- Bachelor's degree in Political Science, Law, Public Policy, Economics, Law or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications

- Direct experience on EU or multilateral tax policy (e.g., digital services tax, Pillar Two, VATreform), customs regulation, or trade agreements.
- Familiarity with the legislative processes of the European Commission, Council, and Parliament on fiscal and trade matters.
- Experience working with or inside a global company's government affairs function.
- Ability to engage credibly with technical subject matter (e.g., legislative texts, regulatory filings) while keeping strategic advocacy objectives in focus

title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.

Key job responsibilities
* Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.
Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews.
* Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly.
Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
* Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.
Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.
Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits.
* Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.
Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.
Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.

About the team
We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
descriptionHtml:
UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization — establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act — protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale.

This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch.

- Improve the static stability of authentication — ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery.

- Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet.

- Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events.

- Own pipeline and release health for SDK components — keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy.

- Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews.

- Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Sr. Communication Systems Research Scientist – Radio Resource Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites providing low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. As a Communication Systems Research Scientist, this role owns the research and system design of the radio resource management (RRM) and radio access layers of Amazon Leo’s direct-to-device (D2D) system, delivering 3GPP-compliant service to unmodified commercial handsets.

The Role:
Be part of the team defining the communication system and architecture of Amazon’s direct-to-device wireless network and analyzing its system level performance: beam and cell capacity, spectral efficiency, coverage, latency and service availability. This is a unique opportunity to innovate with few legacy constraints, in a segment where the standard itself is still being written.

This role leads the research and system design of radio resource management (RRM) for a 3GPP Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN), where D2D upends terrestrial assumptions: a power-limited handset with a near-isotropic antenna, very large cells, hopping beams, large time-varying delay and Doppler, and scarce shared spectrum. RRM in time, frequency and spatial domains is the focus, but the role reasons across the stack, from L1/L2 up through RRC, NAS and 5GC interworking. Agentic AI is expected to be a standard part of the work for development, optimization, tests and debugging, with the scientist accountable for the algorithms, models and conclusions.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Research, design and specify RRM algorithms for Amazon Leo’s 3GPP-based D2D system: MAC scheduling, link adaptation, power control, HARQ strategy, DRX, admission and congestion control, and load balancing, mapping 5QI and QoS flow requirements to scheduler behavior across voice, messaging, emergency and data services.
• Treat beam management as part of joint resource optimization, not a standalone process, optimizing it with band assignment, packet scheduling and user pairing in multi-user MIMO (MU-MIMO).
• Define the RRM framework for NTN conditions: earth-fixed and earth-moving cells, large time-varying propagation delay, ephemeris-assisted timing and Doppler pre-compensation, extended timing advance, selective HARQ feedback disabling, feeder link and satellite handovers, and interference and spectrum sharing across beams, satellites and terrestrial networks using the same MNO spectrum.
• Design mobility and service continuity for a network where the base stations (i.e., satellites) move rather than the user: idle and connected mode mobility, location and time based conditional handover, cell reselection, paging, tracking area design, and NTN-to-terrestrial continuity.
• Specify supporting L1/L2 elements with the PHY team: numerology under Doppler, PRACH and initial access, coverage enhancement through repetition, synchronization at low SNR, receiver abstraction, and FEC and BLER modeling for link adaptation.
• Keep the radio design coherent with the networking layers: RRC and NAS, RLC and PDCP over long-RTT links, CU/DU split, NTN gateway and 5GC/EPC integration, and transport behavior.
• Develop link-level and system-level simulators capturing constellation dynamics, beam patterns, handset characteristics, traffic models and RRM behavior, and use agentic AI across that loop: build and refactor simulation code, scale parameter sweeps, optimize scheduler and link adaptation parameters, explore configuration spaces too large to sweep by hand, maintain regression tests, and triage failures across logs, traces and over-the-air captures.
• Translate research into system requirements and implementation-level specifications, and work with modem, payload, ground, RF, ASIC and Testbed teams through integration, field trials and link bring-up, root-causing gaps between simulation, implementation and over-the-air behavior in a fast-paced environment.
• Represent Amazon Leo in 3GPP and other standards development organizations, develop and defend contributions on NTN and D2D work items, and contribute patents and publications.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, or experience working in electrical engineering field
- 7+ years professional experience working in wireless communications at the system or implementation level
- Demonstrated experience in radio resource management for 3GPP systems (LTE, 5G NR or NTN): MAC scheduling, link adaptation, power control, HARQ, mobility or QoS
- Experience developing and running link-level or system-level wireless simulators in Matlab, Python or C++, using agentic AI as a tool for development, test and debugging

Preferred qualifications

- PhD with emphasis in wireless communication systems, radio resource management, or network optimization. Strong foundations in algorithm development, optimization techniques, queueing theory, communications theory and machine learning.
- Deep understanding of 3GPP radio resource management: MAC scheduler design, AMC and outer loop link adaptation, open and closed loop power control, HARQ and RLC ARQ interaction, DRX, bandwidth part management, measurement and mobility procedures, and multiple access systems such as OFDMA, SC-FDMA and TDMA.
- Expertise in multi-antenna and beam-domain resource allocation: beam assignment and spatial scheduling, beam coloring and reuse planning, beam measurement, switching and handover, MU-MIMO user pairing, and optimization or machine learning applied to joint allocation.
- Experience in the development and standardization of 3GPP technologies such as LTE, 5G NR, NB-IoT and NTN, including the Rel-17 through Rel-19 NTN and D2D work items, contributions in RAN1 through RAN4, and a track record of publications or patents.
- Experience with direct-to-device or mobile satellite service systems, including the link budget and capacity consequences of a low-gain handset antenna in L/S band MSS or shared MNO spectrum.
- Deep understanding of modem L1/L2 algorithms, QoS in packet based wireless systems, and end-to-end architecture from the physical layer to the application end-point, including RRC, NAS, 5GC/EPC and transport over high-latency links.
- Depth in simulator design: traffic modeling, PHY abstraction, large-scale Monte Carlo evaluation, calibration against field or testbed measurements, and agentic AI used to scale sweeps, maintain regression coverage and triage failures; familiarity with optimization, queueing theory or machine learning applied to resource allocation.
- Ideal candidate has depth in radio resource management and the MAC/RRC layers, a passion for building carrier-grade communication systems, a habit of using agentic AI without giving up rigor, and the ability to work in a small team and lead technical initiatives.

title: Head of NAMER Partner Sales Strategy, AWS Partner Sales
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Head of NAMER Partner Sales Strategy to serve as the strategic partner to the Director of NAMER Partner Sales. This role designs and evolves the Geo-level GTM execution framework across Deep, Focus, Scale, and Indirect partner engagement motions. You will operate at Geo scale across all NAMER divisions and partner development functions, anticipate organizational evolution, identify structural gaps before they create execution friction, and work with Partner & Field Sales Operations to operationalize strategic frameworks. This is a high-impact strategic position with influence across all partner sales divisions, AMER partner sales and development leadership, and field sales organizations.


Key job responsibilities
Operating Model Design & Evolution
You will design and evolve the GTM framework that governs how NAMER partner sales operates. This includes coverage models, sales play architecture, inspection cadences, and the mechanisms that translate strategy into PSL execution. You will stress-test the operating model against organizational priorities, identify drift patterns, and propose structural changes when the model no longer serves NAMER's growth objectives. You will work with divisional Partner Sales Leaders to ensure clarity on role boundaries, inspection logic, and escalation thresholds. Your work here sets the standard for how partner sales operates across the Geo.

Critical Inputs to NAMER Inspection Cadences
You will generate the strategic analytics and performance signals that inform all NAMER inspection cadences, including WBR, IPMM, MBR, Top Deals, MFR, and Forecast. For each cadence, you will prepare decision-ready briefs that surface the information leadership needs to govern and make course corrections. You will work with Sales Operations to ensure cadence logistics run smoothly while maintaining focus on the business signals that matter. Your analytical work will enable faster, more rigorous leadership decision-making.

Cross-Functional Accountability & Governance
You will work with AMER Partner Development (Consulting and Technology) leadership to ensure shared accountability with Geo and Division revenue outcomes. You will drive partner development investment aligned to NAMER division needs, support partner business/geo account and territory planning, influence top-of-funnel pipeline campaign builds and execution, govern partner-first and partner-led sales motion interlock with field sales leadership, and ensure cross-organizational escalation accountability to remove deal blockers and accelerate win rates.

Cross-Functional Goal Design & Cascade
You will influence quota methodology, partner-attached goal design (including field sales cascade), and compensation frameworks that align PSM and field seller behavior with partner-led growth strategy. Partner Sales Operations owns execution of partner sales goal setting and cadence. You will work with Partner Sales Operations and Field Sales Operations to design the logic of how NAMER goals cascade into division expectations and how partner-attach expectations flow to field sellers who do not have direct PSM coverage. Your work here ensures that partner-led growth becomes a structural expectation of the entire field sales organization, not just a PSM responsibility.

Data Governance & Analytics Infrastructure
You will define pipeline standards, funnel definitions, forecasting methodology, and KPIs that enable faster, data-driven leadership decision-making across NAMER. You will establish what constitutes qualified partner pipeline, what stage progression signals mean, and what metrics tell leadership whether a partner motion is working at scale. You will work with Sales Operations to translate these definitions into operational reality and with divisional leaders to ensure consistent application.

Revenue Operations Partnership
You will partner with Sales Operations to operationalize strategic frameworks. You set strategic requirements and performance standards; Sales Operations executes and maintains operational responsibility for cadence logistics, data governance, and systems integrity. The two functions operate as a flywheel to ensure strategy turns into measurable execution and can be continually improved.

About the team
AWS Partner Sales is the team responsible for driving partner-led revenue across AWS's largest and most complex enterprise customers. We operate at the intersection of enterprise sales, strategic alliances, and industry specialization—helping customers solve their most critical business challenges through the AWS partner ecosystem.

Our team members are trusted advisors who combine deep industry knowledge with executive selling skills and operational excellence. We champion a culture of customer obsession, ownership, and bias for action—and we believe the best outcomes emerge when AWS, partners, and customers work as one team toward shared goals.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

descriptionHtml:
Delivery Service Partners Capacity Manager – Japan (Based at HND21, Tokyo)

Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Japan is looking for a Delivery Service Partners (DSP) Capacity Manager to lead capacity execution across the entire country. This is a high-impact role that plays a key part in ensuring we deliver on our customer promise while optimizing our nationwide delivery network. With end-to-end responsibility for Japan, this role offers significant leadership exposure, strategic influence, and the opportunity to shape the future of Amazon’s last-mile logistics.

As the DSP Capacity Manager, you will own and drive capacity execution at the national level, ensuring we have the right resources in place to support our expanding delivery operations. You will work cross-functionally with key teams—including OTR, Stations, Finance, Central Operations, Fleet, Amflex, ACES and SnOP team —to identify opportunities, improve processes, and drive efficiency across our network.

This role requires someone comfortable working in an ambiguous and fast-moving environment, capable of making data-driven decisions, and confident in collaborating with senior AMZL leaders. You will analyze complex datasets, translate insights into actionable strategies, and provide updates to senior leadership. With significant responsibility and direct exposure to leadership teams, this is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Amazon’s delivery network in Japan.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead DSP capacity execution across all of Japan, ensuring scalability and operational efficiency.
- Optimize short-term, mid-term, and long-term capacity planning, aligning network resources with delivery demand.
- Analyze complex data and generate insights that drive strategic decision-making.
- Collaborate with key stakeholders across OTR, Stations, Finance, Central Operations, Fleet, Amflex, SnOP, ACES and WW Central Planning.
- Drive improvements in capacity management by identifying bottlenecks and implementing data-driven solutions.
- Engage with senior AMZL leaders, providing updates and recommendations on capacity planning.
- Bring clarity to ambiguous situations, ensuring alignment across partner teams and leadership.

What You’ll Need to Succeed
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to break down complex problems and identify practical solutions.
- Experience managing cross-functional projects and working with senior stakeholders.
- A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and drive clarity from ambiguity.
- Strong communication skills, with confidence in reporting and presenting insights to leadership.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of last-mile logistics in Japan, ensuring we continue to delight our customers with fast, reliable deliveries. If you’re looking for a role where you can make a real impact and drive operational excellence at a national scale, we’d love to hear from you!

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

More Information
・Department: Last Mile (AMZL)
・Location: Tokyo Office


Key job responsibilities
• Owner of regional capacity cadences for Off Peak and Event Periods for all AMZN capacity workstreams.

• Removal of controllable barriers to capacity execution, through identifying risk and working with partner teams like DPM, Fleet Planning, CO, SNoP, PXT, Geospatial Partner Experience and Top of Funnel to mitigate and plan around risk.

There will need to be a constant focus on identifying barriers on things like like Fleet shortages, driver shortages or severe weather incidents. Ownership of this and providing visibility on how we overcome them within your peer group and to senior leadership will be a key part of your success.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Legal Department is looking for a talented technology lawyer to support Amazon Web Services (AWS) in selling to commercial and public sector customers throughout the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region, with a primary focus on supporting AWS sales in the United Kingdom and Northern Europe. AWS is at the forefront of the cloud computing industry, providing AI and IT infrastructure services, such as on-demand compute capacity, storage, content delivery, database services, and more to private and public sector customers.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for drafting, negotiating, and advising on strategic technology service agreements with enterprise customers, public sector customers, and partners, as well as providing legal support for local and regional services and initiatives. The role will also involve ongoing legal counsel and regulatory interpretation and guidance for senior executives and other business and legal team members on a variety of product development, operational, security, compliance, data protection and public policy matters. The role includes participating in other legal team projects, including managing legal issues that arise in existing relationships and handling customer and business partner inquiries.

We are looking for a candidate who is proactive, entrepreneurial, enjoys being challenged, has strong technology and communication skills, and demonstrates sound, pragmatic judgment in ambiguous situations.

This position is based in London, United Kingdom. Some regional and international travel will be required.


A day in the life
You will work with various teams within the AWS organisation. Our lawyers value working alongside and in person with their business colleagues and local legal teams to solve a constant flow of novel challenges in a growing and exciting business. AWS empowers millions of customers worldwide to build, innovate, and scale their businesses through our comprehensive cloud computing platform.

The role involves providing legal support to AWS's Sales and Marketing team (SMGS) in service of tech- and regulatory-savvy customers in the United Kingdom and Northern Europe across commercial and public sector engagements, covering a range of cloud and technology transactions with customers who are often highly knowledgeable about the technology they procure. Work extends beyond the UK to include transactional and regulatory support across EMEA, delivered through team work allocation and ad-hoc assignments in collaboration with colleagues across multiple jurisdictions.

Day-to-day activities may include negotiating enterprise agreements with UK and Northern European customers, advising on regulatory matters (including UK GDPR, the Online Safety Act, and sector-specific frameworks), coordinating with EMEA teammates on multi-country deal structures, and serving as lead counsel on strategic sales transactions and partnership agreements. You will also support UK public sector engagements, including Crown Commercial Service frameworks and G-Cloud procurements. You will pioneer AI-driven transformation of legal operations—improving contract review cycles, eliminating manual bottlenecks, and deploying advanced research tools that deliver insights in minutes instead of hours. Your innovations will multiply our legal function's impact, enabling faster decisions, consistency, and proactive risk mitigation.


About the team
The UK/Northern Europe AWS Legal team is part of the broader EMEA SMGS Legal organisation and consists of lawyers supporting AWS's regional customer base across commercial and public sector engagements. Based in London, the team advises on a wide range of cloud and technology transactions with some of AWS's most sophisticated customers, spanning financial services, healthcare, telecoms, and government. descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will develop rigorous methods to understand how traffic sources, customer journeys, and onsite experiences influence purchasing and revenue. You will use experimentation, causal inference, statistical analysis, and machine learning to distinguish correlation from true business impact and identify the drivers of performance changes. You will work with product, engineering, and business partners to translate complex findings into clear recommendations, design measurable interventions, and build tools that support faster diagnosis and better investment decisions. If you are energized by solving complex challenges at the intersection of AI and measurement science, we would love to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop methods to understand how traffic sources, customer journeys, and onsite experiences drive purchasing and revenue, using experimentation, causal inference, and machine learning to separate correlation from true business impact.
- Drive or heavily influence the design of scientifically complex software solutions or systems, taking ownership of components and providing system-wide design guidance for both new and evolving systems.
- Define a long-term science vision and roadmap, combining science leadership, technical depth, and business understanding.
- Translate complex findings into clear recommendations for product, engineering, and business partners, and build tools that support faster diagnosis and better investment decisions.

descriptionHtml:

• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.

• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.

A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.

Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.

Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.

End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

title: Quality Engineer I, Amazon Manufacturing Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Manufacturing Services is an internal Amazon service specializing in the production of high-quality components through additive manufacturing (3D printing), CNC machining, welding, sheet metal fabrication, powder coating, and assembly. We serve design engineers, product developers, operations engineers, and retail product concept testing teams across Amazon.

About the Role
AMS seeks a Quality Engineer to own quality systems and processes across our world-class manufacturing facility. You will ensure product quality meets customer specifications while maintaining ISO 9001 certification and driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires strong technical metrology expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to work cross-functionally with manufacturing teams and external suppliers.


Key job responsibilities
Quality Systems and Compliance
• Maintain and improve ISO 9001 quality management system certification
• Develop and document quality procedures, work instructions, and inspection criteria
• Conduct internal audits and support external certification audits
• Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes
• Ensure compliance with customer specifications and industry standards
Metrology and Inspection
• Program and operate CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) and other metrology equipment
• Set inspection criteria and sampling plans for incoming materials, in-process, and final products
• Perform first article inspections and generate detailed inspection reports
• Conduct capability analysis (Cp, Cpk) to validate process performance
• Execute Gage R&R studies to ensure measurement system accuracy and repeatability
Supplier Quality Management
• Conduct supplier audits to assess quality systems and manufacturing capabilities
• Own supplier quality performance and drive improvement initiatives
• Review and approve supplier first article inspection reports
• Manage non-conformance issues with suppliers and implement corrective actions
• Qualify new suppliers and materials
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner with manufacturing managers to resolve quality issues and implement process improvements
• Work with production teams on root cause analysis and problem-solving
• Support Customer Success team with quality documentation and customer inquiries
• Collaborate with engineering teams on design for manufacturability and quality requirements
• Train production staff on quality standards, inspection techniques, and documentation
Continuous Improvement
• Lead Six Sigma projects to reduce defects and improve process capability
• Analyze quality data to identify trends and improvement opportunities
• Implement statistical process control (SPC) methods
• Drive cost of quality reduction initiatives

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems
- Proficiency with CMM programming and operation
- Experience with statistical analysis tools and methods (capability analysis, Gage R&R, SPC)
- Demonstrated ability to create first article inspection reports

Preferred qualifications

- Six Sigma Green Belt, or Six Sigma Black Belt Certification
- 5+ years of quality engineering experience in contract manufacturing or multi-process environments
- Experience with multiple manufacturing processes (CNC machining, welding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, coating, assembly)
- Supplier audit and supplier quality management experience
- Proficiency with metrology equipment beyond CMM (optical comparators, surface roughness testers, hardness testers, etc.)
- Familiarity with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and blueprint reading
- Experience with quality management software and statistical analysis tools (Minitab, JMP, or similar)
- Strong verbal and written communication skills

title: Technical Program Manager III, AWS Infra Supply Chain Automation
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges that impact cloud infrastructure at global scale? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team is seeking a Technical Program Manager III to drive critical programs that ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time. You'll tackle never-been-done-before problems involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly enable AWS's ability to scale and meet customer demand.

In this role, you'll leverage your program management expertise and technical depth to orchestrate complex supply chain initiatives across the Supply Chain Operating System (SCos). You'll work with cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain. This is an opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while solving ambiguous problems that require both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team supply chain automation programs, defining scope, validating requirements, and driving execution with measurable success criteria
- Partner with engineering teams and business stakeholders to translate supply chain challenges into technical solutions, creating high-level designs and architectural approaches for the Supply Chain Operating System (SCos)
- Drive alignment across diverse global teams by managing priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs while proactively identifying and mitigating risks before they become blockers
- Establish program health metrics and operational excellence mechanisms, continuously monitoring progress and driving process improvements that enhance delivery efficiency
- Influence technical and business decisions by building consensus across stakeholders, communicating program status through written narratives and presentations, and escalating appropriately to resolve contentious issues

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing deployment metrics for a critical supply chain automation initiative, identifying a potential bottleneck in inventory forecasting. You organize a design review with partner engineering teams, asking probing questions to pressure-test assumptions and ensure the solution scales globally. After clarifying action items and owners, you draft a concise narrative for leadership addressing a cross-team dependency that needs resolution. You spend time mentoring a junior program manager on stakeholder management, then join a working session where you help engineering and operations teams navigate trade-offs between speed and technical debt for an upcoming launch.

About the team
The AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team builds the software systems that orchestrate AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain at global scale. Our mission is to ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time to support customer demand. We work on complex challenges involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly impact AWS's ability to scale.

Our team values innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We foster an inclusive culture where perspectives from varied backgrounds drive better solutions, and we invest heavily in developing our engineers and leaders. As AWS continues its rapid growth, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while working on programs of critical importance to Amazon's success.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

title: SAP Production Planning Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building an SAP S/4HANA platform that unifies our robotics business into a single digital thread, and Production Planning sits at the heart of how we plan, source, and build — at the speed our robotics roadmap demands. This role exists to make design-to-build cycles dramatically faster, layering automation and AI on top of a clean SAP PP core. As the SAP Production Planning Solution Architect, you will own the solution architecture for the PP domain end to end — translating how the business forecasts, plans materials, and executes manufacturing into a coherent, standard-first design that scales. A central focus of this role is the configuration of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and the integration of SAP PP with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), so that engineering, planning, and manufacturing execution flow as one connected thread. You will build the Business Process Designs (BPDs) hand in hand with business, operations, and the integrated technical team, work backwards from plan-to-produce and manufacturing reporting requirements, and ensure the architecture is designed around how the business actually operates while connecting cleanly to the broader supply chain, procurement, quality, and finance. Beyond stabilizing the core, you will drive a program of innovation on top of the SAP PP base to compress design-to-build cycles. These automation and AI layers — SAP Business AI and Joule, generative and agentic AI on SAP BTP (AI Core / AI Foundation), RAP-based and low-code accelerators, and CPI/Integration Suite orchestration — sit cleanly alongside a clean-core S/4HANA foundation.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the SAP Production Planning (PP) domain on S/4HANA, translating plan-to-produce business requirements into a coherent, scalable, standard-first design.
- Own the MRP architecture — configure classic MRP and MRP Live, planning strategies, lot-sizing procedures, MRP areas, and consumption-/forecast-based planning — to balance service levels, inventory, and manufacturing capacity.
- Own the integration between PLM and SAP PP, designing how engineering BOMs, material masters, Engineering Change Management (ECM), and document links flow into production master data and stay synchronized with product revisions.
- Own the integration between SAP PP and the Manufacturing Execution System (MES), designing production order dispatch, confirmations, component consumption, goods movements, and real-time production feedback, along with genealogy, serialization, and back-flushing requirements.
- Build the Business Process Designs (BPDs) for the PP domain, working hand in hand with business stakeholders, operations, and the integrated technical team to align on standard process adoption, exceptions, and trade-offs.
- Work backwards from how the business plans and builds — demand management, S&OP, BOMs, routings, work centers, production versions, capacity planning, and production/process orders — to ensure the PP architecture meets operational needs across discrete, repetitive, and process manufacturing.
- Design for manufacturing reporting needs — production cost, variance, yield, and capacity analytics — ensuring the PP design captures the right data to meet management and statutory reporting requirements.
- Own the integration requirements connecting PP to adjacent domains — Materials Management (MM), Quality Management (QM), Warehouse Management (WM/EWM), and Finance (FICO) — ensuring plan-to-produce connects cleanly to procurement, quality, fulfillment, and product costing.
- Lead PP standard-versus-custom decisions, favoring configuration and clean-core extensions over core modifications, and set the design patterns and integration standards the delivery team builds against.
- Drive innovation on top of the SAP PP base — lead automation and AI layers built on SAP Business AI / Joule, generative and agentic AI on SAP BTP, and RAP-based or low-code accelerators — to compress design-to-build cycles, accelerate configuration and testing, and augment planners, while keeping the core clean and upgrade-safe.
- Build master data standards, planning governance, controls, and audit and compliance requirements into the PP design from the start, rather than retrofitting them.
- Serve as the senior technical authority for the PP domain through design and configuration reviews, prototypes, and hands-on resolution of the hardest PP configuration and integration problems, mentoring functional analysts.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- 10+ years of experience working in ERP implementation
- 5+ years of experience leading the Production Planning domain in an ERP implementation
- Experience across discrete and repetitive manufacturing environments
- Experience configuring SAP Production Planning (PP) on S/4HANA in at least one full-lifecycle implementation

Preferred qualifications

- Experience integrating SAP PP with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), including engineering BOMs, Engineering Change Management (ECM), and master-data replication
- Experience integrating SAP PP with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for production order execution, confirmations, and production data exchange
- Experience building Business Process Designs (BPDs) in partnership with business, operations, and integrated technical teams
- Experience architecting plan-to-produce end to end and integrating PP with MM, QM, WM/EWM, and Finance (FICO) for product costing
- Experience leading standard-versus-custom decisions and evaluating design trade-offs on controls, auditability, and upgrade-safety
- Experience with SAP clean-core design concepts, including design and build using non-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI and data & analytics
- Experience driving innovation on top of core SAP PP — building automation and AI layers with SAP Business AI / Joule, generative and agentic AI on SAP BTP (AI Core / AI Foundation), and RAP-based or low-code accelerators — to shorten design-to-build cycles

title: Sr. Manager, Data and Insights, US Prime & Marketing Technology
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited to build and grow a new customer insights team that will influence flagship initiatives across Amazon and Prime? Do you enjoy using data, analytics, and AI to deliver actionable insights that support critical business decisions?

The US Prime & Marketing Team is seeking an experienced data and analytics leader to lead and grow a new North American Stores Customer Insights team focused on delivering faster, AI-accelerated insights and recommendations that drive customer engagement across North American Stores and US Prime.

As the Sr. Manager, Data and Insights, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of Business Analysts, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Data Engineers who provide data, reporting, and analytical insights that influence and support critical business decisions. You will create and implement a new charter that reimagines how insights are generated and delivered, combining traditional BI with agentic, AI-native analytics: conversational access to trusted data, automated deep dives, and agent-ready data foundations that get answers to decision-makers in hours instead of weeks. You will build scalable data solutions to enable insight generation and provide analytical support for flagship initiatives across Amazon and Prime. You will lead the team to design and build the right data infrastructure layer, including well-governed, semantically documented data that both humans and AI agents can trust and consume, to enable reporting and analytics, while partnering with product teams to define metrics, software engineering teams to instrument the appropriate data pipelines, and data engineering to scale our data infrastructure.

You will lead the team to build the AI layer of the insights stack, not just adopt it: standing up the data services and agent integrations that let internal AI tools query our data safely, developing and improving natural-language reporting so partners get answers directly, and setting the standard for how BAs, BIEs, and DEs use AI-assisted tooling in their own work. The goal is to move team capacity from routine reporting to the deep analysis and recommendations that move the business.

This role requires excellent technical skills and hands-on fluency with how GenAI is changing analytics work, in order to raise the bar on both the team's craft and its high-judgment, responsible use of AI, and excellent written/verbal communication skills to interact effectively with business and tech leadership.

Key job responsibilities
- Single-threaded owner for data, analytics, insights, and AI-enabled analytics for the US Prime & Marketing Technology team
- Lead and coach a multidisciplinary team of Business Intelligence Engineers, Business Analysts, and Data Engineers, setting the standard for how each role applies AI-assisted tooling in their own work
- Develop, launch, and scale self-service analytics and insights offerings, including natural-language and conversational access to data that lets partners get trusted answers directly
- Design and build the governed data models, semantic layers, and agent integrations that allow internal AI assistants and agents to consume NA Stores and Prime data reliably
- Deliver insights and recommendations to help shape strategy across North American Stores and US Prime, moving team capacity from routine reporting toward deep analysis and high-judgment recommendations
- Partner with Business, Product, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and Science leaders to provide data-driven insights and recommendations that influence business decisions

About the team
Few analytics teams at Amazon get a domain this wide. US Prime & Marketing Technology (UPMT) owns the US Prime member experience, the category, seasonal, and brand marketing and creative for North America Stores, and the science and engineering behind the automated and agentic merchandising, personalization, and content-quality platforms that run across Amazon's stores worldwide. Our belief is that everything beautiful should be automated, and everything automated should be beautiful. Measuring an org like that means working across membership economics, marketing incrementality, on-site and off-site engagement, creative performance, and the output of agentic systems that didn't exist two years ago.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 11+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
- 5+ years of delivering results managing a business intelligence or analytics team, including employee development and performance management experience
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in econometrics, statistics, industrial engineering, operations research, optimization, data mining, analytics, or equivalent quantitative field, or Master's degree and 5+ years of a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science experience
- Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
- Experience managing analytics, data science or technology teams, with a product or insight focus
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence
- Experience leading a team that built GenAI-enabled analytics products on AWS, such as conversational access to data or agentic analytical workflows
- Experience building governed semantic layers, metrics stores, or data models that make organizational data reliably consumable by AI agents and natural-language analytics
- Experience with causal measurement at scale, such as incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling, geo-experiments, or subscription and membership LTV analysis
- Experience leading a multidisciplinary team that includes Data Engineers alongside Business Intelligence Engineers and Business Analysts

You will be responsible for managing the intake pipeline for WhatsApp templates, upholding SX standards, coordinating template testing and performance tracking during dial-ups, and serving as the first responder for emergent communication needs and liasoning across partner tech teams for any issue debugging. This is a high-visibility role that requires strong ownership, a bias for action and an eye for identifying and simplifying processes for builder teams.



Key job responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
WhatsApp Template Intake & SX Bar Raising
• Own the end-to-end intake process for WhatsApp template requests from stakeholder teams across WW Stores
• Serve as the SX bar raiser — review template content for tone, clarity, compliance, and alignment with seller communication principles
• Partner with content, legal, and product teams to ensure templates meet brand guidelines and regulatory requirements
• Maintain a structured intake tracker and provide visibility to stakeholders on request status and timelines
SOP Management, Intake Tracking & SLA Governance
• Create, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the WhatsApp communications workflow
• Track and close-loop all intake requests against defined SLAs; flag and escalate deviations
• Produce weekly/monthly reporting on intake volume, SLA adherence, bottlenecks, and process health metrics
• Drive process improvements based on data trends and stakeholder feedback
Template Testing & Performance Management During Dial-Up
• Coordinate end-to-end testing of new templates across pilot populations before broad rollout
• Define and track performance metrics (delivery rate, read rate, opt-out rate, CTR) during phased dial-up
• Identify underperforming templates and recommend optimizations or rollbacks based on data
• Maintain a performance dashboard and share insights with stakeholders during business reviews
Emergent Communications Management
• Serve as the single-threaded owner for urgent/same-day communication requests that require immediate setup and deployment
• Establish and maintain a rapid-response workflow to triage, approve, build, and deploy emergency templates within hours
• Coordinate cross-functionally with tech, content, and approvals teams to ensure timely delivery under compressed timelines
• Maintain a log of emergent comms with root cause analysis to reduce future ad-hoc requests
Technical Debugging & Issue Resolution
• Act as the first point of contact for technical issues including Cradle job failures, template errors, and delivery failures
• Triage and debug issues by working with engineering teams, reviewing job logs, and identifying root causes
• Maintain a known-issues tracker and drive resolution or workarounds to minimize seller impact
• Document recurring issues and partner with tech teams to build permanent fixes

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field
• 2+ years of experience in program management, operations, or a related role
• Experience working with communication platforms, CRM tools, or messaging workflows
• Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data analysis
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with WhatsApp Business API or similar messaging platforms
• Familiarity with Amazon's internal tools (Cradle, SIM, etc.)
• Experience in seller-facing or marketplace operations
• Exposure to Emerging Markets and cross-geo stakeholder management
• Basic understanding of SQL or scripting for data pulls and debugging
• Experience creating SOPs and process documentation from scratch

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
- Experience in MS Access and SQL

title: Software Development Engineer, Ads AI Core Infrastructure (ACI), Ads AI Core Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Ads, we're re-imagining the advertising landscape through advanced generative AI technologies and AI agents, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands online. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle — from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights.

The Ads Agent Fabric team delivers the AI infrastructure platform that accelerates agentic application development from months to weeks. We build the agent-builder SDK with pre-integrated Ads features, developer tools that accelerate the develop, test, and model evaluation lifecycle, and a fully-managed stateful runtime with integrated access to Ads services, data, and foundational models. Our platform solves core production challenges: managing execution state across multi-step reasoning and multi-agent orchestration, enabling resumability through checkpointing and task queues for long-running workflows, and providing memory primitives that enable stateful experiences where agents remember and learn across sessions.

You will build Tier-1 services to handle millions of requests per day, while maintaining response latencies in the milliseconds and meeting strict SLA requirements. You will develop distributed solutions with service-oriented architecture to build high-performance platforms powering the next generation of AI-driven advertising experiences. Our systems and algorithms operate on massive datasets using distributed frameworks. In this role, you will design new and rebuild existing solutions for the fast-growing scale of agentic infrastructure — including stateful runtime services, and pre-built platform components that agent-builder teams rely on to ship production agents.

You will not merely go through the full software development cycle but more importantly drive appropriate technology choices for the business, lead the way for continuous innovation, and shape the future of AI-powered advertising at Amazon.

We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun-loving team building at the forefront of AI agent infrastructure. We are entrepreneurial and have a bias for action with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on the future of AI agents in the Amazon Advertising business.

A successful candidate will have the satisfaction of seeing their work power thousands of AI agents serving millions of advertisers globally, broaden their technical skills across distributed systems and ML infrastructure, and work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation.



Key job responsibilities
SDE-2s are autonomous contributors to their team's software. You deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle including working backwards from customers, software design, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and documentation.

SDE-2s coach others on producing high-quality code, using processes such as code review as a teaching mechanism. They ensure that when their software fails, the root cause is identified and eliminated with a permanent fix. They ensure the software they produce can be maintained and extended by those not familiar with the code by writing clear documentation and making good design choices.

SDE-2s participate in an inclusive, constructive dialogue with other team members and members of closely related teams. They train new team members on how their software is constructed, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.



About the team
Agent Fabric is Amazon Ads' AI infrastructure platform. We extend AWS AgentCore with advertising-specific capabilities and a managed, stateful runtime, cutting agent development from months to weeks. We own the platform end-to-end: the agent-builder SDK, the runtime that executes agents in production, and the knowledge and governance layers that keep it safe and accountable at scale. Our systems are in the critical path for GenAI projects across Amazon Advertising.

Stateful Runtime & Orchestration: an orchestration framework that turns a single agent turn into durable, resumable work: async conversations that persist after a turn ends and notify on completion, scheduled and event-driven workflows, and multi-step DAG execution with fan-out, cancellation, and retry. Checkpointing, task queues, and short- and long-term memory let agents resume and learn across sessions.

Knowledge Base: the RAG Knowledge Base that grounds advertiser answers across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP, reporting, and optimization. We run the KB agent, an OpenSearch vector index, and a daily ingestion pipeline spanning published and partner-curated content, with eval gates that enforce retrieval quality before every rebuild.

Pre-Built Ads Components: delegated advertiser authorization, privacy-safe logging, policy guardrails, real-time data access, and context handoff between agents.

Metering & Throttling: metering every invocation across model calls, tool calls, memory operations, and session time, then enforcing per-user and per-advertiser limits on a sub-millisecond path to protect the platform from abuse.

Operational Excellence: parallelization for low latency, human-in-the-loop approvals, end-to-end tracing, security isolation, cost attribution, and versioned deploys with rollback.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
