title: Senior Financial Analyst, Finance Transformation and Analytics - North America Customer Fullfillment
descriptionHtml:
Finance is all about the numbers... unless you work in NACF Finance; here it is knowing the numbers and so much more. Amazon operates the most complex retail fulfillment network in the world, delivering billions of packages to hundreds of millions of homes and businesses every year. North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) Finance provides the cost controllership, return-on-investment analysis, and financial insight that keep the economics of that network healthy. We translate operational KPIs into financial impact so our stakeholders have the most reliable, up-to-date information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.
This is a perfect role for a finance expert with highly advanced data skills, or a data expert with strong ability and genuine interest in finance. You know how to turn large, messy datasets into advanced analysis, automation, and metrics that move the business. You view problems as treasures, you dive deep to find the root cause, and you are comfortable when your ideas and mechanisms are tested daily. You will sit at the center of a Hub-and-Spoke analytics team whose mission is to own the outcome of the NACF finance analytics function, not simply to produce more dashboards.


Key job responsibilities
1. Serve as an expert in both Finance and Data, bridging the gap between finance and data teams. Build deep understanding of the key cost-of-fulfillment drivers across the NACF network along with the related finance, accounting, and controllership systems and data.
2. Use solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models and analyze complex business problems with limited guidance.
3. Own the efficiency of financial reporting for a business area, identify and resolve complex data-integrity issues with stakeholders, and build data-analysis processes that are scalable and auditable.
4. Collect, analyze, and manage quantitative data and create meaningful metrics and tools that drive cost reduction and process improvement.
5. Write systems queries to gather finance data and perform data mining and analysis using Excel, SQL (required), and Python.
6. Lead root-cause analysis that uncovers core issues in the data, then partner with Operations to improve their competitive position and profitability.
7. Enable finance stakeholders to navigate data-driven solutions and datasets so they can confidently self-service their needs.
8. Apply AI to raise your own productivity and to automate financial workflows: use large language models and agentic development tools (for example AWS Kiro, Claude Code, and similar) to build analyses, tooling, and automation faster than traditional methods allow.
9. Identify, lead, and execute opportunities to improve, automate, standardize, or simplify finance tools and processes across teams and organizations.
10. Work with data-source providers and tech teams to ensure key decision data is accurate, automated, and timely.
11. Communicate data clearly and concisely, in writing and verbally, adjusting your style to the audience to make complex finance issues understandable. Draw conclusions, make recommendations, and challenge partner assumptions when necessary.


A day in the life
No two days in NACF Finance look alike. You will work in a fast-paced, high-energy, and ever-changing environment alongside Operations, Product, Tech, and Procurement partners. One day you may be building a cost model for a network initiative, the next automating a reporting process with an AI-assisted toolchain, the next root-causing a data defect that is distorting a leadership metric. You move with purpose and speed, think like an owner, and treat every day as Day One.

About the team
NACF Finance Transformation & Analytics is a centralized, Hub-and-Spoke analytics team that supports the full North American Customer Fulfillment network. The team is the front door for finance analytics: rationalizing the reporting landscape into one source of truth, delivering advanced analytics and deep-dive root-causing, and building AI-first automation that lets finance spend less time assembling data and more time answering the hard questions. You will partner with Senior Leaders across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Procurement, Accounting, and Technology as a trusted financial advocate and business partner.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance) experience
- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 4+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 4+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience

title: WHS Officer , WHS Officer
descriptionHtml:
The WHS Officer will partner directly with site operations teams (First Mile/Middle Mile/Last Mile) to implement company safety policies, ensure compliance with all local and regional regulations, and maintain a secure, healthful work environment. Leveraging lean principles and kaizen methodologies, this individual contributor will independently lead continuous improvement initiatives to mitigate conditional and ergonomic risks in processes, utilizing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis to influence operational changes. The role requires good communication skills to deliver clear, consistent messages verbally and in writing, train Operations Leaders on safety protocols, and integrate best practices into company standards. Proven ability in teamwork, analytical thinking, sound judgment, and customer-focused problem-solving is essential to effectively collaborate across functions and drive meaningful safety outcomes. The WHS Officer will apply expertise in safety programs, environmental compliance, and ergonomics to support site teams, ensuring adherence to Amazon's safety frameworks while driving a culture of proactive risk management and operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
Ensure compliance with Amazon Safety Policies, standards, and applicable local/regional/national regulations through direct guidance and oversight.
Support assigned site(s) in implementing Amazon WHS procedures as directed by WHS leadership.
Partner with site stakeholders to drive compliance with WHS standards, procedures, and local laws.
Conduct comprehensive site walks engaging associates on hazard observation, coaching on WHS requirements, ergonomic postures, and Permit to Work compliance.
Conduct frequent site safety inspections and audits to identify non-compliant equipment or processes.
Complete area readiness checks for the Wellness Room and replenish supplies as needed.
Conduct risk assessments for all processes and update them for change management at defined frequencies.
Implement corrective solutions to eliminate risks and prevent injuries across facilities.
Initiate corrective actions for findings identified during standard work implementation.
Analyze weekly/monthly/quarterly safety metrics and incident trends to prioritize resource allocation to high-risk areas.
Measure site performance against safety policy requirements and develop action plans to address deficiencies.
Complete assigned tasks and stretch assignments to advance site safety goals.
Assist in conducting safety inductions, toolbox talks, and awareness programs.
Coach associates on new/existing WHS requirements and their operational impact. Promote a proactive safety culture through engagement and collaboration with stakeholders to resolve safety barriers.
Maintain all records related to safety operations (regulatory/non regulatory inspections, audits, SOPs).
Support the site safety manager in timely reporting of compliance status to leadership.
Implement Kaizen or other initiatives to strengthen workplace conditions and safety performance.
Deliver on-time, high-quality projects to support Operations teams.
Collaborate with site operations and WHS leadership to address day-to-day risks and escalate compliance issues through inspections/audits.
Complete peak readiness actions, provide updates, and contribute to lesson-learned sessions.
We have a 5-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.
For roles in last-mile and Amazon Fresh sites, manage multiple small sites within a city as required.

A day in the life
Daily Deep Dive of metrics, Site safety audit / inspections, Incident reporting and investigation, Training, TBT, FGDs, Startups at site, AWHS committee meeting, Communication on required safety matters, Safety compliance adherence with respect to Amazon WHS Policies and procedures, PPE issuance and compliance, Risk Assessment, Inventory management and procurement of safety supplies.

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Bachelor's degree in science or equivalent
- 2+ years of experience in Workplace Health and Safety

- Master's degree in Health and Safety or a related field
- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel
- A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent), or NEBOSH (National General Certificate)
- Experience in a fast paced, changing/growing organization
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment.
- Fulfillment Center or Manufacturing Safety experience with mix of exempt and non-exempt employees at a site of at least 200 people preferred.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with site leaders.

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help customers build AI agents that change how work gets done? As a Principal, Solutions Architect in AWS, you will design and productionize agentic systems using services like Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, contribute to open-source AI accelerators, and help customers adopt AI-native software development practices. Your time splits roughly 50/50 between direct customer engagements and building reusable assets that scale your impact. On the customer side, you will guide teams through hands-on architecture and unblock adoption. On the builder side, you will create reference implementations, open-source tools, and technical content that enable the broader community. This is a global role where you will maintain deep relationships with AI service teams and collaborate with specialists and builder customers across regions to stay current on capabilities and influence product roadmaps.

descriptionHtml:

title: Business Development Manager, AWS Cloud Intelligence , AWS Cloud Intelligence
locations: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
descriptionHtml:
Join a team of cloud experts focused on uncovering and articulating advantages for AWS Customers!

The AWS Cloud Intelligence team is a specialty services organization that provides cloud compete expertise globally. We are subject matter experts (SMEs) covering top and emerging competitors, key domains, and industry segments. Cloud Intelligence enables field teams to help their customers quickly by removing both business and technical blockers in the sales cycle. We advise account teams and their customers through at scale content, gather and analyze insights surrounding comparable cloud providers, and highlight product and position gaps that our customers are experiencing to continuously improve AWS’ overall value proposition. In addition to on-demand self-service resources, the CI team provides targeted support for specific competitive opportunities through one-to-one customer engagements. This team hires SAs and BDMs who are SMEs in one or more public clouds to advise AWS field teams on the best strategies to develop compelling business cases to support customers co-existing and partnering with competing public cloud services.

As a Cloud Intelligence Field BDM, you will be a strategic partner to the AWS field sales team. You will help customers understand why AWS is the best cloud partner for their business. You will coach sales teams on how to amplify AWS strengths and create differentiation strategies. As a strategic partner to sales and external customers, you will identify emerging signals and best practices, to serve the broader organization. This position blends business and technology skillsets. Cloud Intelligence Field BDMs drive complex engagements and interact with executive audiences. They also have technical competence that enables them to analyze AWS and other cloud providers. Candidates must have the capability to craft and convey compelling value propositions, and to communicate concepts and stories effectively.

We are looking for experience in one or more of the following: market or competitive intelligence, sales, business value engineering, sales enablement, sales coaching, and customer-facing technology sales experience. The ability to successfully differentiate cloud services in competitive market segments is key.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop scalable competitive strategies to enable winning key strategic deals.
• Support, coach, and develop large deal closing capability.
• Be the go-to resource for an AWS field sales segment and sales leadership for AWS differentiation.
• Leverage excellent communication skills to articulate the business value of AWS value propositions, working backwards from our customers strategic objectives.
• Demonstrate the ability to earn trust with and influence C-level executives in customer organizations and within AWS.
• Support strategic, in-person workshops (this position will require travel).

title: Principal PMT, NTN Core, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. As part of this mission, we are seeking a Principal Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to define product requirements, lead feature alignment, and drive roadmap planning for the NTN Core Network globally. You will work closely with engineering teams across satellite RAN, Core, and Devices, with focus on the NTN core.

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP protocols, NAS signaling, extensive experience deploying 4G/5G Packet Cores across multiple vendors, product lifecycle software release management, and the ability to translate customer experiences and user stories into detailed product requirements. The Principal Product Manager - Technical (PMT) will be at the forefront of defining NTN Core Network requirements and building 0-to-1 satellite systems for consumer, business, and government customers globally.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive NTN Core Network feature alignment to ensure interoperability across Amazon Leo RAN, Core, Transport, and cloud infrastructure, delivering seamless connectivity and roaming services between satellite and terrestrial networks.
• Own the NTN Core Network product roadmap and service delivery plan, ensuring delivery across multiple workstreams with high standards and operational excellence.
• Work closely with Amazon Leo engineering teams, Payload Integration Test (PIT) and telco MNO/Device/Chipset partners to define, build, deploy and test 3GPP-compliant protocol layers, network functions, and service-based architecture, ensuring deterministic behavior, low latency, and high reliability for satellite-based connectivity and TN-NTN mobility. Lead by example with systems thinking to solve problems.
• Stay current with 3GPP releases, industry trends, and evolving NTN deployment models to guide long-term product strategy aligned to Amazon Leo’s roadmap.
• Write and present technical documents (6-pagers, PR/FAQs, BRDs, PRDs) to senior leadership.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering hardware, software, systems, operations, and program management teams across Amazon Leo.
• Be structured and flexible at the same time to learn as the business evolves.
• Provide visibility and communicate extremely well, with responsibility to provide updates to VPs, author operation plans, business review documents, and communicate to the broader Amazon Leo team.
• Be a seasoned product leader with a demonstrated history of leading product strategy, technology solutions, data analytics, and customer experience.
• Thrive on ambiguity and have a track record of delivering large-scale technology products and/or led large operational or technical teams.
• Lead large, global, and complex technology initiatives in a large business unit, working cross-functionally with several business and technical teams.
• The ability to think and move quickly and is inspired to build mechanisms to simplify and continuously innovate.
• Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills; ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases.

A day in the life
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

About the team
You will be joining a team that is focused on defining and driving the product requirements for the Amazon Leo Direct-to-Device (DTD) satellite system.

Basic qualifications

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience technical product management
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, or 7+ years of wireless communications systems and implementation experience
- 5+ years of technical product management, program management or engineering experience
- 10+ years of solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry experience
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- 7+ years of wireless communications systems experience, including deployment of 4G/5G Packet Core

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience in Space Vehicle/Satellite Operations, Space Communications or related industry
- In-depth knowledge and working experience with satellite communications and deployment of NTN Core network software stack, troubleshooting, voice, network functions, emergency services and call flows.
- Familiarity with Amazon's internal tools and processes.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy innovative industrial robotics across North America's fulfillment network. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of networking fundamentals
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related STEM field
- Experience working in an engineering, construction, manufacturing, or warehouse environment
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience in managing and troublshooting network
- 1+ years' experience with technical drawings and/or reading CAD models (mechanical and electrical)
- 1+ years' Experience working on mechanical, electrical, IT networked, or software systems
- Understanding of data collection, reporting processes, and ability to make data-driven decisions
- Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Interest to work primarily in a construction or warehouse environment in a field-based role
- Ability to travel domestically 75% or more of the year

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of TCP/IP and networking protocols such as HTTP and DNS
- 1+ years of engineering, construction, manufacturing, or warehouse environment experience
- Proven experience working on hardware integration or complex mechanical-electrical or networked industrial equipment. Knowledge of specific robotic equipment (Fanuc, ABB), and Allen Bradley PLC experience
- Certified in OSHA, ANSI, or other Automation Safety Certifications. Familiarity with LEAN or Six Sigma, certifications are a plus

descriptionHtml:
Amazonは、何百万の商品をお客様へ提供し続けることによって、世界的に認知度が高く、グローバルリーディングカンパニ—としての地位を確立しています。また、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業”であり続けるため、日々改善と改革を行っており、それらの業務へ貢献できる経験豊富な人材を求めています。

JCFS(Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions)とは、AmazonのFulfillment Solutionを追求するオペレーション技術統括本部です。アマゾンジャパンオペレーション業務の中核部門としてオペレーションの各部門を効率的に連携することに貢献します。
JCFSは、Reliability&Maintenance Engineering Facilities部門(以下RME-F)において、Facilities Svs Sr Area Managerを探しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンジャパンにおける、デリバリーステーション(以下DS)の設備((配送機能だけでなく、倉庫機能や冷凍冷蔵設備を有する拠点も含む)の維持管理とそこで働く従業員の職場環境の日々改善を、Outsourcingを活用して実現していくポジションです。

Facilities Svs Sr Area Managerは建屋の建築、電気、空調、衛生、消火、昇降設備、冷凍冷蔵設備の保守点検及び不具合対応や小規模な工事、そして売店、シャトルバスの運行管理、各種資産の管理、DSの運営にとって重要なコストの管理も行います。施設管理では年間保全計画や中長期保全計画のプランと実施、売店運営では、全従業員が満足できる環境作りに積極的に取組、カスタマーエクスぺリエンスの向上を成し遂げます。 そして従業員の通勤手段であるシャトルバスのダイヤ改正や適切な運行管理とコスト管理でカスタマーに貢献します。
また、サステナビリティにも貢献します。DS内で発生する消費電力を最適化するべく、省エネ活動を提案・実行します。次に廃棄物の低減を目的としたリサイクル率の向上やコンプライアンスを遵守した運営費用の最適化を協力会社と共に深堀し改善します。

以上の業務をOutsourcing先の協力会社と自社で構築しているコールセンターを管理しながら、その管理体制も改善するべく提案・実行のリードを担ってもらいます。また、DSや自身の管轄だけでなく、全国のフルフィルメントセンターのRME-F設備管理を行っている各拠点の担当者とディスカッションを含むコミュニケーションを密に行い、情報・学び・成功体験を共有・標準化して展開する業務にも取り組んでいただきます。社内外ともに良好な関係性を築ける高いコミュニケーション能力を発揮し、自ら行動を起こし結果に繋げる、強いドライブ力をもった方からの応募をお待ちしています。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

■20％：安全管理/サプライヤー評価/カスタマーエクスぺリエンス向上/GlobalにAlignした業務の見直し/DS統一での運用ルールづくり

Als erfahrene HR-Führungskraft agierst du als Individual Contributor und arbeitest direkt mit Field Leaders, Standortleitungsteams und General Managers zusammen. Du bringst dabei die Seniorität und Glaubwürdigkeit mit, die für strategische Diskussionen zu komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen erforderlich sind. Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für das End-to-End-Mitarbeitererlebnis an deinen Standorten und verantwortest Feedback-Mechanismen, Anerkennungsprogramme sowie Umgebungsstandards, die Vertrauen, Engagement und Leistung nachhaltig prägen. Diese Rolle erfordert die Balance zwischen taktischer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick – unter Nutzung von Technologie und menschlichem Urteilsvermögen, um qualitativ hochwertige Mitarbeitererlebnisse zu schaffen und gleichzeitig eine proaktive Risikoidentifikation und -minderung voranzutreiben.
Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten und mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner Region (Campus) betreuen, mit regelmäßiger Mobilität zwischen den zugewiesenen Standorten.

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement

Förderung einer offenen Zwei-Wege-Kommunikation durch Voice of the Associate-Programme, Rundtischgespräche und GEMBA-Walks mit zeitnaher Lösung von Anliegen und Stärkung der Beziehungen zwischen Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften. Umsetzung von Engagement-Strategien und Anerkennungsprogrammen, die die Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit messbar steigern. Schaffung eines inklusiven Umfelds, in dem sich Mitarbeitende sicher fühlen, ihre Meinung zu äußern und authentisch aufzutreten – durch die Etablierung von Employee Resource Groups und die Sicherstellung gerechter Talentpraktiken. Regelmäßige und sichtbare Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche, um Vertrauen auf allen Ebenen aufzubauen und Anliegen frühzeitig zu erkennen, bevor sie eskalieren.



Operational Excellence & Site Standards

Bewertung der Arbeitsbedingungen durch regelmäßige Standortbegehungen und Etablierung von Routinen zur Einhaltung der Standards gemäß den Amazon-Vorgaben. Zusammenarbeit mit Standortleitungen und Safety-Teams zur konsequenten Umsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards und -programmen. Leitung strategischer Community-Initiativen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams für Public Policy und Public Relations. Proaktive Risikoidentifikation und -minderung durch die Einrichtung von Frühwarnsystemen, Nutzung von Datenerkenntnissen und fundierte Entscheidungen, die den Richtliniengeist mit den Geschäftsanforderungen in Einklang bringen. Umsetzung zentraler PXT-Prozesse nach strengen Standards sowie Durchführung von Inspektionen und Audits zur Sicherstellung der Compliance. Effektive Koordination mit Shared Services und funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zur Gewährleistung einer nahtlosen Serviceerbringung.



Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology

Führende Nutzung von Analysen und KI-Tools zur Aufdeckung verborgener Muster, Antizipation aufkommender Risiken und Förderung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung. Umwandlung von Erkenntnissen in überzeugende Narrative, die Senior Stakeholder beeinflussen und messbare Verbesserungen im Mitarbeitererlebnis und in der Unternehmensleistung vorantreiben. Strategische Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen und Self-Service-Tools für Effizienz und Exzellenz – unter Nutzung von Automatisierung bei gleichzeitiger Beibehaltung eines persönlichen Service für sensible Anliegen, die menschliches Urteilsvermögen und Empathie erfordern.



Strategic PXT Leadership

Regelmäßige Partnerschaft mit Standortleitungen und General Managers zur Balance zwischen operativen Anforderungen und Amazons Werten sowie Personalstrategie – mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen bei komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen. Hinterfragen des Status quo und Förderung von Innovationen in HR-Praktiken bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung einer nachhaltigen Umsetzung. Coaching von Business Leaders zu effektivem Personalmanagement, einschließlich Leistungsfeedback, Teamentwicklung und komplexen Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen. Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen durch Verstärkung von Botschaften, Abbau von Widerständen und Unterstützung von Führungskräften bei der Übertragung von Veränderungen in lokale Routinen. Festlegung klarer Ziele für die Kulturtransformation und Umsetzung umfassender Strategien zur systematischen Stärkung der Organisationsgesundheit, Talentkompetenzen und Führungseffektivität.



PXT Leadership & Organizational Health

Mitwirkung bei PXT-Personalentscheidungen, Ressourcenallokation und Dienstplanung zur Sicherstellung angemessener Abdeckung und Kompetenz. Beteiligung an Nachfolgeplanung und Beförderungsentscheidungen sowie Identifikation von High-Potential-Talenten und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Durchführung von Talentbewertungen für PXT-Teammitglieder mit Beiträgen zu Leistung, Potenzial und Entwicklungsbedarf. Unterstützung der Entwicklungsplanung und Beitrag zum Aufbau von Nachfolgekapazitäten für kritische Positionen. Beiträge zum Performance Management des PXT-Teams sowie Förderung einer positiven Teamkultur und Anerkennungspraktiken.

A day in the life
Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet strategisches Denken mit praxisnaher Umsetzung auf Standortebene. Du nutzt fortgeschrittene Analysen und KI-gestützte Tools, um Trends zu erkennen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die das Arbeitsplatzerlebnis verbessern. Vom Coaching von Senior Leaders bei komplexen Personalherausforderungen bis hin zur Förderung von HR-Prozessexzellenz arbeitest du eng mit Field Leaders und General Managers an zukunftsorientierten Strategien zusammen. Du pflegst eine starke Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche durch Standortbegehungen, Mitarbeiter-Feedback-Runden und strategische Initiativen und navigierst dabei komplexe organisatorische Herausforderungen mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen. Darüber hinaus trägst du zur organisatorischen Gesundheit des PXT-Teams durch Talentbewertungen, Nachfolgeplanung und Performance Management bei. Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt von deiner Fähigkeit ab, Veränderungsinitiativen zu leiten, in unklaren Situationen fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und eine Unternehmenskultur zu schaffen, in der sich Mitarbeitende wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen.

title: Programmatic Solutions Analyst, Amazon Ads
descriptionHtml:
Our Amazon DSP team is looking for a Programmatic Solutions Analyst to join Amazon Advertising's growing team based in New York.

As a Programmatic Solutions Analyst, you will manage the end-to-end experience of our enterprise customer, known as programmatic trading desks, driving the overall expertise in our programmatic advertising DSP.
The Programmatic Solutions Analyst develops our customers into proficient users of Amazon DSP. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with programmatic traders at agencies/advertisers, as well as Amazon Advertising internal account teams, support engineering, sales, and product to address customer needs, acting as the voice of the customer to help drive product enhancements, and create solutions on behalf of a diverse set of customers. You will be passionate about understanding customer objectives, and addressing them via training, product deep dives, adoption of Amazon technologies.

Key job responsibilities
Our Amazon DSP team is looking for a Programmatic Solutions Analyst to join Amazon Advertising's growing team based in New York.

As a Programmatic Solutions Analyst, you will manage the end-to-end experience of our enterprise customer, known as programmatic trading desks, driving the overall expertise in our programmatic advertising DSP.
The Programmatic Solutions Analyst develops our customers into proficient users of Amazon DSP. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with programmatic traders at agencies/advertisers, as well as Amazon Advertising internal account teams, support engineering, sales, and product to address customer needs, acting as the voice of the customer to help drive product enhancements, and create solutions on behalf of a diverse set of customers. You will be passionate about understanding customer objectives, and addressing them via training, product deep dives, adoption of Amazon technologies.

A day in the life
A typical engagement with our customers could include conducting deep dives to quality check campaign set-up, campaign performance monitoring, providing optimization recommendations, reviewing defect ticket trends to find opportunities for training, analyzing customer satisfaction surveys, and owning internal requests for onboarding new customers.

You will advocate for the customer in internal forums, provide troubleshooting support and triage when needed, and simplify and propagate customer feedback to inform product and services design. The Programmatic Solutions Consulting team operates as trusted advisors to customers every day, and ensure customers gradually develop into a proficient users of our DSP, who see Amazon DSP as their preferred means to their goals.

You will be passionate about understanding customer objectives, and address them using our book of services and engagement best practices, to drive adoption of Amazon technologies. Your ownership and curiosity will allow you to comprehensively understand the details of our offerings and be able to speak to these to our customers with passion, authority, empathy, and clarity.

About the team
Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.

Here at Amazon Advertising, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have 13 employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfilment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

- 2+ years of programmatic advertising experience
- Experience with Excel
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
- Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in e-commerce or online advertising
- Experience (technical and operational) with multiple domain areas of programmatic advertising technologies (DSP, RTB, bid shading, machine learning optimization, ad verification, ad tracking, ad attribution, etc.)

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, Platform Engineering & Emerging Technologies
descriptionHtml:
Own the product vision and multi-year strategy for AWS Secret Cloud for Industry (ASCI), the managed service that enables cleared U.S. defense contractors and other National Industrial Security Program organizations to run contractor-owned, contractor-operated classified workloads directly on AWS.

As Principal PMT you set the direction for ASCI as a product area and are accountable for where it goes next, giving customers a secure and isolated environment to run generative AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads in a classified setting. You define the strategy others execute, shape the business models that open new customer segments, and influence senior leaders across AWS, government stakeholders, and industry partners to make that strategy real. This is a highly technical role that rewards deep fluency in technical and compliance detail and the ability to set direction and build alignment across customers and internal AWS organizations.

- Own the vision and multi-year strategy for ASCI as a product area, central to the COCO mission.

- Set direction across the portfolio and resolve the hardest prioritization and sequencing trade-offs.

- Shape the business and engagement models that open new customer segments and use cases.

- Influence senior AWS leaders, government stakeholders, and industry partners to align on and fund the strategy.

- Carry business accountability for adoption and growth, and represent the product area in executive reviews.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product strategy. Set the vision and multi-year strategy for ASCI as a product area, define the tenets and goals that guide it, and keep that strategy connected to broader organizational and executive planning.

- Set direction others execute. Frame the hardest, most ambiguous problems, make the one-way-door calls, and give product managers and engineering teams the direction they build against.

- Shape new business models. Turn the platform's reusable primitives into new engagement and acquisition models that open additional customer segments and use cases.

- Drive launches at scale. Own the readiness bar across the portfolio: technical readiness, pricing, independent verification and validation, compliance and accreditation gates, and go-to-market, coordinating the many teams each launch depends on.

- Be accountable for outcomes. Own adoption and business results against goals, surface and prioritize growth opportunities, and report progress in operational and executive business reviews.

- Influence customers and partners directly. Work backward from customers, engage them and senior government and industry stakeholders directly, and partner across AWS service, engineering, and field organizations to turn their needs into what ships.

- Write the narratives that drive decisions. Produce the strategy documents, business reviews, and planning narratives that senior leadership uses to make investment and direction decisions.

Basic qualifications

title: Data Center Security Specialist, CMH-Hilliard Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) serves customers and developers who rely on storage, compute, and our other service capabilities. Our customers trust us to handle their data with air-tight security measures, which is something that we guarantee.

AWS is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a Data Center Security Specialist to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team, who will help manage and improve site security operations in our data centers.

Key job responsibilities
The selected individual will be responsible for managing physical security operations, developing post orders, defining security procedures, handling site incidents, working with security equipment, participating in construction projects and to drive day-to-day process improvement activities and managing vendors.

Duties include ensuring consistent deployment of all required security policies and procedures and participate in re-occurring site audits and reviews and testing new security technologies.
Must have and demonstrate resilient leadership skills, flexibility to work in dynamic environment, exceptional knowledge of security practices and strong written and verbal communication.

A day in the life
A day typically begins with a comprehensive review of any security incidents or operational issues that occurred. They start their duties by conducting thorough security system checks, including testing access control systems, verifying camera operations, and reviewing alarm panel statuses.

Throughout the day, they actively participate in operations meetings with the DC Operations team to align on maintenance activities, review vendor access requests, and address any emerging security concerns. They conduct detailed facility walkthroughs, inspecting perimeter security, checking equipment condition, and documenting any vulnerabilities in the security tracking system.

A significant portion of their day involves managing security-related tickets, including processing badge access requests, coordinating vendor escorts, and handling security system maintenance requests. They take ownership of vendor management activities, overseeing the security guard force operations, verifying SLA compliance, and conducting random post inspections to ensure quality service delivery.

The specialist regularly participates in security team meetings where they review metrics, discuss process improvements, and coordinate upcoming projects. They dedicate time to administrative responsibilities such as updating security procedures, completing required reports, reviewing camera footage, and documenting incidents as needed.

Throughout their shift, they remain responsive to any security incidents or alarms, maintaining constant vigilance over the facility's security posture. The role requires them to maintain effective communication with various stakeholders, including vendors, contractors, and internal teams.

The position demands strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to make sound decisions in dynamic situations, all while maintaining the highest standards of data center security.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Data Center Engineering Operations - 2027 Internship , DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear

- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers

- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)

- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment

- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment

- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
descriptionHtml:
Ready to do something big?

How would you build the next generation of mission-critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store, and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for worldwide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, leveraging our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces.

In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.

What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb_kp4&t=2s

The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team
https://vimeo.com/80948105


Third-party sellers have become one of Amazon's greatest growth engines, outpacing our own first-party retail business for years. That success did not happen by accident. We invested in building the best possible selling tools — from inventory management and payment processing to shipment tracking, reporting, and cross-border commerce — and we continue to invent new ones every year. FBA and the Prime membership program sit at the heart of that effort, dramatically improving the customer experience of buying from independent sellers and unlocking growth for businesses of every size.

As a Principal Technical Program Manager with FBA, you will lead broad cross-organization efforts from the early stages through release. You will work closely with product managers, engineering managers, scientists, and engineers to build the next generation of seller platforms. You will be responsible for influencing the organization's product and technical roadmap and technical architecture. You will drive organization-wide engineering and operational excellence initiatives, represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to senior leaders, and leverage your technical knowledge to guide technical choices. You will manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs are aligned, guiding technical direction to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead broad, cross-organizational programs from strategy definition through delivery, owning the technology roadmap for seller-facing platforms and driving alignment across product, engineering, and science teams.
- Define and decompose complex technical problems into clear solutions, assessing risk, driving clarity, and creating the right sense of urgency to keep programs on track.
- Influence the organization's product and technical architecture by applying deep system knowledge, identifying gaps across services and workflows, and proposing improvements that reduce repeated effort year over year.
- Partner with senior leadership to communicate trade-offs, present options, and drive decisions — managing cross-functional stakeholder alignment and escalating with strong judgment when necessary.
- Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, driving adoption of program management best practices, and contributing to the broader technical community.

A day in the life
Your primary focus will be guiding large-scale, cross-team programs that directly shape how millions of sellers interact with Amazon's fulfillment network. You will spend your time working across product managers, engineering leaders, and scientists — aligning priorities, unblocking technical decisions, and ensuring delivery stays on course. Expect a mix of deep technical design reviews, strategic roadmap discussions with senior leaders, and hands-on problem solving when programs hit ambiguity.

About the team
The FBA team builds and operates the platforms that enable sellers in 135 countries to store, ship, and manage billions of products through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our mission is straightforward: make sellers successful so customers get the selection and value they expect. We are investing in the next generation of seller tools and infrastructure, and this role will be central to shaping that future. If you want to work on programs that operate at massive scale and have a direct impact on both sellers and customers worldwide, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

title: Sr Ground Gas Specialist
descriptionHtml:
As an Amazon Worldwide (WW) Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Ground Gas Specialist you will help protect one of the safest real estate programs in the world. You will partner with stakeholders and teams across Amazon to develop and run our ground gas mitigation program in continental Europe, spanning standards and policy development, implementation, and execution; your work directly reduces environmental and human-health risk across our facilities.
To be successful you will bring strong contaminated-land and ground gas or vapour-intrusion expertise, including risk assessment, mitigation system design, construction, operations, maintenance, and monitoring (OMM); you will understand how ground gas and vapour intrusion are regulated within European contaminated-land frameworks and be able to extend that understanding across the countries in scope. We welcome experienced geo-environmental generalists with demonstrable ground gas exposure, and Amazon will sponsor specialist accreditation and training to deepen your expertise.
This role is based in continental Europe and covers Amazon's European portfolio, coordinating country-specific regulatory work through qualified local partners and consultants. Travel is variable and project-driven, concentrated during site investigation, construction, and startup phases; it is not a fixed continuous commitment.

Key job responsibilities
Provide a single point of contact to internal teams to develop, understand, and execute Amazon's ground gas program in continental Europe, coordinating country-specific coverage through qualified local consultants and partners.
Complete due diligence reviews of properties to assess ground gas risk.
Complete reviews of mitigation system designs, construction plans, and construction verification, startup testing, and OMM data.
Inspect and/or oversee field personnel inspecting systems during construction, startup, and operation to evaluate conditions and confirm design and operating assumptions.
Oversee and direct field personnel providing OMM including developing scopes of work, coordinating and scheduling OMM events, evaluating field reports, and acting-on and implementing follow-up actions.
Support legal, property owner, construction management, preconstruction management, consulting, transaction management, business leadership, and facility operations teams and partners on ground gas risks and intrusion mitigation systems, and operations, maintenance, and monitoring (OMM).
Support and train a wide range of facility operations teams and partners on mitigation systems, monitoring equipment, and OMM.
Review work performed by contractors, developers, and consultants, including local specialists retained for country-specific regulatory work.
Prioritize and lead multiple projects and assignments concurrently.
Represent Amazon at appropriate levels with property owners and their representatives, consultants, and legal advisors to maintain professional and effective relationships.
Travel across continental Europe as needed to support site work, concentrated around active project phases.

07:00 First CPT wave approaching — monitor pick/pack/SLAM throughput on dashboards; flex labor from slower paths to bottlenecks

16:30 Conduct shift handoff with incoming Night shift AM — cover backlog status, open action items, associate callouts, and known risks

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Coalition Accelerator Builder, GNSD
descriptionHtml:
The Coalition Accelerator Builder team is the conversion layer between qualified defence-cloud demand and reusable, deliverable capability. The NSD mission threads and field identify customer challenges and generate demand; this team turns that demand into proven accelerators that ProServe, partners, and regional teams can deliver repeatedly without a specialist in the room.

The accelerator portfolio includes C2CMA (Command and Control Cloud Mission Accelerator), Trusted Secure Enclaves, and CEGA (Cloud Edge Global Access), linked together by the AMF (AWS Mission Framework) to deliver holistically for the mission rather than as isolated point solutions.

You will be one of the first builder hires into this team. Your job is to build, prove, and scale the accelerator portfolio: helping build best-practice guidance and reference architectures, hands-on in the codebase, embedded in live customer delivery, and then codifying what works into repeatable approaches that the wider field can own.

How You Work: The Prove-Then-Scale Model

Your initial validation is direct involvement in customer delivery. You embed alongside ProServe and partner engineers on live engagements, contribute code, solve real deployment problems, and understand what breaks in production defence environments. You then extract that experience into repeatable, tested patterns: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, demo platforms, contribution guides, and enablement collateral. The credibility of everything you produce comes from having built it against real operational need, not in a lab.

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a traditional customer-facing SA role with occasional prototyping. It is a build role. You will write code, own pipelines, and maintain a codebase. Customer exposure comes through embedded delivery, not through pre-sales presentations. If your instinct is to architect on a whiteboard and hand off to someone else to implement, this is not the right fit.

Key job responsibilities
- **Engineer and maintain accelerator codebases.** Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, infrastructure-as-code. You own the shared core that every deployment depends on.
- **Embed in live customer delivery.** Work alongside ProServe and partner teams on funded engagements to validate patterns, fix what breaks, and build credibility for the approaches you will later scale.
- **Build and maintain demo and reference platforms.** Standing environments that prove the accelerators work, support sales conversations, and give partners a validated starting point. This includes environments demonstrating secure-by-design patterns to customers and accreditation bodies.
- **Design and implement automated compliance validation tooling** that maps deployed infrastructure to control frameworks (NATO, NCSC, national standards) and produces auditable evidence.
- **Own contribution standards and code quality.** Define how ProServe and partners contribute to the shared codebase. Review pull requests, enforce Architecture Decision Records, maintain architectural coherence across country-specific extensions.
- **Create technical enablement collateral.** Not marketing decks. Deployment guides, runbooks, architecture walkthroughs, security runbooks, accreditation evidence templates, and hands-on workshops that make non-specialist SAs, Tech BDs, and delivery teams self-sufficient.
- **Drive roadmap delivery.** Execute against the priorities set by the Product Owner and STL. Translate demand signal from the field into shipped capability.
- **Interface across the collaboration model.** Work with ProServe, partners, regional SAs, Tech BDs, and AWS Security. You are the bridge between the team that sets direction and the teams that deliver at scale.

About the team
Coalition Accelerator Engineering sits within GNSD and governs the accelerator portfolio that underpins the AWS defence-cloud go-to-market across allied nations. The team is deliberately small and high-leverage: it builds each capability once, to a standard that holds, and it becomes a repeatable delivery vehicle. You will work directly with the STL, Product Owner, and fellow engineers, and interface daily with BD, ProServe, and partner teams across multiple countries. Each accelerator compounds: what one nation builds, the next fields rather than rebuilds.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control workflows, automated testing, code review, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (Docker, ECS/EKS)

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in defence, national security or government cloud environments, including multi-classification architectures, secure-by-design patterns and strict data separation, ideally with an active or recently held security clearance in a NATO nation (UK SC/DV, US Secret/TS or equivalent).
- Deep DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipeline design, GitOps, automated testing, release management and observability at scale, applied in regulated environments with audit trails and automated compliance evidence or security posture validation, ideally using generative AI or RAG for evidence extraction.
- Deep knowledge of AWS security services (GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM Access Analyzer, KMS, Nitro Enclaves, CloudTrail), container orchestration (EKS/ECS/Kubernetes) and event-driven serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge) across cloud and edge.
- Experience with mission systems (TAK Server/ATAK, geospatial pipelines, C2) or mesh, SD-WAN and overlay networks for contested environments, deployed in field exercises or austere conditions, and a track record of building enablement (documentation, workshops, partner certification) for partner delivery teams in more than one country.

title: Senior Channel Team Lead, On the Road, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
※こちらのポジションは、名古屋の拠点を中心に中部エリアをご担当いただきます。
担当エリアや業務状況により、週3日程度の出張（宿泊を伴う場合有）が発生する可能性があります。

Amazonは、フルフィルメントセンターからデリバリーステーションまで一貫した物流ネットワークを構築・運営しています。デリバリーステーションは、お客様に高品質なサービスを提供するラストマイル配送を担っている部門です。

今回募集するSr. Channel Team Leadは、デリバリーステーションの成長を牽引する中核ポジションです。配送パートナーと密接に連携し、オペレーション管理、品質の継続的な改善、および複雑な課題解決を主導的かつ戦略的に実行することで、カスタマーエクスペリエンス向上・パートナーサクセスに貢献します。

物流・オペレーション未経験の方も歓迎しており、入社後はOJT・トレーニングを通じて、課題解決・プロジェクト推進など、必要なスキルを段階的に習得できる環境が整っています。


■ 業務内容 ■
①オペレーション
担当する複数のデリバリーステーション（3～4拠点）における年間目標（安全・品質・生産性）の達成に向け、改善活動の計画立案、実行、および進捗管理を一貫して行い、目標達成に対する責任を負います。

日々の配送オペレーションにおける課題（需要変動、システムトラブルなど）に対し、Amazonのポリシー・コンプライアンスを遵守しながら、配送パートナーと協働して解決を主導します。

必要に応じ、現状の包括的な分析と客観的な判断基準をマネージャーに明瞭に説明し、適切な戦略的意思決定を促進します。

②プロジェクト
プロセス・システム・テクノロジー導入プロジェクトにおいて、社内の関連部門と連携し、現場導入のプロジェクトチームの一員として役割を実行します。

また、マネージャーの支援を受けて、他部門を巻き込む改善プロジェクトのリーダーとしてプロジェクトマネジメントを行います。

③ レポーティング・情報共有
配送パートナーのパフォーマンスを現場とデータの両側面から分析し、マネージャーへレポーティングを行います。

課題・リスクを分析し、改善案を立案します。また、データドリブンな意思決定を支えるため、各種メトリクスのトレンド分析を通じて本質的な課題を抽出し、定量的な根拠に基づいた優先順位付けを行います。

④ チャネル・パートナーシップマネジメント
配送パートナーに対し、安全・品質・生産性改善のコンサルティングを行い、事業の持続的な成長と安定化を促進します。

配送パートナーのエンゲージメント向上をけん引し、リテンション改善の要となる役割を果たします。

⑤人材開発・文化形成
メンバーの成長を積極的に支援し、会社の就業規則及び各種ポリシーに関する深い理解に基づき、チームメンバーを適切に指導することで、組織の健全性を維持します。メンバーの業務上の懸念事項や課題に傾聴し、必要に応じて適切な専門部署（相談先）と連携するとともに、自律的な問題解決に取り組みます。

リーダーシッププリンシプルを深く理解し、多様性を尊重する組織文化の形成に貢献します。


■教育制度■
入社後、約2か月はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャー・リーダーシッププリンシプル、Amazonの物流ネットワークに関わる知識を学ぶことができる研修の機会を提供しています。本配属後は、トレーナーのもとSr. Channel Team Leadの業務をOJTで学び、各種ツールの使用方法などを習得していく環境を整備しています。


■キャリアパス■
Sr. Channel Team Leadからキャリアをスタートし、シニアエリアマネージャー、リージョナルマネージャーとなるキャリアアップのチャンスがあります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くことができます。Amazonでは自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。


■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。

Amazonには失敗に寛容な文化があります。まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

The Amazon University Talent Acquisition Team is looking for ambitious students to join us as Operations Intern, working in one of our core businesses, Amazon Operations.

Our internships are educational opportunities intended to allow you to discover how we operate. Our IT Support Engineers work behind the scenes to troubleshoot any issues and improve our systems, so that we can operate at our best.
