title: Principal, Senior, Distinguished Engineer, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services, AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring Principal, Senior, and Distinguished Engineers to join AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services.


AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services is redefining how the world stores, serves, and reasons over data in the age of AI. Our vision is to make every byte of enterprise data instantly durable, infinitely scalable, and intelligent by default — so that organizations of any size can turn their data into insight and action. We pair decades of hard-won operational experience with relentless curiosity to build the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on: object storage (Amazon S3), block storage (Amazon EBS), archival storage (Amazon S3 Glacier), analytics and database engines (Amazon Redshift, EMR, SageMaker), and the ultra-high-performance caching layers that make generative AI and analytics fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. We're hiring Principal and Senior Principal Engineers across the org to own technical direction for some of our hardest problems: building a new cache product purpose-built for GenAI and analytics — delivering ultra-low-latency, ultra-high-throughput access to S3 data at exponential scale; setting architecture for S3 storage at the exabyte tier; and driving the engineering direction of SageMaker, Redshift, EMR, and AWS Database Services. These are deep, high-ownership systems roles — some remote-eligible, others anchored to hubs like Seattle, Irvine, and Berlin — for engineers who have led org-wide technical strategy and want to see it run in production. If you want to build systems that operate at planet scale — where durability, availability, latency, and failure-mode ownership are first-class concerns measured in eleven nines — this is the team.

What You'll Do

This is a rare chance to own and ship the foundational services the rest of the cloud is built on — not features on top of a platform, but the storage, data, and caching layers that everything else depends on, operating at a scale no one else in the industry touches. You'll architect systems that store and serve exabytes of the world's most critical data, where a single design decision ripples across hundreds of millions of customers and millions of applications.

The problems here are unlike anywhere else. How do you deliver eleven nines of durability while adding net-new capabilities to a service that already stores hundreds of trillions of objects? How do you build a new cache product that serves S3 data at ultra-low latency and ultra-high throughput for GenAI and analytics workloads growing exponentially? How do you evolve block, object, and archival storage — and the analytics and database engines on top of them — without ever compromising the durability, availability, and latency guarantees customers have bet their businesses on? These are deep systems challenges solved in production, at a scale where the usual playbooks break down. You help write the new ones.

The systems you build here don't sit in a backlog — they're load-bearing for the internet: S3, EBS, and Glacier storing the data behind modern AI and analytics; Redshift, EMR, and SageMaker turning that data into insight; and the next generation of high-performance caching making all of it fast. You'll have direct influence over technical choices, minimal layers between you and decisions, and the opportunity to define what foundational data infrastructure looks like in the AI era.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver strategic technical projects and design new storage, data, and caching systems at massive scale

Lead architecture and engineering strategy for foundational services across S3, EBS, Glacier, and the analytics and database layer (Redshift, EMR, SageMaker, AWS Database Services)

Mentor and guide engineers while solving the hardest durability, availability, and latency problems hands-on

Work cross-functionally with Principal Engineers and teams across AWS Foundational Data & Storage Services

Scout and recruit top technical talent, actively growing the engineering community

Drive a strong engineering excellence and operational culture across all services and teams

Shape technical direction for systems where correctness, durability, and failure-mode ownership are first-class, measured in eleven nines

Balance deep systems expertise with strong analytical skills to make informed architectural decisions at scale

Basic qualifications

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of design, development engineering experience.

Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.

Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.

Preferred qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with large-scale distributed systems, storage or database internals, high-throughput data systems, and performance-critical caching

Experience with big data and analytics engines, containerized microservices, serverless functions, and event-driven architecture

Hands-on experience designing for extreme durability, availability, and latency guarantees in production systems serving at planet scale

title: Sr Technical Program Manager - Business Process, Infrastructure Reliability and Quality (IRQ)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Infrastructure Reliability and Quality (IRQ) Team owns the Quality and Reliability of critical infrastructure equipment for the lifecycle of equipment. This includes leading Design for Reliability (DFR) and Design for quality (DFQ) effort for AWS Infra New Product Development (NPD), supporting/sustaining the existing AWS critical infra equipment fleet by identifying systemic equipment issues, driving root cause analysis (RCA) corrective action to mitigate the risk in the AWS fleet.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for Quality and Reliability for the Mechanical and Power Generation Products, you should be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally. You will lead multi-discipline and highly technical program teams. You should have experience of driving quality and reliability initiatives in a complex engineering environment and will have worked as a technical project manager on increasingly complex projects. Your experience includes data center infrastructure technologies including HVAC, power distribution systems, security devices and controls. You will generate and maintain enhanced reporting, meaningful KPIs, and process/automation improvements to ensure team efficiency and visibility of the portfolio efforts to critical stakeholders and leadership.

You will partner with other engineering teams, purchasing team and project execution/delivery teams regularly. You will make strategic decisions regarding specific projects and overall program direction. You will be capable of connecting long-term strategies with rapid growth patterns of AWS, as well as guide specific operational needs of the business.

You must be adept at identifying and communicating upcoming risks, issues, and bottlenecks as well as be instrumental in resolving those issues, often cross multiple departmental boundaries to achieve your goal. You must possess a strong sense of organization, communication and team building skill-sets that foster robust working relationships for both internal and external stakeholders.



Key job responsibilities

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Leo GBO Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Amazon Leo Global Business & Customer Operations (GBCO) engineering team owns designing, implementing, and operating the planning systems that decide where Leo can be sold, how much capacity is available in each location, and at what price. Satellite capacity is finite and varies by geography, so our systems turn raw network coverage into a trustworthy, sellable inventory plan and enforce that plan at the point of sale so the network is never oversold. We sit between the teams that model what the network can do and the teams that operate it in real time, and we bring the business context that shapes those plans. We are looking for a talented software development engineer to help scale up and optimize the planning and simulation methods at the center of that work: the algorithms and systems that decide which cells to open for service, how much capacity each will deliver, and whether the live network can deliver it. As one of our valued team members, you will be obsessed with matching our standards for operational excellence with a relentless focus on delivering results.

You will not do this alone. You will work closely with partner engineering teams across Amazon Leo. You will lead the system architecture of simulation tooling that spans multiple use cases and users, taking planning and simulation methods and making them faster, larger-scale, and production-ready, with the curiosity to engage with the substance of the problem rather than treat it as a black box.

Beyond the planning and simulation work, you will contribute across the other systems our team owns. Our portfolio spans capacity, demand, pricing, inventory, and reservations, and from time to time you will pick up work on any of them as priorities and dependencies shift, from backend services to data pipelines. You will both operate systems that produce commitments the business plans against and build new ones as Leo scales worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
* Scale up and optimize the planning and simulation methods that turn satellite geometry and demand into capacity and coverage plans, improving their performance, scale, and fidelity.
* Make large problems tractable through sound engineering: decomposition, precomputation, caching, and parallelism, proven out with measured results rather than intuition.
* Build and operate the high-performance data and compute infrastructure (large-scale data stores, columnar query, batch fan-out) that lets planning run quickly.
* Build systems that produce correct, trustworthy results, validating outputs against reference implementations and guarding the accuracy of numbers the business commits to.
* Partner with the teams that model the network's capabilities and the teams that operate it in real time to move methods from demonstration toward production.
* Contribute across the other planning systems our team owns, from backend services to data pipelines, as priorities and dependencies require.
* Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build highly available, scalable software services, and provide operational excellence including monitoring, alarming, and on-call ownership.

Export Control Requirements:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

About the team
Our team is the engineering group within Global Business & Customer Operations (GBCO) for Amazon Leo. We own the systems that connect satellite network capacity to what customers can actually buy: capacity planning, demand planning, pricing, inventory, reservations, and the data platform that ties them together. We started focused on capacity planning and have grown our scope alongside the business, so there is real room to shape new systems as Leo expands globally. We value ownership, operational excellence, and engineers who think across system boundaries.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience working effectively with science, data processing, and software engineering teams
- Experience improving the performance and scale of computationally intensive systems or algorithms.
- Exposure to optimization, simulation, or large-scale numerical or geospatial data processing, or an interest in developing depth in those areas.

アマゾンジャパンのオペレーション部門では、事業拡大のためオペレーションマネージャー（副センター長格）を募集しています。アマゾンは毎日多くのパッケージと笑顔をお客様にお届けし、地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業を目指しています。

当社の「より早い配送」を実現するための最前線のオペレーションの現場を管理する責任を負います。このサイトではチームは20～300 名程度のメンバーで構成されます。数十億円の予算規模の年間の運営計画を立て、その実行責任を負います。分析スキルや問題解決スキル、チームとしてパフォーマンス実現、メンバーと良好な関係構築、コーチングやメンタリングなどの人材管理スキルの成長を期待されると同時にサポートされます。

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、ビジネスの拡大を共に体験し、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからプログラムマネージメントまで、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーとの交流を通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
【キャリアパス】
オペレーションマネージャーは、大きな組織をリードし、サイトリーダーに昇格する機会や、地域統括リーダーへとステップアップする機会があります。また、アマゾンのオペレーションの様々なポジションへのステップアップを模索するオプションがあります。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
- オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
- 物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
- メンバーがより生産的で、パフォーマンスが高く、多様性があり、インクルーシブになるようサポート、指導し、動機付けします。チームメンバーの個人的な成功に対するビジョンとコミットメントを持って、共感を持ってリーダーシップを発揮し、楽しく仕事をし、メンバーに楽しんでもらいましょう。
- Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
- 年間のオペレーション計画を編成し、日次/週次の生産計画と実績確認、短期/長期の需要変動対応、3PLを含む関係者との調整を通じて、コストを管理しながら、年間のオペレーション計画を実行します。
- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

A day in the life
※こちらの職種は日勤帯を中心としたシフト勤務（土日祝日含む交替制勤務）となりますが、職務遂行上必要な場合には夜勤帯で勤務していただく場合もございます。

title: Account Manager, US AVS, Paid Selling Partner Services
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role

Account Manager - Amazon Vendor Services, North America

As an Account Manager you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services. You will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.

AVS team is looking for bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidates to join our team. You will interface with Ecommerce/Digital teams of your assigned vendors and also internally with stakeholders across our Retail Vendor Management and Vendor Services teams, while being responsible for multiple aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize and trouble shoot to grow business for your vendors on Amazon.

You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as, selection, catalogue quality, buying, inventory management, finance, operations, to drive the performance of vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on driving numerous aspects of managing the customer relationships with vendors.

You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of deal activities to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities impacting business.

Timings will be as per North America shift, 3:00 pm IST to 12:00 am IST


Key job responsibilities
•Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.

• Partnering with the Retail Category Team and build successful communication channels at all levels, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan for the vendors.

• Build and execute on a joint business plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.

• Conduct deep dive analysis on vendor issues and publish recommendations and action plans based on data, to improve vendor experience.

• Success will be measured by the performance of your vendors on input metrics and impact on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers.

• Conduct regular business reviews with the vendors, highlight business metric performance and build action plans.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
- 2+ years of sales or account management experience
- Experience with Excel
- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience analyzing key open issues and resolution metrics for each of the managed accounts
- Experience in relationship management within technology, start-ups, or SaaS Platforms

title: HW Lead Engineer, Nitro Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind the custom silicon and systems at the heart of AWS (Amazon Web Services) infrastructure — we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

Our Nitro Cards ("K2") are present in each and every server deployed at AWS, continuously innovating across new technologies, new server platforms, and new cloud services.
Nitro Cards serves critical roles in the server control plane and data path — delivering better performance, greater stability, and higher availability to customers at a global scale.
We work closely with the Nitro Silicon and Nitro Firmware and Software teams across definition, development, and mass production to optimize product value and accelerate time-to-market.
We learn from large-scale production health data and feed those insights back to continuously improve our products and processes.
Our success depends on world-class designs and the ability to deliver them on time, at scale, and with the best possible value for our customers — handling massive scale and the rapid integration of emerging technologies.

We are looking for a HW Lead Engineer to help define, shape, and integrate cutting-edge solutions for the next generation of our cloud platforms.
As a Card Lead Engineer in the Nitro/K2 team you will be responsible for defining Annapurna Labs’ Network Interface Card (NIC) hardware for the Compute a storage servers type, owning the development and validation of Nitro cards,  including readiness for mass production.
You’ll provide leadership in new technologies of the HW interfaces, bringing them to large-scale deployment, in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience. This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you’ll work with technical experts, senior leaders, and multiple areas of technology.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the design and sustain of the Nitro Smart Network Interface Card for CMRI vertical use cases.
- Work with joint design partners and manufacturing sites, to enable healthy mass production of the Nitro card.
- Review, identify, and qualify second-source electrical components, to enable continuity of supply.
- Analyze and debug design/manufacturing/integration issues.
- Continuously assess process capabilities and innovate to simplify processes, reduce costs, and shorten the time cycle of Nitro cards’ development and manufacturing.
- Collaborate with members of cross-functional teams, to gain knowledge and improve product design,  processes, and quality.
- Work with customers, to optimize the entire value stream and put together joint processes that will lead to improved time cycle and lower costs.
- Willing to travel abroad one or two times a year, for a week at a time.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical  Engineering or in related field.
- At least 8 years' experience leading hardware products from design to mass production: life cycle, components selection, schematics, layout, thermal, mechanical design, review, hardware-software interfaces, and production testing.
- At least 6 years’ experience in high-speed board design and practical hardware lab.
- Design/lab experience with at least at one of the following interfaces: DDR , PCIe , Practical experience with high-speed lab equipment.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with mass production products.
- Experience with  Networking/Storage/Linux.
- Knowledge and  understanding of HW PCB architecture and design.
- Experience with CPLD/FPGA coding and simulation.
- Technical leadership, Matrix work with multiple teams.
- Practical experience writing scripts.

title: Electrical Design Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electrical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud and ML/AI models running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the best possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective electrical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want YOU! At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience. If you can design an electrical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data center, and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit. As we grow we are structuring our team to own more of our engineering in house. Engineers will be responsible for taking designs from concept to the permit and construction document set. You must be capable of defining critical equipment specifications and approving equipment submittals. Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

At Amazon team work is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. As this position is based out of Virginia, travel to our head office in Seattle will be required. Travel should be up to 20% of your time, majority throughout the Virginia-based data centers and in-person collaboration efforts not in your assigned office location. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel will be necessary. Support could consist of working on international teams and could require developing schematic and design document packages. An understanding of international electrical design requirements is helpful but not necessary.

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities of the Electrical Engineer, will be:

Data center electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create a construction document set.
Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes.
Review and approval of equipment submittals.
Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems.
Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed.
Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

About the team
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud
platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster
a culture of inclusion that empower us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer.
That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing
resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, hospitals, manufacturing facilities.

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: Multi-Site EHS Manager II
locations: North Las Vegas, NV, United States
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We're seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to directly impact associate wellbeing while driving operational excellence.

As a WHS Manager, you'll be the site's safety champion, leading our Global WHS Program implementation. You'll combine hands-on safety management with strategic thinking to protect our most valuable asset – our people. Your role bridges the gap between safety requirements and operational success, requiring both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. Working closely with Operations leadership, you'll drive safety initiatives that make a real difference. You'll conduct comprehensive risk assessments, analyze safety data, and implement practical solutions that protect associates while supporting productivity. Your ability to build relationships and influence positive change will be essential as you help shape our safety culture. You'll lead safety compliance efforts, conduct thorough site audits, and analyze incident trends to target improvements where they matter most. Managing our first aid program and emergency response capabilities, you'll ensure immediate care is always available. Your analytical skills will transform safety data into actionable insights, while your leadership abilities will help engage associates in our safety mission.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

This position requires the flexibility to travel 50-70% of the time and work various shifts.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in WHS and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations
- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management, or 2+ years of Amazon Safety (blue badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Distribution Center or manufacturing safety experience with mix of exempt and non-exempt employees at a site of at least 250 people preferred.
- Master’s degree preferred
- Experience in a fast-paced, changing/growing organization
- Certified Safety Professional preferred
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort collaborating with site leaders.
- Ability to develop and implement department goals and strategies.
- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability.
- Ability to adapt well to fast-paced environments with changing circumstances, direction, and strategy
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and the use of pivot tables and the development of charts and graphics.
- Ability to manage multiple sites/remotely.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Seller Springboard
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented Software Development Engineer II to join our ISPX Registration team in Bangalore, focusing on building AI-powered solutions that will transform how millions of sellers register and stay compliant on Amazon. As one of the founding engineers in this team, you will have significant technical ownership and influence on our architecture and implementation choices.

You will work directly with LLMs and machine learning systems while developing scalable services that power seller registration, identity verification, and compliance workflows across global marketplaces. This role offers unique exposure to AI technologies while solving real-world problems that impact millions of Amazon sellers from the very first step of their journey.

This role is perfect for a motivated engineer who wants to combine deep technical work with real business impact. You will help transform complex, multi-page registration and compliance processes into a streamlined, AI-powered experience while working alongside experienced engineers and leaders.

Success in this role means delivering scalable, reliable services that power seller onboarding and regulatory compliance while maintaining high standards of code quality and engineering excellence.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities You'll shape the future of e-commerce by tackling complex challenges across the software development lifecycle. Collaborating with business and compliance stakeholders, you'll envision innovative solutions that reduce registration friction and meet regulatory requirements, then design robust, scalable architectures to bring them to life.

During implementation, you'll craft high-quality, reliable code that meets rigorous standards, leveraging your expertise in testing and operations to ensure seamless deployments. But your role won't stop there - as a seasoned engineer, you'll also mentor junior team members, sharing your best practices to elevate the entire organization.

title: Instandhaltungstechniker:in für unseren Standort in Lengede
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life


Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Mindestens zweijährige Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Handwerk

- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

title: Senior Manager, Hardware Engineering, Robotics Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics Technical Services (RTS) is building a central hardware support function to keep the world's largest robotics fleet running, and we are hiring a Senior Manager, Hardware Development to lead it. This leader will own hardware outcomes across the fleet, from readiness of new products, through in-field hardware services, reliability, and maintainability. You will lead multiple teams — Custom Tools, Retrofits, and Problem Management — along with individual contributors, and build the central Hardware Support Engineering capability that partners across every hardware team in Amazon Robotics. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role for a leader with deep hardware expertise who can set strategy, raise the engineering bar, and operate across organizational boundaries as the function grows.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a multi-team hardware organization spanning Custom Tools, Retrofits, and Problem Management, plus individual contributors, with scope expected to expand as the function matures.
- Set the multi-year technical and organizational strategy for central hardware support across Amazon Robotics, defining the mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that keep the world's largest robotics fleet serviceable at scale.
- Act as the central hardware authority partnering across product engineering, deployment, RME, field hardware support, safety, and supply chain teams — aligning priorities and resolving contentious technical trade-offs beyond any single team.
- Build and develop leaders: hire, coach, and grow managers and senior ICs, and raise the engineering and operational-excellence bar across the organization.

You meet cross-functional partners in RME, field support, and supply chain to unblock fleet-wide issues with spare parts and training. You coach a manager on a growth plan, review an escalation, and shape the longer-term strategy for central hardware support — balancing today's field needs against the organization's multi-year direction.

About the team
Amazon Robotics designs and deploys the robotics solutions that power Amazon's fulfillment network. Robotics Technical Services keeps the fleet running. Your organization is the central hardware function — spanning Custom Tools, Retrofits, and Problem Management, and growing into a broader central Hardware Support Engineering capability. descriptionHtml:

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Amazon's Data Center Bridge (DC Bridge) organization builds and operates the software that runs AWS's worldwide data centers. The DC Console team is hiring a senior, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer to set the technical direction for the platform that lets every builder in DC Bridge ship data center operator experiences, not just the team that owns the console.

You should be a senior engineer with real depth in modern TypeScript, React, Rust or equivalent programming language. Browser fundamentals and high-volume real-time UX, and a track record of leading the design of systems other teams build on.

Half of this role is platform engineering (build systems, deployment, and the mechanics of how frontend code gets to a browser), so you should be comfortable owning architecture that spans repositories, pipelines and teams you don't manage. You take personal pride in interfaces operators trust during an incident, and you raise the engineering bar of the people around you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the architecture of the platform that lets engineering teams across the organization ship features into a shared operator console (independent packages, independent pipelines, composed into one product at runtime) and write the design documents that set its direction.

- Define the contract between the console shell and the teams that build on it: navigation, routing, page registration and shared services, versioned so partner teams can upgrade on their own schedule.

- Lead the resolution of the hardest cross-origin problems a federated frontend creates (authenticated module loading, edge authentication, content security policy, per-stage isolation, and graceful fallback when the module registry is unreachable) and make the security trade-offs explicit.

- Drive self-service onboarding end to end, so a partner team gets a working module, account, CDN and pipeline in one step, including teams that bring their own backend. Measure time to first deploy and drive it down.

- Set the operational bar for the platform: per-team health metrics, alarms, paging and user reports, so each feature team owns its own module's quality without owning the shell.

- Plan and lead the migration of existing pages out of the monolith, sequencing work across teams and keeping every rollout reversible behind feature flags.
- Guide the design of real-time visualizations of power and cooling data that operators rely on during site events.

- Influence partner teams through design reviews, security reviews and office hours, so a federated frontend doesn't fragment into ten different products.

- Mentor engineers on the team, review their designs and code, and help grow the next set of technical leads.

You'll split your time between hands-on code (React and TypeScript against Cloudscape, plus AWS CDK infrastructure) and technical leadership: reviewing a partner team's design, deciding how the shell ships a breaking change, or working out why a module loads in one stage and is denied in the next. Each engineer develops against a personal, authenticated copy of the full console. The team leans hard on AI tooling and expects you to shape how it's used, not just use it.

title: Cluster Service Technician, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Summary

The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they're the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you'll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Shift Pattern: This role includes working in non-traditional shift pattern, which may include nights and weekends



Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites



A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You'll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites' equipment to make sure it's working safely. As an RME Technician, you'll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You'll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you'll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You'll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we're known for.

As a Cluster Technician, you'll be assigned a nodal home site that serves as your primary base. However, the role includes an element of travel within your designated cluster of sites. This means you'll move between locations as needed to provide maintenance support, respond to breakdowns, and carry out planned preventative work across multiple facilities. This travel element ensures our sites receive consistent, high-quality technical coverage and gives you the opportunity to broaden your experience across a variety of operational environments.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or completed a 4-year UK certified apprenticeship
- Valid Full UK Driving License is Essential

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- Experience with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and safety standards
- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance

title: InfraOps Support Manager, Operations Management Center (OMC)
descriptionHtml:
The InfraOps Support Manager leads a two-tiered team of engineers within Amazon's Operations Management Center (OMC) -a 24/7/365 team that keeps the technology inside Amazon's 400+ corporate office buildings running across Networking, Audio-Visual (AV), and Print services.

As one of OMC's regional managers, this role owns a segment of the team's follow-the-sun coverage (the model in which AMER, EMEA, and APAC teams hand work across time zones for continuous 24/7 coverage). The manager balances hands-on technical leadership with people management: they run day-to-day operations to meet service levels, develop and coach engineers, build and maintain operational mechanisms, drive operational inspection and continuous improvement, and partner closely with Service Managers/Owners and IT Services partner teams. They work with minimum supervision to deliver operational changes and projects focused on infrastructure services, and thrive in an ambiguous, collaborative environment while building high-performing teams.

Key job responsibilities
On a typical week, an InfraOps Support Manager will:

1. Operational Leadership & Service Delivery

Keep the 24/7 operation healthy and meeting its commitments.

Lead the team to deliver results, ensure the operation runs properly, meets SLAs, and drives the right customer outcomes across Networking, AV, and Print.

Audit work queues and SLA adherence; audit engineers' work to ensure results are high-quality.

Own a portion of follow-the-sun coverage: build and maintain gap-free shift schedules and a sustainable on-call rotation that supports 24/7 operations without burning out engineers.

Manage difficult problems and escalations, identify and mitigate immediate risks before they become roadblocks, and decide when to handle directly versus escalate.

Make operational trade-offs across time, quality, and resources.

2. Operational Inspection & Continuous Improvement

Inspect the operation and make it measurably better.

Perform operational inspection: establish and run mechanisms (e.g., weekly operations reviews) that inspect performance metrics and drive corrective action.

Prioritize root-cause resolution and process improvements; partner with teams to improve mechanisms and drive enhancements.

Dive deep into incident causes, and establish, iterate, and deploy best practices across OMC and its partner teams.

Identify and optimize workflows and best practices for operational excellence.

3. People Management & Talent Development

Build and grow a high-performing team.

Hire, attract, and onboard bar-raising talent; own customized onboarding plans that ramp new engineers quickly.

Set clear performance expectations and provide regular feedback; hold regular 1:1s and team meetings.

Evaluate engineers against the appropriate role guidelines, participate in calibration, and clearly document performance and progression.

Coach and develop engineers toward their career goals; lead the promotion process for those consistently performing at the next level.

Address underperformance by clearly documenting the required change, communicating it respectfully with a timeframe, and seeking guidance from HR and leadership as needed.

Navigate challenging conversations with empathy, escalating or seeking HR/leadership guidance when appropriate.

Create and continuously improve a team environment where every engineer feels valued, trusted, connected, and informed, and support work-life harmony across time zones.

4. Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

Represent the team up, down, and across.

Work closely with Service Managers/Owners and IT Services partner teams to resolve escalations and align priorities.

Communicate the team's mission, vision, and priorities, helping engineers see how their work contributes to organization goals.

Be clear and concise in verbal and written communication (narratives, WBR/MBR/QBR); put the right people in the room; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three levels above.

Write clear documentation and may be accountable for Correction of Error (COE) write-ups.

5. Technical Leadership

Stay close enough to the technology to lead it well.

Maintain a solid understanding of the design approaches and technologies used by the team (Networking, AV, Print) to guide technical decisions and trade-offs.

Lead the team through building, implementing, and managing solutions to difficult operational problems.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in information science, information technology, data science, computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related field or equivalent experience
- Experience managing teams of 5+ support engineers, including resource management, staffing, mentoring, and maintaining best-of-class global engineering teams
- Experience in development or technical support
- 2+ years of leading technology teams as a information technology operations manager experience, or Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 4+ years of professional or military experience
- Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP(S), DNS, and TCP/IP
- 2+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM experience
- Experience in technical support

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of developing a team of technical professionals across multiple locations experience
- Experience in managing an engineering team operating at scale
- Experience supporting video conference and teleconference equipment
- Experience hiring, developing and promoting engineering talent
- ITIL V3 certification

title: Principal Product Manager-ES, Desktop Cloud Visualization (DCV)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

We are AWS Agentic Workspaces, a part of AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS). We are creating a world in which our Customers’ people, teams and AI collaborate securely, from anywhere, on any technical stack, to create value for the world. Our product is a secure, managed environment that hosts and uses automation and agentic AI to increase the productivity and reduce cost of our Customers’ business workflows. It relies on Desktop Cloud Visualization (DCV), our high-performance display protocol, that provides Customers the ability to stream securely from any cloud/data center and network connections. Customers stream applications to simple client machines, focusing on the work rather than the virtualization infrastructure. Our team is part of AWS Applied AI Solutions, a team with a drive to allow millions of Customers to run efficient, safe and fast operations.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to evolve DCV. You will own the vision and deliver the results that scale DCV to thousands of clients and millions of users, across a diverse portfolio of products (e.g. Agentic WorkSpaces Applications, Agentic WorkSpaces Personal, EC2).

You will own the entire DCV portfolio, the success of its Customers and of their Customers. You will partner with our Engineering, Science and Customer Success teams to define the metrics that describe automation and agentic usage and efficiency, guiding Customers into the new era of business processes and ensuring our product delivers them measurable benefits. You will think about the CX of the Customer in all their personas (e.g. IT Administrator, Operator, Engineer, Builder, etc.). You will partner Customers to understand their needs and pains from legacy virtualization solutions, helping them reinvent their business processes to deliver cost and time savings with improved data and visibility. You will treat Agents as first class citizens, ensuring Customers can develop and deploy them safely on the workflows and environments enabled by DCV.

The ideal candidate:

This role is for you if you want to be part of reinventing how companies work. You gain energy from shaping an industry. While you have a track record of delivering simple solutions for complex problems, you know that success requires a strong team and partnerships across multiple functions. You think both long-term and short-term about how our Customers will derive value, and enable your peers, Engineering and Go To Market teams to see and realize the profitable future. You bring clarity to ambiguity, and spot the need for innovation on behalf of our Customers. Your past experience spans across enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML in environments which require security and quality.

Why this role matters:

Entire industries will go through shifts from automation, AI and agentic business. Every organization will need to answer: how do we let people and AI succeed together in their work, with high quality and securely, at near infinite scale. You will be building the answer with our Customers and Teams. This is an opportunity to participate in defining this industry, shaping it to your needs and ambitions.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Lambda EDA
descriptionHtml:
AWS Lambda (https://aws.amazon.com/lambda) is changing the way we think about computing in the cloud. Serverless computing offers customers an exciting new way to create applications, turn business logic and application code into scalable, fault-tolerant production systems without requiring them to be experts in distributed systems, deployment technologies, and infrastructure management.

We are part of AWS Lambda team who is making it easier for developers to build new applications or extend existing systems using serverless technology, by seamlessly integrating services such as DynamoDB, Kinesis, S3, Kafka, ActiveMQ and SQS as "Lambda Event Sources". Our growing team in Seattle has an opening for an experienced engineer who can help us to bring better experience to customers for building data driven applications.


Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain distributed systems that power AWS Lambda's event-driven architecture — connecting Lambda to streaming and messaging services like Kafka, SQS, DynamoDB Streams, and Kinesis
Build and improve scalable, multi-tenant platforms that process billions of events daily for millions of AWS customers
Write clean, well-tested code with high operational standards — you'll own what you build, from design through deployment and production operations
Drive features end-to-end: define technical approach, navigate cross-team dependencies, and deliver with high quality from design through multi-region rollout
Identify and solve ambiguous problems — propose solutions, evaluate tradeoffs, and make sound technical decisions with increasing independence
Participate in on-call rotations, lead operational reviews, and raise the bar on production reliability for your team's services
Contribute to system design, mentor junior engineers, and influence team best practices through code reviews and design discussions
Work across the full development lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring

A day in the life
Morning: you check dashboards for your team's services — systems processing millions of customer events in real time. An alarm fires; you investigate, find the root cause, roll back, and update the runbook.

Mid-morning: you write code — a new feature that improves how the system scales under load. You push a code review and get sharp feedback from a senior engineer that makes the design better.

Afternoon: you join a cross-team design discussion, review a teammate's code (catching a subtle bug), and deploy your own change across multiple regions.

Your code runs infrastructure millions of developers depend on. You own real problems end-to-end, work with experienced mentors, and grow fast. No two days are the same.

About the team
We're a high-impact team within AWS Lambda responsible for event-driven architecture — the systems that connect Lambda to streaming and messaging services like Kafka, SQS, Kinesis, and DynamoDB Streams. Our platform processes billions of events daily for millions of customers worldwide. We value ownership, mentorship, and shipping quality software. Engineers here have real autonomy — you'll own features end-to-end and see your work matter at scale. We support each other's growth, invest in operational excellence, and believe the best ideas can come from anyone on the team.

- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

title: HW Test Development Engineer, Amazon LEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are seeking a Hardware Test Systems Development Engineer to design, develop, and implement comprehensive test solutions for satellite payload phased array antenna hardware design verification. This role requires expertise in analog/digital hardware systems and design, power design, and automated lab test development. The ideal candidate will enhance our hardware design engineering verification process, ensuring our phased array antenna hardware meets rigorous performance specifications for space applications.

You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and have a drive to deliver results. You’ll have relentlessly high standards and be constantly looking for ways to improve. We are looking for individuals who want to reach beyond what is possible today. Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



Key job responsibilities
- Architect, design, build, and operate hardware test systems for satellite hardware design verification at the bring-up, sub-system, and system levels.
- Drive alignment with key partners and stakeholders on verification strategy.
- Collaborate with design engineers to define test requirements and acceptance criteria.
- Build quantitative models (test coverage, reliability, throughput) to inform design trade studies and design modifications.
- Analyze test data and generate comprehensive test reports with recommendations.
- Perform root cause analysis on test failures, lead corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement of the test systems.
- Optimize test coverage, reduce test time, and improve measurement accuracy.
- Stay current with emerging test technologies and industry standards.

A day in the life
Our time is balanced between utilization, critical support, and improvement of existing hardware test systems and designing future systems. This can be hands-on support troubleshooting or utilizing test systems, aligning with partner to define future test needs, and employing engineering best practices and tools. The tasks and daily focus change rapidly, and you will often take on exciting new responsibilities to ensure project success. Expect to address complex problems by diving deep into the data, identifying the scope of the issue, and creating innovative and functional solutions.


About the team
The payload team is responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, validation, qualification, and new product introduction to manufacturing for all satellite payloads. These systems will meet performance requirements as well as environmental and reliability requirements. To this end, the payload team collaborates closely with all the partner teams including silicon, power, mechanical, thermal, modem, RF/Coms system, and SW teams.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- Experience with test plan development, building the necessary test bench infrastructure, developing tests and verifying the design
- 5+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- 3+ years of development/programming/scripting language (Python/Java/Bash/Perl) experience
- Experience designing and planning test conditions, test scripts, and test data sets to ensure appropriate and adequate coverage and control
- Experience using common electronics test equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, function generators, etc)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 1+ years of experience with signal and/or power integrity

title: Equipment Engineer, Equipment Engineering , Equipment Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) in Pasadena, CA, is looking to hire an Equipment Engineer who will aid in AWS’s effort to bring cloud quantum computing services to its worldwide customer base. The candidate will work in a cleanroom environment alongside research scientists and process engineers, keeping complex semiconductor fabrication & characterization equipment in working order. Responsibilities include troubleshooting equipment-related issues, performing preventative maintenance and calibrations, interacting with vendors during the installation of new equipment and scheduled repairs, making self-guided & team-guided improvements to the lab infrastructure, and taking the lead on aspects of our equipment health program. The facility is focused on research and development, which utilizes equipment ranging from reactive ion etchers, to various material deposition tools, to advanced characterization instruments, most of which are classified as vacuum systems. The candidate will evaluate and develop procedures that provide maximum tool up-time for wafer processing and characterization while maintaining the equipment at optimal performance. Candidates must have a demonstrated background in fundamental engineering principles and must have excellent problem solving and communication skills. Successful candidates will have prior experience working in an academic or industrial fabrication facility, or similar. Working effectively within a team environment is critical.

Key job responsibilities
An Equipment Engineer troubleshoots problems related to equipment and other lab infrastructure, then devises and documents the solutions such that the problems can be more easily solved the next time they occur. When necessary, the Equipment Engineer works with field service engineers from the company that manufactured the equipment, scheduling service calls and supervising & documenting those engineers' work in our labs. The Equipment Engineer is responsible for improving the up-time of equipment, which involves developing better preventative maintenance (PM) plans, executing the PMs, performing equipment calibrations, owning equipment health initiatives, implementing new equipment-tracking initiatives in our manufacturing execution system (MES), and obsessing over the details of the equipment such that it can operate at peak performance. The Equipment Engineer may assist with the development and/or implementation of hardware modifications and new lab upgrades. The Equipment Engineer has ownership of equipment and lab spaces and is responsible for the reliable, excellent performance of our labs and everything that operates within it.

title: Data Engineer, Amazon Live Data Engineering, Sciences and Analytics (DESA)
descriptionHtml:
Description Amazon Live is building the future of shoppable video — connecting brands with customers through livestreams, short-form video, and creator-driven content across Amazon Shopping, Fire TV, Prime Video, and social platforms. The product serves millions of monthly viewers, processes billions of events daily across 9 marketplaces, and generates tens of millions of dollars in advertiser revenue, with a goal to reach 100MM+ MAUs and 20K+ brands in the next couple of years.

Amazon Live has a mature, high-performing data platform powering reporting across 9 marketplaces, 14+ dashboards, real-time creator analytics, and a growing suite of AI-native tooling (self-serve analytics agents, agentic operational assistants). The opportunity ahead is to build the next layer on that strong foundation: the team is standing up an intelligence layer — causal measurement, content intelligence, and ranking signals — and that requires a new class of foundational, reusable data assets purpose-built for both analytics and ML consumption. This role builds them.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the DESA team as a dedicated owner of forward-looking data architecture. You will design and build durable, well-modeled datasets that serve three consumers at once: the BIE for executive reporting, the Applied Scientists for model training, and downstream ML systems (ranking, personalization, recommendations) for feature consumption. The goal is leverage — build an asset once, serve many use cases, and let the whole team move faster on top of it. Your work becomes the foundation the science function builds on: when the data assets are ready ahead of need, scientists model from day one instead of waiting on bespoke pipelines.

This is a high-ownership role on a team that moves fast. You will go from problem to production quickly, in a challenging and fast-paced environment, and you will work across the full breadth of the data domain — platform engineering, data modeling, ML-ready feature production, data quality, and AI-assisted development. You will partner closely with Applied Scientists, MLEs, fellow Data Engineers, and the BIE, giving you the opportunity to learn and execute across every aspect of a modern data organization — from raw event ingestion through the models and reporting that move multi-million-dollar business decisions.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build a content metadata layer that unifies broadcast events, product catalog data, creator profiles, and show metadata into reusable assets consumed by both dashboards and models.
- Build cross-session shopper profile datasets that sessionize event data across visits and compute rolling engagement metrics (frequency, recency, depth, conversion lag).
- Build integration pipelines connecting retail catalog and advertising performance data into the Amazon Live platform, unlocking new dimensions for analytics and ML.
- Produce structured, ML-ready datasets that feed Applied Scientists' models and serve features to downstream ranking and personalization systems.
- Own and advance data quality: proactive monitoring and anomaly detection so the team stays ahead of issues.
- Advance platform engineering maturity — CI/CD for ETL (BDT/Maestro), standardized deployment, and AI-assisted code generation and review.
- Partner with Applied Scientists, MLEs, DEs, and the BIE to align data assets to model, serving, and reporting needs.

A day in the life
You will move fast across a broad surface. Some weeks you will be designing a denormalized content metadata asset with an Applied Scientist to unblock a new model; other weeks you will be integrating a retail or advertising data source, hardening a pipeline's CI/CD, building data-quality alarms, or packaging features for the distribution team's ranking systems. You will partner daily with scientists, MLEs, DEs, and the BIE — scoping what to build and how it will be consumed — and you will have self-serve analytics agents and agentic operational tooling to accelerate your work (and a hand in extending that tooling as the platform grows). The pace is quick, the problems span the full data lifecycle, and the ownership is real.

About the team
The DESA team owns the data platform, analytics, and sciences for Amazon Live and Shop the Show. descriptionHtml:
The Security Service Assurance Specialist will be part of the team which is responsible for demonstrating the security controls of services offered by AWS. This position will be focused on the Security Assurance function, leading on day-to-day security assurance activities, evaluating compliance and providing evidence of how they meet the requirements of our most security conscious customers.

At AWS we are obsessed with earning and maintaining customer trust. This role facilitates our ability to build and maintain that trust through our internal Security Assurance processes and mechanisms. Ideal candidates will have the ability to learn and comprehend security control implementations and operational effectiveness, AWS services, and IT and cloud auditing processes. They will also be able to evaluate opportunities for improvement, and influence across organizations and teams.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with internal teams and customers to establish baselines and agree the security requirements and associated security controls.
• Manage requests for evidence relating to key security controls, by working in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
• Responsible for reviewing the security of proposed new AWS systems, networks, and software designs for potential system security risks, and resolving integration issues related to the implementation of new services within the existing cloud infrastructure.
• Liaise between key stakeholders and AWS technical communities to articulate security control implementation.
• Dive deep into the Amazon control environment to develop broad domain and technical understanding of our security activities and control implementations to enable these to be articulated to both customers and internal/external stakeholders.
• Work across a wide variety of AWS teams to establish and maintain information security documentation.

A day in the life
Our customer needs to work with the most secure AWS services, this role will work with AWS security teams to ensure that our services meet a high security bar before they get into customer control. This will involve performing security assessments and working with teams to support threat modelling on AWS services. Each change to a service represents a new risk, so this role will ensure changes are adequately assessed and any vulnerabilities addressed. If you have worked with security assurance or compliance in the past, this role could be a perfect fit!

About the team
This role sits within the Security Assurance Team. This team covers AWS service and physical security assurance.

- 2+ years of professional experience in performing technical assessments or audits within a cloud environment, including working knowledge of foundational security principles and industry best practices.
