title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, OIS NANO
descriptionHtml:
Own the network and device technology infrastructure strategy for Amazon's fastest-growing Quick Commerce operation across an entire country. As the single-threaded infrastructure owner, you'll define the technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, and enable hundreds of sites to launch at unprecedented speed while maintaining enterprise-grade availability and cost optimization.

Key job responsibilities
As an TIPM with the Network and Assets for Nimble Operations (NANO) Team you will:
- Define country-level infrastructure strategy by establishing architecture standards and readiness criteria that guide all site launches, ensuring consistency and quality across the fleet
- Own end-to-end network infrastructure scope from vendor selection through service level agreement governance to financial outcome management, driving performance and cost efficiency
- Identify and recommend end-user equipment (associate-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers) that meet regional cost and performance targets, partnering with device technology teams for certification
- Establish playbooks, architecture standards, and deployment sequencing for the country, stepping in at escalation points where selections carry fleet-wide implications beyond execution-level authority
- Drive network availability outcomes, device fleet health, and financial performance across the country's fleet through structured vendor governance cadences and performance management

A day in the life
You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction compared to traditional models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor selections that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
We are the Network and Assets for Nimble Operations (NANO) team within Operations Infrastructure Services. We exist to solve a singular challenge: enabling Amazon Operations to launch and operate thousands of small-footprint sites at speed, at scale, and at a fraction of traditional infrastructure cost. We own the full infrastructure lifecycle — network strategy, vendor contracts, site launches, incident management, and financial governance — across India, United States, Middle East, United Kingdom, and Japan. Quick Commerce dark stores represent the overwhelming majority of our use cases today, scaling from approximately 500 sites to 3,000+ by 2028, with our enablement model extending to every emerging no-capex site type in Amazon's portfolio.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

- Experience in stakeholder and communication management
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 6+ years of program management experience in IT infrastructure delivery
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment while prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities
- Ability to successfully facilitate collaboration across multiple functions, departments, and levels

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities

title: Business Development Manager, Amazon Shipping

Amazon Shipping Spain is just three years old — still a young, fast-moving organization with a startup mentality. You won't join a fully built machine but you'll help shape what it becomes.

You'll own the full sales cycle: building pipeline, identifying opportunities, and closing deals. There's no standard pricing playbook here — every deal is personalized. • Startup autonomy backed by Amazon's scale.
• Influence on product direction based on what you hear from the market.
• Career growth in a business still defining its trajectory, with direct exposure to senior leadership.
• Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Operations, Finance, and more.

You'll thrive here if:
• You're energized by building and scaling, comfortable wearing multiple hats.
• You have a proven track record owning the full sales cycle — from cold outreach to closing and growing accounts. This is indispensable.
• You're a strong negotiator who can structure non-standard, tailored deals while keeping a sharp eye on profitability.
• You build strong relationships with customers and internal teams alike.
• You can find the best solution for a customer — even when it doesn't exist yet.

As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

title: Software Development Manager, ICON
descriptionHtml:
The Intelligent Cloud Hosting (ICON) team is looking for a Software Development Manager who is passionate to work on the development of innovative software products which will help boost engineers productivity in Amazon, for improving services' posture towards security, availability, efficiency, compliance and maintainability. We aim to eliminate vast quantities of undifferentiated work for Amazon development teams - our opportunity for impact to tens of thousands of developers is enormous.

As the Software Development Manager for ICON's team in Dublin, you are a hands-on leader who guides engineers building the AI native factory that produces automation to operate on Amazon's production infrastructure. Your team owns the test pipeline that validates every workflow before it reaches production, builds workflows that run at Amazon scale, and contributes core capabilities to the factory. ICON operates critical services that power the Amazon shopping experience. Keeping those services healthy has required manual runbook authoring, interrupt-driven toil, and undocumented expertise held by individual engineers. The factory replaces that work with validated automation.

Engineers describe operational intent in natural language, and the factory produces a validated, production-ready workflow tailored to that service's unique context. An engineer describes a routine change, such as moving a service to a new instance type during the next maintenance window, and the factory generates, validates, and executes the workflow. Engineers state the outcome they need, and the factory supplies the operational knowledge, safety checks, and execution steps.

We are an AI-native team. We use AI across every aspect of our work, from workflow generation and validation to execution monitoring and continuous learning. The factory uses AI agents grounded in Amazon's operational history to generate, validate, and improve every workflow it delivers.

On this team, AI-native leadership is a daily practice. You use LLMs and agents in your own work, from drafting designs and analyzing operational data to reviewing code and preparing business reviews. You set the standard for how your team builds with AI, measure the productivity gains, and share what works across the organization. You understand how agentic systems behave in production: where they succeed, how they fail, and which guardrails keep them safe.

Key job responsibilities
– Own the technical vision, roadmap, and architecture for your team's scope, and deliver it end-to-end as the factory takes on new classes of operational work.
– Own the test pipeline that every generated workflow passes before production, and use automated evaluation and execution data to measure correctness and catch regressions before release.
– Partner with service teams to find high-toil operational tasks and turn them into validated, reusable workflows that run at Amazon scale.
– Contribute core capabilities to the factory, and align with partner teams on shared architecture and roadmap.
– Expand the share of operational work that agents own end-to-end, moving each workflow in stages from human-approved execution to supervised autonomy.
– Make the higher-stakes tradeoffs that come with AI in production: autonomy versus approval, speed versus safety, and model capability versus cost.
– Set a safety-first bar for production: separate fast experimentation from production-grade automation, establish operating best practices for traditional and AI-powered workloads, and own risk mitigation and escalations.
– Lead your team's adoption of AI development tools, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and share proven practices with partner teams.
– Hire, retain, and grow a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists who ship AI-native products at Amazon scale; set clear goals, give regular feedback, and manage performance.
– Earn adoption across service teams by making the factory effortless to use and trustworthy in production, and prove its value through measurable results in hours saved and execution success.

A day in the life
As the Dublin SDM, you balance engineering execution, technical judgment, and people leadership. A typical week might look like this:

• Reviewing a design for a new test pipeline stage that applies lessons from a recent operational event, so every generated workflow is checked against that failure mode.
• Meeting with a partner team about a repetitive operational task, and leaving with a plan to turn it into the next automated workflow.
• Aligning with partner teams on a shared platform capability your engineers are contributing.
• Pairing with a scientist on your team on how to score workflow quality automatically, so the platform improves with every run.
• Coaching an engineer through their first design review, helping them reason about blast radius and rollback for automation that runs in production.

Your team uses AI in its own engineering work, from design and prototyping to testing and deployment.

About the team
Our team builds and operates the AI-native factory that produces automation for Amazon's production infrastructure. The Dublin team owns the factory's test pipeline and workflow delivery, and contributes core factory capabilities. We are an AI-native team that uses AI across every aspect of our work, from workflow design and code generation to validation and operational monitoring. ICON hosts Amazon's customer-facing websites and backend services, centralizing management and automation so developers across Amazon can focus on customer innovation.

If you want to build at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and operational automation, and build the safeguards that let engineers rely on AI-generated automation in production, we would like to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience managing teams, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large-scale distributed systems or web services
- Track record of partnering with product, program, and technical leadership to define strategy and priorities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy

title: Sr. Simulation Scientist, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Are you inspired by invention? Do you want to see how your work impacts the bigger picture? If yes, you'll fit right in at Amazon's Last Mile Simulations and Analytics Engineering team.

The WW AMZL Simulations and Analytics Engineering team drives innovation across our Last Mile network delivery stations through digital twin technology and the seamless integration of process engineering, physics, design, technology, and robotics. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do. If you're interested in joining a rapidly growing team building a unique, solutions-advisory group with a relentless focus on the customer, you've come to the right place.

This is a blue-sky role where you'll roll up your sleeves and dive into big data sets to build digital twins—discrete event simulations, robotics models, and physics-based 3D simulations using tools like Flexsim, AnyLogic, and Emulate 3D. You'll develop experimentation systems at scale, integrating process workflows, physical dynamics, facility design, emerging technologies, and robotic automation to create comprehensive virtual replicas of our operations. Build optimization algorithms and leverage advanced technologies across Amazon. This is an opportunity to think big about solving challenging problems for our customers.

As a Senior Simulation Scientist, you'll deep dive into complex problems and drive relentlessly towards innovative solutions with cross-functional teams. You'll interface and influence various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organization. Lead strategic digital twin and simulation projects that integrate process design, physics modeling, technology innovation, and robotics to drive operational decisions. Your expertise in synthesizing and communicating insights to audiences of varying technical sophistication will enable you to answer specific business questions and innovate for the future. You'll apply advanced multi-disciplinary methodologies—combining process optimization, physics simulation, design thinking, and robotic systems—to complex use cases across the Last Mile network. You'll also contribute to the end-state vision for digital twin simulation and experimentation of future delivery stations at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of the simulation data science solutions to perform system of systems discrete event simulations for significantly complex operational processes that have a long-term impact on a product, business, or function using FlexSim, Demo 3D, AnyLogic or any other Discrete Event Simulation (DES) software packages
• Lead strategic modeling and simulation research projects to drive process design decisions
• Be an exemplary practitioner in simulation science discipline to establish best practices and simplify problems to develop discrete event simulations faster with higher standards
• Identify and tackle intrinsically hard process flow simulation problems (e.g., highly complex, ambiguous, undefined, with less existing structure, or having significant business risk or potential for significant impact
• Deliver artifacts that set the standard in the organization for excellence, from process flow control algorithm design to validation to implementations to technical documents using simulations
• Be a pragmatic problem solver by applying judgment and simulation experience to balance cross-organization trade-offs between competing interests and effectively influence, negotiate, and communicate with internal and external business partners, contractors and vendors for multiple simulation projects
• Provide simulation data and measurements that influence the business strategy of an organization. Write effective white papers and artifacts while documenting your approach, simulation outcomes, recommendations, and arguments
• Lead and actively participate in reviews of simulation research science solutions. You bring clarity to complexity, probe assumptions, illuminate pitfalls, and foster shared understanding within simulation data science discipline
• Pay a significant role in the career development of others, actively mentoring and educating the larger simulation data science community on trends, technologies, and best practices
• Use advanced statistical /simulation tools and develop codes (python or another object oriented language) for data analysis , simulation, and developing modeling algorithms
• Lead and coordinate simulation efforts between internal teams and outside vendors to develop optimal solutions for the network, including equipment specification, material flow control logic, process design, and site layout
• Deliver results according to project schedules and quality


A day in the life
If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

-PhD, or Master's degree and 5+ years of quantitative field research experience
-Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive etc.
-Experience communicating qualitative research methods and findings to non-qualitative researchers

Preferred qualifications

-Experience with discrete and continuous optimization methodologies and algorithms

title: Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:

With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Key job responsibilities

title: Process Engineering Manager, RMTO Process Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is located in the greater Boston area, the epicenter of robotics innovation. Our diverse team of engineers come from all over the world to design, test, and build our dynamic fleet of robots and mechatronic systems. Having our offices, labs, test floors, and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build, and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in autonomous movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more.

The Amazon Robotics (AR) Robotics Manufacturing and Technical Operations (RMTO) organization manufactures high-quality robotics and gets the right materials to the right place at the right time to enable our automated solutions.

The Process Engineering Manager will independently lead a team of engineers responsible for developing, installing, validating, and optimizing complex manufacturing processes and systems with considerable impact across the Robotics manufacturing business. You will be accountable for the structure and strategic direction of your team, determining the right mix of engineers and where they need to be located to meet business needs. You will set the vision and tenets that guide how your team makes decisions, and your roadmap will influence broader organizational goals, including participation in Amazon’s annual planning process.

You will partner with Supply Chain, Engineering, Facilities, and Operations teams, and regularly communicate with senior management on status, risks, and change control. You will prioritize high-impact projects, obtain approval from relevant functional leaders, schedule resources, and drive crisp decisions about which work is essential, which can be triaged, and which can be omitted. You will build a team that delivers successfully without you, coaching engineers to make smart trade-offs and take end-to-end ownership of the systems they build.



Key job responsibilities
- Actively support and foster a culture of inclusion.
- Coach and mentor a team that owns process development and optimization for new products.
- Set your team’s vision, tenets, and roadmap; participate in Amazon’s planning process.
- Implement technology and tool improvements that impact Safety, Quality, and Cost targets.
- Perform critical process reviews, including Risk and Hazard assessments.
- Lead the development and validation of processes specific to NPI (New Product Introduction) programs.
- Write business and operational planning documents for capital equipment and plant infrastructure.
- Coordinate cross-functional development work across teams and all levels of the organization, delegating to TPMs or senior engineers as appropriate.
- Define audit mechanisms and metrics that explain team performance and variance against goals.

A day in the life
You will balance hands-on technical judgment with team leadership, questioning proposals and assumptions when you are involved while empowering your engineers to own their systems end-to-end. You will drive mindful discussions that lead to clear decisions, structure projects to reduce exposure to classic failure modes (unclear requirements, ineffective collaboration, insufficient testing), and recommend reviews with Senior/Principal Engineers when solutions risk adding complexity or impairing future innovation. descriptionHtml:
Amazon Corporate Security is looking for an experienced, self-motivated, corporate security leader who embodies Amazon’s Leadership Principles, in particular, Customer Obsession, Ownership, Earn Trust, and Bias for Action, to join the team as an Area Security Manager for Seattle, WA. The Area Security Manager reports to a Regional Security Manager, who leads a team of security experts.

The Security Manager is responsible for implementation of all elements of the Corporate Security program at all Amazon corporate locations in their area of responsibility. The Security Manager supports the Regional Security Manager with delivery and oversight of the day-to-day security operations at multiple sites across multiple locations in a highly ambiguous and dynamically fluid environment. The Security Manager conducts security assessments, ensures that the corporate sites meet or exceed all requisite security standards, and manages incidents and supporting crisis response. Finally, the Area Manager provides security consultancy to local business leadership, develops plans to mitigate gaps in security controls, and manages the guarding and access control programs.

Key job responsibilities

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical infrastructure that powers one of the world's largest and most complex networks? Amazon is looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to take on a technical leadership role in the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of our data center infrastructure systems. In this role, you will tackle ambiguous, high-impact problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will serve as a key technical resource, guiding infrastructure strategy and influencing decisions that shape the long-term reliability and efficiency of our facilities. If you are a collaborative problem solver who thrives on simplifying complex systems and mentoring others, we want to hear from you.


Key job responsibilities
• Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
• Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
• Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well-thought-out products.
• Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.

• Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.

• Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
• Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
• Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.

title: Senior Industrialization Engineer, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Industrialization Engineer to lead manufacturing and industrialization activities for New Product Introductions (NPI) from prototype to high-volume production. You will own the translation of product design intent into scalable manufacturing workflows, consult on Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and partner with internal partners and external suppliers to achieve volume output based on business demands.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

As a Senior Industrialization Engineer, you work within the strategy and standards set by the team’s Principal Engineers, you develop the detailed manufacturing process, stand up production lines, and lead ramp-up activities at large-scale contract manufacturers (CMs). You are measured on getting real product out the door: lines that hit their takt time, OEE, and yield targets, and a repeatable process that scales across sites.

You will spend meaningful time on the factory floor diagnosing bottlenecks, balancing lines, and partnering directly with CM engineering teams to resolve the issues that stand between a design and dependable high-volume output.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel to our data centers (located throughout AMER region), contractor manufacturer visits, and yearly team off-sites are required. Domestic travel is ramp-driven: 30–50% during active production ramps, tapering between platform launches. International support will be part of the job and some international travel may be necessary.

Key job responsibilities
- Manufacturing Process Development: Develop and document the detailed manufacturing process, workstation definition, work content, line balancing, and takt time, translating the team’s manufacturing strategy into executable production plans.
- Capacity & Scale Planning: Build the capacity models and scaling approach for each product, deciding how the process ramps from low-volume builds to serialized production across sites, then validate the plan against real line performance.
- Production Line Build & Ramp: Stand up production lines at contract manufacturers and lead ramp-up from low-volume builds to serialized production, maintaining presence on the factory floor until OEE targets are met.
- Tooling, Fixturing & Automation: Specify and validate tooling, fixturing, and automation/robotics appropriate to the volume and product, and confirm they perform on the line.
- Process Analysis & Optimization: Use simulation, process flow analysis, and ergonomics to identify bottlenecks and drive yield improvement, cost reduction, and throughput gains.
- CM Execution & Qualification: Partner day-to-day with CM engineering teams to qualify processes against defined standards and ensure consistent, repeatable output across lines and sites.
- Design-for-Manufacturability Feedback: Work with the product design team to flag manufacturability risks early and feed line-level constraints back into design before high-volume commitment.
- Issue Resolution: Lead the resolution of production issues on the floor, partnering with Quality and Reliability to separate design defects from process/line inefficiencies and restore stability.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Preferred qualifications

- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)

title: Sr. Partner Success Manager, eero
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Partner Success Manager to lead and scale eero’s most strategic internet service provider (ISP) partnerships. This role encompasses technical business development and customer success with full ownership of partner outcomes—from onboarding and deployment through long-term growth and expansion.

You will operate with a partner development mindset, owning performance across eero hardware sales and recurring software services adoption. You’ll shape partner strategy, forecast demand, and drive expansion while ensuring strong execution across the full partner lifecycle.

Partner Success Management is part of the Operations team at eero, and this role partners closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Legal, and Manufacturing Operations.

This position requires regular travel to meet with partners on-site (~20%).

Key job responsibilities
Own Partner Performance and Growth: Lead a portfolio of large and mid-sized ISP partners, with full accountability for business performance, adoption, and expansion. Develop and execute multi-year partnership strategies aligned to partner goals and eero priorities.

Drive Commercial and Go-To-Market Initiatives: Identify and execute growth opportunities across pricing, packaging, and go-to-market. This includes supporting marketing and sales efforts with ISP partners, shaping joint campaigns, and implementing non-standard agreements to meet partner needs.

Lead Onboarding, Launches, and Lifecycle Management: Own the full partner lifecycle from onboarding through scaled deployment. That includes ensuring fast, high-quality launches, driving early adoption, and maintaining momentum post-launch. You’ll coordinate closely with supply chain and operations to align demand planning, inventory, and rollout timelines.

Act as a Trusted Advisor to Partner Leadership: Build deep relationships with partner executives and decision-makers. Influence partner roadmaps and customer experience strategies. Represent eero in high-visibility engagements including QBRs and executive reviews.

Steer Product Strategy: Translate partner needs into clear product requirements and strategic inputs for Product and Engineering teams. Advocate for roadmap prioritization that unlocks scaled partner value. Bring market insights back to eero to inform broader strategy.

Lead Complex, Cross-Functional Projects: Orchestrate cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Sales, Ops, Legal, Finance) to deliver against partner commitments. This includes managing large-scale deployments, negotiating tradeoffs, and removing blockers to keep programs on track.

Operate with Data and Rigor: Define success metrics and track performance across partner programs. Strong financial acumen is critical—you’ll model scenarios, evaluate tradeoffs, and ensure programs deliver against revenue and margin goals.

Scale What Works: Build repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and processes. Identify opportunities to automate and standardize partner workflows.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience structuring and negotiating complex agreements and leading cross-functional groups to orchestrate and successfully complete deals
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software

Preferred qualifications

- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech , TPA5 RME
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and intern/co-ops should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.

Please note that by applying to this role you would be considered for System Development Engineer summer intern and spring/fall co-op roles on various Robotics teams. You will be able to provide your preference of location and start date during the application process but, we cannot guarantee that we can meet your selection based on several factors including but not limited to the availability and business needs of this role. Finalization on the location and start dates available will be provided to you at the time of job offer.


Key job responsibilities
- Create, improve, or invent tools and/or applications that are a part of a larger system
- Build and operate a supportable product or service, and is making significant technical contributions to it
- Write code that is secure, stable, testable, maintainable and has minimal defects
- Understand a variety of technologies such as hardware, software, networking, and operating systems, and how they interact with one another
- Build systems and processes that enable other builders through improved safety, agility, and automation
- Seek to learn the business context and technologies behind your team’s system implementations

A day in the life
As an Amazonian, you will be matched to a manager and a team, and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and work on critical projects early in your career.

In addition to working on impactful projects, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in various activities. We give you the tools to own your projects and learn in a real-world settings.

Basic qualifications

- Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related discipline
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Experience coding, scripting, automating in at least one language (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, Ruby, or PowerShell)
- Experience with open-source technologies (e.g. Linux, Spring, React)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with TCP/ICP networking fundamentals and application of IP protocols such as: DNS, DHCP, NTP, SMTP, and SNMP
- Experience with distributed computing, programs and systems
- Experience with automating and simplifying team development, test, and operations processes
- Strong object-oriented design and coding skills developing on Unix-like operating systems

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Japan はビジネスの成長をサポートする新しいフルフィルメントセンター,インバウンドクロスドック,アウトバウンドソートセンターなどFirst Mile/Middle Mileの新規サイト立ち上げおよび数十の既存サイトにおける改造プロジェクトにおいて、設置されるマテハン機器や自動化設備の安定稼働に向けて設備の安全性や品質、信頼性、生産性の改善を技術的にリードする Senior Engineer を探しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンのグローバルチームや国内外のサプライヤーと協力し共に成長しながら技術的なリーダーシップを発揮し、安全性やコストバランスを維持しつつ設備およびプロセスの能力と品質を最大化させます。また、オートメーションを含む最新鋭の搬送設備の導入に伴い新たに発生する技術課題に対しても状況に応じて最適なソリューションを提案し、関係するステークホルダーとの合意形成をとりながらタイムリーに解決へ導くことで新規ソートセンターの立ち上げを成功させ、日本のお客様へお届けする商品のリードタイム短縮と輸送コスト削減に貢献します。そして幅広い技術力や経験知を指導することでチーム全体の技術力を底上げし、さらに設備仕様や業務プロセスの標準化へつなげていくことで技術のスケールアップにも貢献します。下記が主な業務となります。
- 日本のオペレーションが計画する中期および年次計画に基づいてフルフィルメントセンターおよびソートセンターの立ち上げを実現すること。
- 設備の技術問題に対して重大性や影響度を迅速かつ正確に捉え、状況に応じて安全、日程、品質、コストの全体最適となるソリューションを提案し解決させること。
- 既存のコミュニケーションチャネルとワークプロセスの更なる改善を行い、社内外のステークホルダーとの信頼関係を構築しながらコンフリクトを解消し合意形成に結び付けるようマネージすること。
- グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと連携し、最先端の設備や業務プロセスを日本に導入して、入出荷能力の向上や業務効率化を図ること。また、日本のベストプラクティスはグローバルへ提案し標準化すること。
- 国内外の協力会社と連携するだけでなく、継続的にそれら協力会社の能力を高め、安全性・品質の向上と低コスト化を推進すること。
- 安全基準とエンジニアリング指針に則り、標準作業作りなどを通してメカニズムを構築し安全な職場を実現すること。

Amazon Japan is seeking an Senior Engineer to manage the construction of the material handling equipment and automation equipment, verify the operational capability, and start up the new fulfillment center/IB cross-dock/OB sort center that handles First mile/Middle mile delivery. This position will demonstrate technical leadership while working and growing with Amazon's global team and domestic and international suppliers to maximize facility and process capability and quality while maintaining safety and cost balance. In addition, we propose optimal solutions for new technical issues that arise with the introduction of state-of-the-art transportation equipment, including automation. By guiding them, we will successfully launch a new sort center and contribute to shortening lead times and reducing transportation costs for products delivered to Japanese customers. In addition, by teaching a wide range of technical skills and empirical knowledge, we will raise the technical skills of the entire team, and furthermore, we will contribute to the scale-up of technology by leading to the standardization of equipment specifications and business processes.
The following are the main duties.
- Realize the launch of fulfillment centers and sort centers based on the mid-term and annual plans planned by the Japanese operations.
- Quickly and accurately grasp the severity and impact of technical problems with equipment, and propose and resolve solutions that optimize overall safety, schedule, quality, and cost, depending on the situation.
- Further improve existing communication channels and work processes, build relationships of trust with internal and external stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and manage to build consensus.
- Collaborate with global engineering teams and introduce new technology and processes to Japan to improve shipping and receiving capabilities and improve business efficiency. In addition, Japan's best practices should be proposed globally and standardized.
- In addition to collaborating with partner companies in Japan and overseas, continuously improve the capabilities of these partner companies, and promote improvements in safety and quality as well as cost reductions.
- According to safety standards and engineering guidelines, create a mechanism through the creation of standard work, etc., and realize a safe workplace.

Key job responsibilities
- マテリアルハンドリングや各種自動化設備の設置から試運転テストそして検収プロセスをリードする。
- Amazon 社内関係者や外部ベンダーとの信頼関係を構築しながら安全と品質、コストの全体最適を考慮した上で技術的課題やコンフリクトを解決し、計画どおりのプロジェクト遂行をリードする。
- グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと協力して、新しい安全・品質の管理プロセスまたは標準を日本に導入し、また日本のベストプラクティスをグローバルチームに提案して展開します。

- 最高の価値と競争力を実現するために、調達やその他ビジネス パートナーへの設備仕様と技術サポートを提供する。

- Lead the installation of material handling and various automated equipment, commissioning tests and acceptance inspection processes for both new site launch and also legacy site retrofit/expansion.
- Resolve conflicts after considering overall optimization while building trusting relationships with Amazon internal stakeholders and external vendors, and lead the project in a short period of time with high quality and low cost.
- Collaborate with global engineering teams to introduce new safety and quality management processes or standards to Japan, and propose and deploy the best practices in Japan to global teams.
- Dive deep on technical details to identify and solve the technical problems and to build a mechanism or standard that leads to recurrence prevention.
- Assist in providing equipment specifications and technical support to procurement and other business partners for best value and competition.

A day in the life
一週間に 3~4 日を工事中のサイトで勤務し現場の工事安全を統括リードし、各ベンダーや関係部署にまたがる複雑な技術課題の解決をリードします。グローバルチームメンバーと協業しながら業務プロセスや標準の改善に向けてドキュメントを作成し提案、実行します。業務を進めるうえで何か迷うことがあれば、チャットや F2F の会話を通して気軽に相談しながら、チーム全体でサポートし合います。フレックスが基本ですが、原則 18 時以降は会議やメールは行いません。有給休暇の取得率も高く長期休暇も、もちろん取得可能です。

An acting site lead works 3 to 4 days per week in a site under construction, leading safety management and solving complex technical issues that cross vendors and other departments. Propose, and implement documents to improve work processes and standards while collaborating with global team. If they have any questions while working, feel free
to consult other members through chat or F2F conversations, and the entire team will support each other. Flextime is the norm, and generally there are no meetings or emails after 6pm. We have a high rate of paid vacations, and of course they can take long vacations.

About the team
チームメンバーは総勢36名で、年間 2～4サイトの新規サイト立ち上げるおよび数十の既存サイトにおける改造プロジェクトにおいて、現場リード 1 名と施工管理者複数名が着工から稼働までプロジェクトを指揮します。 チームメンバーは機械・電気工学から建設の分野までさまざまなバックグラウンドを持っていますが、定期的なチームミーティングや現場レビューを通じてお互いの知識や経験を共有し、オープンな議論を行っています。 そうすることで個人のスキル向上を促しながら、チームとしての成長を目指しています。

There are 36 members in the team, and in order to launch 2 to 4 new greenfield sites and multiple legacy site retrofit projects per year, a site deployment lead and multiple construction managers per site will lead the project from the start of construction to go live. Team members have various backgrounds ranging from mechanical and electrical engineering to architectural design, but through regular team meetings and on-site reviews, they share their knowledge and experience and engage in open
discussions. By doing so, we aim to grow as a team while improving individual skills.

title: Senior Specialist Solution Architect, Developer Transformation
descriptionHtml:
The mission of the Developer Transformation (DevTx) team is to help developers gain greater familiarity and confidence building modern, cloud-native applications that take full advantage of the latest AI-driven tools and AWS’s wide range of services. Through direct developer engagement, DevTx helps customers to address actual business problems and accelerated design, development and deployment of production quality cloud native application workloads.

As a DevTx Solution Architect (SA), you will help customers to innovate and transform their software development practices, applying modern patterns, the latest architectural best practices using the latest AI-native tools for developing and operating full-stack, cloud-native workloads. You will collaborate with customers and peers, develop content and enable the wider community to harness the power of AWS Cloud.

In this role, you will continuously sharpen and apply your expertise in programming languages, distributed systems, design patterns and the full software development life-cycle, to upskill developers and development teams on AWS cloud services, the third-party ecosystem and partner solutions.

Key job responsibilities
- Be an active member of the AWS Solution Architecture team by engaging in on-to-one and one-to-many application architecture and development discussions and workshops with developers, software engineers, enterprise/solution architects and CTOs
- Accelerating adoption of AWS in the professional developer communities by engaging through tech conferences, startup events, meetups, user groups and hackathons
- Help lead the direction for AWS developer events to make them best-in-class from a developer’s perspective, representing AWS through speaking, doing live demos and interacting with attendees
- Creating technical content such as reference applications, starter kits and patterns and practical guidance that will get developers excited about the potential of AWS as a development platform
- Contributing to a library of highly-reusable developer-focused artefacts such as demonstrations, sample code, blog posts, tutorials, and other modes of technical enablement
- Providing end-user feedback to AWS Product Management and Engineering teams based on the developer ‘voice of the customer‘. Participate in technical and design discussions with AWS technical teams to help speed customer adoption and ensure best practices during implementation

About the team
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Developer Transformation (DevTx) team interacts with software development teams in leading companies to innovate and deliver mission-critical business solutions on top of AWS services.

#aws-jp-sa-ap
#AWSJAPAN

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Experience working in a collaborative multi-disciplinary team and working directly with developers for implementation of designs

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
- Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting
- Experience with AWS technologies
- Knowledge of cloud computing, IT infrastructure, and different programming languages
- Hands-on experience with a selection of programming languages, tools and frameworks (e.g. C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, .NET, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Rust) and cloud-centric technology domains such as Serverless, Containers, Big Data, Analytics, Machine Learning, high-performance databases (SQL and NoSQL), complex networking implementations, and highly secured workloads.

title: Production Risk Manager, Studios Risk Management, Studios Risk Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MGM Studios is looking for a Production Risk Manager to join the Amazon MGM Studios Risk Management team and contribute to Amazon MGM Studios’ insurance placement, advisement, contract review and claims management for all productions. Responsibilities include regular interaction with international and U.S.-based brokers and underwriters, and assist in maintaining and strengthening relationships with external producing partners. The position works closely with internal stakeholders, including Physical Production, Production Finance, Legal, Health & Safety, Security and Post Production teams, as well as the Corporate Risk Management team.

Key job responsibilities
• Interpret insurance policy provisions and provide ongoing support on contractual terms and conditions and application of coverage.
• Gather, analyze, and prepare information for underwriting submission information and applications for insurance policy renewals.
• Evaluate insurance policy quotes and negotiate coverage and pricing for special coverage with insurance brokers, providing recommendations to production teams and manager.
• Review insurance binders, policies, endorsements, invoices and audits to ensure accuracy.
• Review Cast coverage regularly for all assigned productions to ensure full coverage.
• Involvement in broker relationships in conjunction with Production, Legal, Finance and Risk Management teams to ensure adequate servicing and SLA's.
• Collaborate with insurance brokers to manage ongoing production risk, insurance, and services provided by our network of brokers.
• Identify, communicate and champion loss prevention and mitigation, and source improvement opportunities.
• Review, analyze and provide feedback on production contracts including locations, equipment and independent contractors / service providers.
• Communicate regularly with internal production executives for all ongoing insurance-related needs.
• in addition to traditional risk management workflows, and ideal candidate will be able to lean into emerging technologies to explore opportunities to leverage workflow optimization.
• Excel as part of a small team in a fast paced environment in support of our global slate.


A day in the life
The Amazon MGM Studios Risk Management team supports global production for all genres of production including Movies, Scripted Series, and Unscripted Series. We collaborate with production teams around the world to assess insurance needs, place necessary coverage and mitigate risk.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of budgeting, scheduling and cost reporting experience
- 5+ years of journalism or documentary production experience
- 6+ years of creative role understanding consumer trends and creating content experience
- Experience as a producer, production manager, line producer or in production risk management

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of ProTools or other audio or video editing software
- Experience leading large projects and facilitate group meetings

title: Superviseur/euse des Operations
descriptionHtml:
Les opérations sont au cœur de toutes les activités d’Amazon. L’efficacité de nos fonctions opérationnelles nous permet de traiter nos commandes et d’expédier les articles à nos clients en temps voulu. En tant que superviseur des opérations, vous verrez comment nous assurons le fonctionnement de nos différentes fonctions opérationnelles et vous jouerez un rôle dans leur bon déroulement.
Vous serez le premier point de contact des membres de l’équipe pendant leur service et les aiderez à suivre les processus mis en place par vos supérieurs. Il s’agit d’un rôle de terrain, qui vous permettra d’acquérir de l’expérience dans l’utilisation des outils et des systèmes essentiels au succès de nos opérations.

Key job responsibilities
Mesurer et contrôler les flux de travail, suivre les performances sur site et fournir aux responsables de terrain les données nécessaires et relatives aux postes/équipes afin de nous aider à atteindre notre objectif d’excellence opérationnelle
Soutenir et former les collaborateurs pour qu’ils donnent le meilleur d’eux-mêmes et les superviser dans leurs tâches quotidiennes
Soutenir le responsable d’équipe/de secteur pour améliorer les processus, cultiver un environnement de travail sûr et accroître l’engagement des collaborateurs
Travailler avec d’autres services pour trouver des solutions aux problèmes fréquents ou aux besoins en matière d’appui opérationnel dans les secteurs clés
Analyse les données pour identifier les solutions qui nous permettront d’optimiser la sécurité, la qualité et la productivité

A day in the life
En tant que superviseur des opérations, vous serez basé·e sur l’un de nos sites opérationnels. Vous aiderez votre chef d’équipe/de secteur à mettre en pratique le plan de travail de l’équipe. Vous participerez aux réunions d’avant-poste avec votre équipe. Vous vous assurerez que chacun respecte les règles de sécurité et les processus de qualité en place et effectue les tâches selon le degré de priorité de chacune.
Vous ferez remonter les problèmes à votre supérieur, mais vous serez parfois la personne la plus gradée de l’équipe et vous donnerez aux collaborateurs les instructions dont ils ont besoin pour mener à bien leurs tâches. À d’autres moments, vous aiderez votre chef d’équipe/de secteur à planifier les rotations d’équipes afin d’avoir un personnel suffisamment nombreux pendant les périodes de pointe.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, ou AMZL, s’occupe des activités de livraison du « dernier kilomètre » en partenariat avec des entreprises de distribution tierces. Nous faisons appel à la créativité et aux initiatives visant à l’amélioration continue pour acheminer des millions de produits physiques jusqu’à nos clients. Notre objectif est de rendre l’expérience de livraison de nos clients aussi fluide que possible et de déployer des solutions de livraison globales pour nos concepts les plus récents, tels qu’Amazon Fresh, Prime Now et Amazon Restaurants.
Notre travail s’effectue de deux manières. Nos collaborateurs·trices « sous le toit » traitent des millions de produits avant de les envoyer à nos équipes de livraison. La dimension humaine est au cœur des activités de l’équipe. Nous jouons essentiellement un rôle de soutien, y compris de nuit. Nous nous concentrons principalement sur les opérations, avec des équipes présentes 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7 dans la plupart de nos sites.
Quant à nos collaborateurs·trices « sur la route », ils travaillent avec Amazon Flex, un réseau d’entreprises de livraison. Chaque année, nous plaçons la barre toujours plus haut en matière d’expérience client grâce à de nouveaux services de livraison. Nous recherchons de nouveaux moyens de relever les défis logistiques du secteur et de nouvelles idées pour réduire notre empreinte carbone, en nous appuyant sur un parc de véhicules (y compris des véhicules électriques) et des technologies de pointe.

Basic qualifications

- Bonne maîtrise de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) dans un environnement professionnel
- Vous possédez le diplôme du baccalauréat
- Parfaite maîtrise du français, à l’oral et à l’écrit

Preferred qualifications

- Les compétences dites « souhaitables » vous aideront à tirer votre épingle du jeu mais elles ne sont pas nécessaires pour postuler à une offre chez Amazon. Si vous possédez toutes les compétences requises listées précédemment, contactez-nous sans plus tarder.
- Expérience dans la gestion des parties prenantes, y compris l’établissement et le maintien de relations professionnelles
- Expérience dans un environnement opérationnel, tel que la logistique, le commerce de détail, l’hôtellerie ou le service client
- Expérience préalable dans l’analyse de données pour identifier les problèmes
- Maîtrise de l’anglais

Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Software Development Engineer , ADC2S
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 7, 2026

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) control-plane services in air-gapped regions. You will help governments run secure cloud infrastructure at scale.

In this role, you will join a team of engineers who build and operate software for EC2's control plane, fleet health, and capacity operations in air-gapped cloud environments. You will own features and services from design through production, make sound trade-offs within your area, and help raise the quality of what the team ships. Commercial tooling often does not exist in isolated regions, so you will build what the team needs instead of configuring an off-the-shelf product.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate EC2 control-plane services, fleet health automation, and capacity tooling across air-gapped cloud environments.
- Own features end to end: write the design, implement and test the code, deploy it through pipelines to disconnected regions, and operate it in production, including on-call.
- Improve monitoring, alarming, and deployment safety for the services you own, and drive the fix when an operational issue reveals a gap.
- Work with partner teams and stakeholders across the air-gapped partitions to deliver shared infrastructure.
- Take part in design and code reviews, and help new engineers ramp up on the team's systems.
- Use generative artificial intelligence tools and techniques to improve automation, code quality, and team productivity.

A day in the life
You might start the morning finishing a design document for a new capacity automation feature, then review a teammate's code change to how instance lifecycle events are processed in a disconnected region. After lunch, you work with a partner team to get your change into a shared deployment pipeline, then spend the afternoon tracking down the root cause of an alarm from last night's on-call shift. You write code most days, and you are expected to propose better ways to automate capacity and remediation workflows in the systems you own.

About the team
We own the software that keeps EC2 running in the air-gapped partitions: control-plane services, fleet-health automation, and the capacity tooling our government customers depend on. We operate what we build, so the engineers who design a remediation workflow are the ones it pages. Because the commercial tooling for a problem frequently does not exist in an isolated region, you build the thing rather than configure it. The team defaults to written design documents and clear ownership boundaries, and you will work alongside engineers who are passionate about solving hard infrastructure problems in the most demanding regulated cloud environments.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

descriptionHtml:

This role requires up to 75% nationwide travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

title: Controls Engineer, Amazon Leo Optical Inter-Satellite Link
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are looking for a PAT Engineer to assist in the development, testing, and validation of pointing, acquisition, and tracking (PAT) systems for free-space optical links across the Amazon LEO satellite constellation. This role blends electrical engineering, opto-mechatronics, and controls knowledge to support the PAT team across FPGA verification, hardware integration and testing, and model-based design. You will work closely with senior PAT engineers to execute test campaigns, maintain verification infrastructure, and help bridge the gap between algorithm models and hardware implementations.

This is an on-site role. The position sits within the OISL Electrical Engineering team, with workload focused on PAT/controls activities directed by the senior PAT engineer and also supporting the EE team on production RCAs, trade studies, and board-level design and bring-up. The split is flexible based on program phase and candidate strengths.
Day to day, you will work alongside senior PAT engineers and EE team members, contributing across multiple workstreams. A controls-focused background is ideal, with supporting knowledge in electrical engineering, mechanical systems, optics, or aerospace. The role requires comfort moving between flight data analysis, simulation, test infrastructure, and hardware debug depending on program needs. Flexible hours may be needed during test campaigns, and occasional travel to integration/testing facilities is required.

Over time, there is opportunity to grow ownership of specific PAT subsystems and take on more independent technical leadership within the PAT and EE domains.

Key job responsibilities
Flight Data Analysis & Simulation Correlation
• Analyze flight telemetry data and compare against simulation predictions — identify discrepancies, characterize on-orbit behavior, and support anomaly investigations
• Run and maintain simulation environments to reproduce flight scenarios and validate model fidelity against observed data
• Help narrow down root causes by correlating flight data trends with known model behaviors and hardware characteristics
Production Failure Support & RCA
• Support production and on-orbit failure investigations — review data, identify patterns, and help narrow down failure modes
• Assist with electrical RCAs and help debug board-level issues
• Contribute to failure analysis reports and corrective action documentation
• Support production ramp activities requiring EE analysis and hardware troubleshooting

FPGA Verification & Test Vector Development
• Develop and maintain test vectors to verify PAT FPGA implementations against Simulink reference models
• Run bit-accurate simulations, compare outputs, and flag discrepancies between model and FPGA behavior
• Work with existing models of PAT control loops and state machines — run simulations, generate test cases, and validate behavior
• Support model-in-the-loop (MIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) verification activities
Electrical Engineering Support
• Contribute to trade studies for data converter selection and signal chain architecture
• Support board-level testing, characterization, and troubleshooting for analog and mixed-signal circuits
• Assist with electrical design reviews
• Support production ramps and RCAs from an electrical and controls perspective

Documentation & Configuration Management
• Document test procedures, results, RCA findings, and discrepancy investigations clearly
• Help maintain version-controlled models, scripts, and test artifacts
• Contribute to test reports, review materials, and configuration management records

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 3+ years experience in a hardware-adjacent controls, test, or systems engineering role
- MATLAB/Simulink proficiency — comfortable running models, interpreting results, building test cases, and debugging issues
- Experience with reading schematics and understanding digital/analog signal interfaces
- Experience with control system fundamentals — feedback loops, transfer functions, stability concepts
- Experience with working across disciplines — comfortable interfacing with EE, FPGA, and mechanical teams
- Experience analyzing test or flight data to identify trends, anomalies, and correlations

Preferred qualifications

- Data converter (ADC/DAC) electrical characteristics, architectures, and design tradeoffs (SNR, ENOB, linearity, settling time), including basic understanding of sampling theory, decimation/interpolation filters, and anti-aliasing as they relate to converter performance in closed-loop control systems
- Analog and mixed-signal board-level design and troubleshooting best practices (power integrity, signal integrity, grounding)
- Experience with production hardware debug and root cause analysis
- Low-noise design techniques (grounding, shielding, power supply filtering)
- Filter design basics (active/passive, analog/digital)
- Digital interface protocols (SPI, I2C, LVDS, CAN, Ethernet) and use cases
- Basic programming experience (Python, C, or scripting for test automation)
- Awareness of radiation effects (SEU, TID) on semiconductor devices
- Thermal considerations for space-qualified electronics
- Experience in aerospace or defense environments
- MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Git, lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, signal generators, spectrum analyzers), FPGA tools (Vivado/ModelSim), real-time platforms (Speedgoat/dSPACE), schematic capture and PCB CAD tools

title: Transportation Specialist, Amazon Freight Field
descriptionHtml:
**This role will require you to be located in Arizona**

Amazon Freight’s team is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Transportation Specialist to assist in the resolution of stakeholder issues of daily freight movements flowing into and out of our North American network. title: Associate Corporate Counsel, AWS Legal
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Legal Department is looking for a talented technology lawyer to support Amazon Web Services (AWS) in selling to commercial and public sector customers throughout the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region, with a primary focus on supporting AWS sales in Switzerland, Austria, and Germany. AWS is at the forefront of the cloud computing industry, providing AI and IT infrastructure services, such as on-demand compute capacity, storage, content delivery, database services, and more to private and public sector customers.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for drafting, negotiating, and advising on strategic technology service agreements with enterprise customers, public sector customers, and partners, as well as providing legal support for local and regional services and initiatives. The role will also involve ongoing legal counsel and regulatory interpretation and guidance for senior executives and other business and legal team members on a variety of product development, operational, security, compliance, data protection and public policy matters. The role includes participating in other legal team projects, including managing legal issues that arise in existing relationships and handling customer and business partner inquiries.

We are looking for a candidate who is proactive, entrepreneurial, enjoys being challenged, has strong technology and communication skills, and demonstrates sound, pragmatic judgment in ambiguous situations.

This position is based in Zurich, Switzerland. Some regional and international travel will be required.

A day in the life
You will be based in our Zurich office and support various teams within the AWS Sales & Marketing organization. Our lawyers value working alongside and in person with their business clients and local legal teams to solve a constant flow of novel challenges in a growing and exciting business. AWS empowers millions of customers worldwide to build, innovate, and scale their businesses through our comprehensive cloud computing platform. You will be a legal and thought partner for the business on day-to-day matters as well as long-term strategic issues. You will own drafting, negotiating, and closing commercial agreements with enterprise customers, channel partners, marketing agencies, and technology vendors. You will pioneer AI-driven transformation of legal operations—improving contract review cycles, eliminating manual bottlenecks, and deploying advanced research tools that deliver insights in minutes instead of hours. Your innovations will multiply our legal function's impact, enabling faster decisions, consistency, and proactive risk mitigation that keeps us ahead of emerging challenges.

Working directly with business colleagues, you will serve as lead counsel on strategic sales transactions, marketing campaigns, and partnership agreements while helping manage existing commercial relationships. You will also research, advise, and develop expertise on new go-to-market initiatives, advertising regulations, data privacy matters, and emerging legal issues that impact the business.

About the team
The Swiss AWS Legal team is part of the broader EMEA SMGS Legal organization and consists of lawyers supporting AWS's Swiss customer base across commercial and public sector engagements. The team also handles EMEA-wide workstreams, including leading the competition law matters across EMEA and co-leading global SMGS AI legal workstream. Work spans transactional, regulatory, and advisory support across multiple jurisdictions, requiring close collaboration with business stakeholders and legal colleagues throughout the region.

Basic qualifications

- Qualified to practice law in Switzerland.
- Minimum of 2+ years post-qualification legal experience.
- Previous work experience in a law firm, government, or in-house at a technology company.
