title: Sr. Engineering Design Manager, Global Building Design Risk and Recovery (GBDR)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a highly skilled MEP Design Engineer/Manager to lead full-lifecycle design and engineering for industrial, commercial, and mixed-use projects across Australia. The primary focus is Electrical Engineering and Design for Industrial Buildings, with a particular emphasis on large-scale warehouse, distribution centre, fulfilment centre, and logistics hub developments. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in warehouse electrical systems, proven competency in Australian codes and standards including current Australian Standards and the NCC/BCA, strong design leadership, cross-disciplinary coordination capability, and a track record of delivering compliant, high-quality engineering documentation from concept through construction.

Key job responsibilities
Electrical System Design — Primary Discipline
All electrical designs to be prepared in full compliance with current Australian electrical wiring standards, NCC/BCA, and applicable state electrical safety legislation.
• HV/MV Power Systems — Design high-voltage substations (11 kV/33 kV), zone reticulation networks, and transformer installations with appropriate redundancy. Carry out protection relay coordination and liaise directly with Distribution Network Service Providers (DNSPs) such as AusGrid, Energex, and SA Power Networks.
• LV Distribution & Cable Design — Size and detail main switchboards, sub-main distribution boards, and motor control centres. Undertake cable sizing and derating calculations in accordance with applicable Australian electrical standards, ensuring voltage drop and fault level compliance throughout.
• Load Analysis, MCC & Variable Speed Drives — Calculate maximum demand and design motor control centres including DOL, soft-starter, and VSD configurations. Perform load flow and harmonic analysis using industry tools such as ETAP or PowerFactory, with power factor correction to meet utility requirements.
• Emergency & Standby Power — Design diesel generator sets, online UPS systems, and automatic transfer switching arrangements to meet essential services requirements under the NCC/BCA. Provide appropriate redundancy levels for critical process and life safety loads.
• Lighting, Earthing & Hazardous Areas — Develop industrial lighting designs for warehouse, distribution centre, and fulfilment centre environments, including high-bay warehouse lighting layouts, aisle-by-aisle lux level calculations, racking interleaved luminaire placement, and emergency egress lighting. Incorporate DALI controls and NCC Section J energy compliance for large-footprint warehouse facilities. Design earthing and bonding systems and lightning protection installations. Classify hazardous areas and select explosion-protected equipment in accordance with relevant Australian standards for flammable atmospheres.
• Warehouse Power Distribution & Energy Management — Design warehouse power distribution systems including dock leveller power supplies, conveyor and ASRS power feeds, forklift charging bays, EV charging infrastructure, and GPO layouts to suit operational workflows. Develop sub-metering strategies and NCC Section J energy compliance reports. Produce complete electrical deliverables including single-line diagrams, cable and panel schedules, design basis reports, commissioning plans, and as-built documentation.

Design Standards & Specifications Writing
• Design Standards Authoring — Author and maintain electrical design standards, technical specifications, and engineering guidelines specifically for warehouse, distribution centre, fulfilment centre, and logistics hub projects, aligned with the NCC and current Australian Standards. Establish project-specific design basis documents that define system design parameters, equipment selection criteria, and installation requirements for warehouse electrical infrastructure.
• Equipment & System Specifications — Prepare detailed electrical equipment specifications for switchboards, transformers, generators, UPS systems, lighting, and cable management systems for warehouse and logistics hub projects. Develop method of measurement and payment clauses, hold point inspection and test plans (ITPs), and commissioning procedures aligned with Australian construction and design certification requirements.

Secondary Disciplines — HVAC, Fire, Plumbing & ELV
• HVAC — Design heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems including central plant, ductwork layouts, and BMS integration, ensuring compliance with NCC energy performance requirements.
• Fire Protection — Design sprinkler systems, fire detection and alarm systems, hydrant networks, and emergency warning systems in compliance with the NCC and applicable Australian fire safety standards.
• Plumbing & Hydraulics — Design water supply, drainage, stormwater, and trade waste systems in accordance with applicable Australian plumbing and drainage standards and the NCC Plumbing Code of Australia. Include on-site detention, grease traps, oil-water separators, and rainwater harvesting where required.
• BMS, ELV & Smart Building Systems — Design BMS/IBMS architecture using open-protocol platforms, SCADA/HMI integration, and NABERS-aligned energy dashboards. Develop access control, IP CCTV, structured cabling, IoT, and cybersecurity solutions to meet building security and operational requirements.
• BIM Coordination — Lead 3D clash detection and multi-discipline MEP coordination using Revit MEP, Navisworks, and BIM 360/ACC. Prepare bills of quantities, design basis reports, and authority submissions in accordance with Australian BIM information management requirements.


About the team
This role will be a part of Amazon Building Design Team for International Region encompassing EU, APAC, India and MEATR . Our team is accountable for ensuring meeting the key business requirements, upholding safety in design and compliance. We continuously innovate to better ourselves, working with internal and external stakeholders.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technology, or Reliability Engineering, or Master's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
- • Electrical analysis: ETAP, PowerFactory, SKM PowerTools — load flow, short circuit analysis, cable sizing, and protection coordination.
- • Lighting & energy modelling: DIALux evo, Relux; NCC Section J compliance (JV3/DTS pathway); NABERS and Green Star reporting.
- • CAD & BIM: AutoCAD Electrical, Revit MEP, Navisworks, BIM 360/ACC; working knowledge of Australian BIM information management frameworks.
- • HVAC & hydraulics: Carrier HAP, IES-VE, EnergyPlus; hydraulic calculation tools for fire and plumbing system design.
- • Core standards proficiency: current Australian wiring, cable selection, and lighting standards, NCC/BCA — with strong working knowledge of all related Australian design and safety standards.

Preferred qualifications

- • Green Star Accredited Professional (GBCA) or NABERS Assessor accreditation.
- • Certified Energy Professional (CEP) or equivalent industry credential.
- • Autodesk Professional certification in Revit MEP or BIM management.

title: Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst, Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate- Quality Analyst is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

Skills:
• Proficiency in verbal & written communication in English
• Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
• Strong attention to details.
• Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
• Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
• Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
• Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- 1+ years of data-driven business operations processes experience
- Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

title: Operational Excellence Manager, FBA, 3P Marketplace
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s South Africa marketplace is growing fast, and the sellers on it depend on us to get their products to customers quickly and reliably. The 3P Fulfilment team owns that promise across FBA, Easy Ship, Seller Flex and Merchant-fulfilled channels.
We are looking for an experienced Operations Excellence Manager to own how well those channels operate. You will be responsible for the operational metrics the business is goaled on, for the mechanisms that move them, and for the data that proves whether they moved. This is a hands-on, deeply analytical role: you will spend your time in order-level data, in the detail of carrier and fulfilment-centre operations, and in the room where trade-offs between speed, cost and seller experience get decided.

You will own end-to-end supply-chain processes from source to customer, using data to influence others and to build scalable systems and processes rather than fixing single issues and you will play a critical role in delivering the optimal seller and customer experience by ensuring the right product is in the right place at the right time.
You will work directly with ZA fulfilment and transportation operations, seller-facing product and account-health teams, worldwide programme teams launching into ZA, and our carrier partners. You will be expected to form your own view from the data, write it up clearly, and defend it.
If you are motivated by taking processes that today rely on manual trackers and individual knowledge and building them into scalable, well-documented mechanisms that run reliably without their owner, this is the role for you



Key job responsibilities
Drive the core 3P fulfilment metrics end to end — own the definitions, the data sources behind them, the weekly and quarterly reporting, and the variance narrative for the 3P speed, reliability and seller-adoption metrics the business is goaled on.

Monitor and improve core 3P operational metrics — seller availability and in-stock rate, inbound lead time, delivery speed and fulfilment/fill rates — identifying and delivering improvement opportunities with sellers and their Account Managers across replenishment, inbound and fulfilment execution.

•Run and improve the standing operational mechanisms that move those metrics — including seller performance review programmes, metric-exemption and waiver processing, seller enforcement ladders, and the 3P inbound appointment process through peak. Document each one so it survives a change of owner.

Act as the ZA 3P operations input into worldwide programme launches — supply the market business requirements, launch cohort and hold-back list, measurement window, performance thresholds and local enforcement design, and coordinate delivery with the owning programme teams.

Build and own the 3P reporting layer — dashboards and scheduled data feeds that give the ZA team, Account Managers and worldwide programme partners a single trustworthy source, replacing manual pulls.

Diagnose and close performance defects. Identify where seller-fault, carrier-fault and Amazon-fault misses actually originate, size each, and drive the fix with the owning team — sellers, Account Managers, carriers or fulfilment centres — rather than reporting it.

Own the carrier and fulfilment-centre operational interface for 3P inbound — service-level expectations, appointment and escalation routes with carriers and FCs. Optimise the end-to-end 3P fulfilment cost structure and profitability through carrier and partner-team engagement, project management and system improvements.

Write the documents. Business requirement documents, weekly and quarterly business reviews. Share 3P operational insights into Senior Leadership business reviews, verbally and in writing.

Partner with Legal, PR and account health on any change to seller-facing policy, help content or seller communications, and own the ZA localisation of seller-facing material.

- Experience with SQL and advanced Excel
- Experience working with large, complex data sets
- Experience in e-commerce, retail or advertising, or experience in logistics

- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma

title: Program Manager, Transportation Network Operations, NOC (Network Operation Center)
descriptionHtml:
Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and, enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services).
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time

Responsibilities of a NOC PM
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, multiple technology and cross-border program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making. This role is a part of the centralized Network Operations Centre (NOC) org part of Amazon India.
A Program Manager is expected to have deep functional knowledge, ability to design new program frameworks/processes and running defect reduction programs. They should be proficient, in identifying the input and output metric to gauge the success of a program. In this role, they will work with business and operations team to analyze historic results, challenge status quo and make business recommendations to senior management based on those analyses – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. The Program Manager will drive improvements to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners. descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is driving game changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. Our products will fundamentally change our data centers, providing operational efficiencies and financial benefits that are critical to the success of AWS and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to be a technical lead driving the innovations being developed and deployed in the next generation data centers.

AWS is seeking a Hardware Engineer to design, prototype, and bring to production the mechanical and thermal systems that enable robots to operate reliably in our data centers. You will own hardware from early-stage concept sketches and CAD models through FEA/CFD validation, prototype builds, manufacturing engagement, and production ramp. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable running a CFD simulation on a cooling manifold as they are on the shop floor reviewing first articles with a supplier. This role closely collaborates with robotics software engineers, electrical engineers, and ML engineers to ensure that mechanical designs meet sensor mounting requirements, thermal budgets, serviceability targets, and the harsh realities of a data center environment. You will be the bridge between design intent and manufactured reality — championing DFM/DFA throughout the development cycle and driving continuous improvement once hardware is in the field.

As Amazon has a global presence, intermittent travel will be necessary and should be expected to be approximately 30% to AWS offices, data centers, suppliers, vendors, and product validation tests. While most travel will be domestic, some international travel may be required.

title: Safety Investigations Analyst, Middle Mile Investigations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're dedicated to becoming the most customer-centric company on Earth. To achieve this goal, we seek exceptionally talented, bright, and driven individuals. Amazon is currently looking for a Safety Investigations Analyst to join Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) within NAST Safety and Compliance.

The Safety Investigations Analyst owns investigation of Middle Mile transportation incidents end to end, from intake through documented finding, across Amazon's carrier programs: Relay Motor Carrier (RMC), Relay Motor Carrier LineHaul (RMCLH), Relay Motor Carrier Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP).

In this role you will conduct comprehensive incident investigations using telematics, video, and law enforcement records; apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria; identify trends across regions, programs, and carriers; recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices; and serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and external counsel. Findings inform network-level changes intended to reduce incident frequency and severity.

The successful candidate writes clearly for senior audiences, reaches defensible conclusions from incomplete information, and works independently across competing deadlines.

Key job responsibilities
Investigation

- Own assigned incident investigations end to end, from intake through documented finding, across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP.
- Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash camera footage, law enforcement records, and carrier documentation.
- Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards.
- Write investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, each sourced to verifiable data.
- Serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and, when assigned, external counsel.

Analysis and enforcement

- Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager.
- Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices.
- Query multiple data systems to extract and reconcile investigation data.

Operating rhythm

- Maintain case records and queue status in the systems of record, keeping tracking current and auditable.
- Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness, and escalate vendor performance issues.
- Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence.
- Propose improvements to investigation process and standard work.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter.

About the team
Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety and Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is small and geographically distributed. Analysts own their cases rather than a shared queue, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. We are building our standard work now, so you will help shape how this function operates rather than inherit a finished process. If you want ownership and are comfortable with ambiguity, you will do well here.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Are 18 years of age or older

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with end-to-end project management

You are a relationship builder, creative problem solver, and have experience growing a business independently. You're energized by working directly with external partners, comfortable with ambiguity, and calm under pressure, and you communicate clearly and build trust with brands, creators, and internal teams alike while always looking for ways to make our programs run smoother and scale.

The Creator Monetization team connects brands with commerce Creators at Amazon, growing brands' businesses and creators' earnings in the process.

title: Solutions Architect, Cross Industries, Retail & Supply Chain and Logistics, AWS
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers solve complex technical challenges? As a Solutions Architect at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will partner directly with customers to design and deliver cloud architectures that drive real business outcomes — whether that means reducing costs, accelerating product launches, or building entirely new capabilities. You will combine your technical depth with a genuine curiosity about each customer's business to craft solutions that are secure, scalable, reliable, and performant.

This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will work across a broad range of AWS services, guiding customers through design trade-offs and helping them adopt cloud best practices. If you are a self-starter who thrives on translating ambiguous technical problems into well-architected solutions, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end solution design for customer engagements, understanding business context and outcome priorities to architect solutions that address specific technical and strategic objectives.
- Dive into technical details with customer engineering teams — evaluating design choices around load distribution, data store selection, scaling strategies, and failover mechanisms — to ensure architectures meet reliability, security, and performance requirements.
- Develop and deliver technical content such as workshops, presentations, sample code, and white papers that educate customers on best practices and accelerate their adoption of AWS services.
- Collaborate with internal teams including sales, business development, professional services, and engineering to progress customer opportunities and translate product feedback into actionable requirements for service teams.
- Identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions and contribute reusable design patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that benefit the broader Solutions Architect community.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing an architecture proposal for a customer migrating a critical workload, then jump into a design session where you whiteboard a resilient, cost-effective solution alongside the customer's engineering leads. After lunch, you could be building a proof of concept that demonstrates how generative AI capabilities can address a customer's specific use case. Later, you share lessons learned from a recent engagement during a peer design review, helping teammates refine their own approaches. Throughout it all, you are the trusted technical advisor your customers rely on.

About the team
Our team of Solutions Architects works at the forefront of cloud technology, partnering with customers to turn ambitious ideas into production-ready architectures. We operate in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning are part of how we work every day. Whether you are coaching a customer through their first cloud deployment or helping an established organization rethink its infrastructure strategy, you will have the support of a team that values creative problem-solving and technical excellence. Join us and help shape how customers build on AWS.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 5+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
